A single schedule / recurrence / template outside the scope answers its own 404 (E-LSC-001 / 002 / 003) instead; lists without a store filter are narrowed to the caller's stores. E-SYS-001 (500) when the scope cannot be read from auth-svc / contracts-svc.

422.description: Missing changeReason (E-LSC-022).

post.description: Cancels this session and all LATER non-cancelled ones of the same recurrence in a single transaction, writing one history row per affected schedule so each cancellation is auditable on its own record. With `stopFurtherExpansion` (default true) the rule is also deactivated so it stops producing more; `false` keeps it generating past the gap. Same reason rules and the same booking cascade as a single cancel, over every cancelled session (`affectedBookingCount` = bookings cancelled; N-030 per member per session). Only valid on a recurrence-produced occurrence — a one-off has no "later ones" (E-LSC-017), checked BEFORE the body (§6.4 #1 → #2): a one-off answers 422 E-LSC-017 even with no category.

200.description: How many sessions the cancellation reached, how many bookings it cancelled with them, and whether the rule stopped generating.

400.description: Missing / unknown category (missing = `details[]` `cancellationReasonCategory` / `required`, answered after the E-LSC-017 check), or `other` without a cancellationReason (E-VAL-001).

403.description: Observer, or a trainer who is not one of the assigned trainers on EVERY row of the cohort (§6.4 #1a / §6.12 #1a — judged on the rows before the write, after the E-LSC-017 check; nothing is written) (E-LSC-101).

422.description: Not part of a recurrence (E-LSC-017) or missing changeReason (E-LSC-022).

post.summary: Cancel this and every later occurrence (API-112 §6)

post.description: The bulk-edit twin of cancel-from-here: applies ONE structural change (startTime / studioId / trainerIds) to this session and all LATER non-cancelled ones of the same recurrence in a single transaction, writing one `updated` history row per affected schedule and syncing the recurrence rule so FUTURE expansions follow too. `endTime` is recomputed per row — from the lesson duration and trainer buffers OF THAT ROW — and never accepted from the client. A new studio is judged per row by the lesson OF THAT ROW (a PATCH may have moved one occurrence to another lesson): a personal-training row refuses it (400), a studio-lesson row must fit the capacity + buffer band of the room (E-LSC-004), body care takes it as is. Trainer conflicts are SOFT — rows are still updated and the clashing dates come back in `conflictedDates[]`, because hard-rejecting on row 7 of 12 would leave the cohort half-updated. After commit, the members still booked (reserved / pending) on every session whose start time, studio or trainer set actually moved are sent N-029 (`changeLessonSchedule`) — one event per session, keyed on its own history row (§6.12 #7(e)). Only valid on a recurrence-produced occurrence (E-LSC-017).

200.description: How many sessions changed, which dates now carry a trainer clash, and how many cancelled rows were skipped.

400.description: Body shape invalid, none of startTime / studioId / trainerIds supplied, or a studio of another store / for a cohort holding a personal-training session (E-VAL-001 — body_care may take one, v0.10).

403.description: Observer, or a trainer who is not one of the assigned trainers on EVERY row of the cohort (§6.4 #1a / §6.12 #1a — judged on the rows before the write, after the E-LSC-017 check; nothing is written) (E-LSC-101).

409.description: Stale expectedUpdatedAt on the anchor row (E-LSC-014) — checked again inside the write transaction, so of two concurrent edits holding the same value exactly one succeeds; the other writes nothing.

422.description: Not part of a recurrence (E-LSC-017), a missing / null / blank changeReason (E-LSC-022), an empty / unknown / duplicate trainer set, or an inactive trainer not already on every target session and on the rule (E-LSC-021, v0.15 — `details[]` field `trainerIds` for the empty set, `trainerIds.<index>` per offending id), or — a new room — any studio-lesson session whose capacity is above that room's capacity + buffer (E-LSC-004, §6.12 #4a; checked before the trainers and the lock, nothing is updated).

post.summary: Apply one change to this and every later occurrence (API-112 §6.12)

get.description: Read-only. Counts the sessions update-from-here and cancel-from-here would write from this occurrence — the anchor and every later NON-cancelled session of the same recurrence, exactly their cohort, with NO date window (the list caps a read at 3 months) — and the `reserved` / `pending` bookings on them (trial included, and split out): the members N-029 / N-030 would go to. Backs the CRM's 「影響を受ける予約」 (change modal) and 「中止による影響」 (cancel wizard) so the FE does not scan the list. Read scope as the detail (§6.10 Read row); a one-off anchor is 422 E-LSC-017 and a trainer must teach every session of the cohort (403 E-LSC-101) — the same guards as the two writes.

post.description: CRM manual entry (§6.1). `statusOnCreate=pending` creates a mode-B HOLD with an expiry, which #7 confirms; `reserved` (the default, published or not) confirms immediately and announces it. An unpublished schedule takes either (§6.1 #2 v0.10 — CRM entry on a non-public slot); only a cancelled one refuses. A hold expires 48 hours after entry (TBD-D01-PENDING-TTL interim). **Evaluation order (v0.12 — R-15), first failure answers:** ① request syntax → 400 E-VAL-001; ② unknown schedule / outside scope → 404 E-LSB-001; ③ references and values → 400 E-VAL-001, in the order member unknown to the directory or deleted (500 E-SYS-001 if auth-svc cannot be asked) — or, for a `trainer`, a member without an `active` / `suspended` main contract at the schedule's store, answered exactly like an unknown member (§7.1 v0.12; 500 E-SYS-001 if contracts-svc cannot be asked), monthly plan without `optionContractId`, an `optionContractId` that is not an existing contract OF THIS MEMBER (`code=not_found`) or not a MONTHLY PLAN (`options.monthly_session_count` null — §6.1 #6a) (500 E-SYS-001 if contracts-svc cannot be asked), `per_use` with a negative fee or with no fee on a lesson that has none (§6.1 #7 — 0 is valid), a seat on a PT / body-care lesson; ④ booking rules → 422, in the order: cancelled session (E-LSB-005) → booking restriction — the lesson has plan / option restrictions and the member holds none (E-LSB-018, §6.1 #3a; 500 E-SYS-001 if contracts-svc cannot be asked) → female-only lesson and the member is not `female` (E-LSB-019, #3b) → the member already holds a reserved / pending / attended booking on this schedule (E-LSB-002, #3c — also on a concurrent duplicate) → no-show penalty for that lesson category (E-LSB-007 — `details: { penaltyType, endAt }`, `userMessage` names the end date) → monthly-plan sessions used up for the schedule's month (E-LSB-006 — current month `COALESCE(remaining_count, monthly_session_count)`, a later month `monthly_session_count`, minus that month's reserved / pending bookings on the contract) → `paymentType=trial` without `isTrial=true` (E-LSB-008, #8) → a trial booking on a schedule that takes none — studio without trial seats, PT that is not a trial course, any body care (E-LSB-008, #8a) → trial ceiling (E-LSB-008, #9 — `inclusive` trial ≤ limit and all ≤ capacity, `additive` trial ≤ limit) → capacity (E-LSB-010, #12 — every reserved / pending / attended booking counts, only non-trial ones under `additive`) → studio seat missing / not a bookable `normal` seat in the right studio / held (E-LSB-009 — also on a concurrent claim). **No monthly-plan session is consumed here** — that happens at attendance (§6.3 #6, D-Q02 interim).

Re-binding checks the NEW contract (§6.5, v0.12 order: 403 → 409 stale → 400 → E-LSB-003 → E-LSB-006 → E-LSB-009): a monthly-plan booking cannot be unbound (`optionContractId: null` → 400 E-VAL-001, #2b); the new contract must be the member's own and a monthly plan (400 E-VAL-001, #2c); an ATTENDED booking cannot change contract (422 E-LSB-003, #2a — its session was taken from the old one; no-show / cancelled ones can); a reserved / pending monthly-plan booking needs a session left in it for the schedule's month, this booking left out of the count (422 E-LSB-006). Edits are silent: nothing is announced.

Other single resources outside the scope answer their own 404 (E-LSB-001 booking, E-LSB-020 penalty, E-LSB-030 memo read, E-LSC-001 booking-stats); lists without a store filter are narrowed to the caller's stores. post.description: By QR scan or manual entry (§6.3). A second QR scan of an attended booking is a no-op 200 with the attendance already on record; a manual re-mark is refused (409 E-LSB-014) because it would overwrite the original timestamp and method. A cancelled or no-show booking cannot be attended (422 E-LSB-013). Attending a pending booking confirms it. By QR it is a confirmation (§6.3 #2, v0.11): the #7 checks run first — expired hold 409 E-LSB-012, and every §6.2 #3 re-check (E-LSB-018 / 019 / 002 / 007 / 006 / 008 / 010 / 009) — and a failure rejects the scan and writes NOTHING (neither the confirmation nor the attendance); on success the confirmation is announced to the member, as #7 would. **A monthly-plan attendance consumes one session** of the bound contract, in the same write (§6.3 #6, v0.10): none left (a concurrent attendance took the last one) → 422 E-LSB-006; contracts-svc unreachable → 500 E-SYS-001 — in both cases NO attendance is recorded; a contract that no longer exists or is not a monthly plan → 400 E-VAL-001 (`optionContractId` — re-bind with PATCH). Retrying after a failure never consumes twice; attending again after a revert (#19) is a new consumption.

post.description: The CAUSE (`cancelledBy`: member / staff / trainer) becomes the STATUS (cancelled_by_member / _by_staff / _by_trainer) because FR-008 treats the three as different outcomes, not one state with an attribute; `cancelledByStaffId` is null for a member cancellation since there is no staff operator. A trainer may cancel — for any cause, a member's phone cancellation included — only on a session they are assigned to (E-LSB-101). Cancelling RELEASES the seat, which is what makes the grid reusable. No monthly-plan session is given back: none was consumed (consumption is at attendance, §6.3 / D-Q02 — and nothing consumes one yet, a later tier). Only a live (reserved / pending) booking can be cancelled: an attended, no-show or already-cancelled one is 422 E-LSB-015.

post.description:
Creates a questionnaire (optionally with nested questions[].choices[]). `code` is optional — omitted, the server assigns the next `Q-001`-style code; a sent code must be unique (E-QST-011). `status` follows the form's 有効/無効 switch (default `inactive`). triggerCode ⇔ category (E-QST-008/015); format ⇔ choices (E-QST-006/007). **system / headquarter only**.

`status: active` on a trigger where another active questionnaire has an overlapping brand scope (empty `brandEnums` = all brands) → **409 E-QST-010** whose `details.conflictingQuestionnaire` names it. To replace it: `PATCH /{conflictingId}/status` `{ status: inactive, reason }`, then retry — the server never deactivates the other one on its own.

put.description:
name / description / triggerCode / brandEnums **and the complete question + choice list** in one transaction, with ONE version bump and ONE history entry. **system / headquarter only**.

- A question / choice with an `id` must already belong to this questionnaire (else E-QST-004); omit `id` for new ones.
- An existing **question** left out is retired (`status=inactive`), answered or not; its answers are kept and still aggregate.
- An existing **choice** left out is always retired, answered or not: members stop seeing it immediately, past answers keep it.
- Nothing is ever deleted. Store visibility is unchanged — it has its own per-question / per-choice endpoints.
- `category` cannot change. Editing an **active** questionnaire so that `triggerCode` or `brandEnums` changes and its brand scope overlaps another active questionnaire on the same trigger → 409 E-QST-010 with `details.conflictingQuestionnaire` (nothing saved).
- Send the loaded `version`; stale → **409 E-QST-016** (`details.currentVersion`), nothing written — reload.
- Array position is the order (questions and choices); no `displayOrder`.

get.description:
The CSV form of EP 16 (FR-004) — **one row per answer**, 1:1 with the list's `items[]`, in the order `sort` / `order` ask for.

The 20 columns (Japanese header row, for Excel) are `回答ID`, `回答日時`, `回答状況`, `回答済み設問数`, `総設問数`, `回答完了`, `アンケートID`, `アンケート名`, `種別`, `バージョン`, `会員ID`, `会員番号`, `会員姓`, `会員名`, `会員区分`, `性別`, `入会日`, `店舗ID`, `店舗名`, `ブランド`. Enum cells carry the CRM wording, not the enum value (`回答状況` 提出済み / 辞退 / 回答中, `回答完了` 完了 / 未完了, `種別` ライフサイクル / オペレーション / カウンセリング, `会員区分` 通常会員 …, `性別` 男性 / 女性 …, `ブランド` JOYFIT / FIT365 …), and `回答日時` is JST `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`.

**No answer-content columns.** A cross-questionnaire export spans questionnaires with different question sets, so a per-question column expansion is impossible — the column count would change row by row. Read one answer's content via EP 13 (`GET /admin/questionnaires/{id}/responses/{answerId}`).

`is_complete` and `response_status` are kept as two separate columns: 未完了 and 辞退 must not be collapsed (§12.5.3). A null `store_id` is written as three empty cells, with no back-fill from `members.primary_store_id`.

Query axes are EP 16's minus `page` / `limit` / `includeTotalAll` (the export is always the full result set); `sort` / `order` are accepted. Requires `positions.can_export_survey_csv = true` — **`trainer` is denied here although it may read EP 16** (§14 row 21: reading on screen and extracting a file are different FR rows).

get.description:
Backs the CRM 「回答データ一覧」 screen (`survey-responses`) — and, with `?memberId=` and no `questionnaireId`, the **member-detail アンケート tab**. Rows span every questionnaire the caller may read.

Each row carries denormalised `questionnaire` / `member` / `store` blocks plus the progress counters, so the table renders without a second round trip. **Answer content is not returned** — the list stays light; read one answer's content from EP 13 or extract it with the EP 15 CSV.

**`isComplete` and `responseStatus` are different axes.** Render three states, not two: 完了 (`isComplete`), 未完了 (`!isComplete && responseStatus != declined`), 辞退 (`responseStatus == declined`, which is `0 / N` and so also `isComplete=false`).

`member.*` and `store.*` display fields are joined here from auth-svc / contracts-svc; they come back **null** when that join is unavailable rather than failing the screen. `member.enrolledAt` is null for now (it needs a contracts lookup with no batch RPC yet). `store` itself is null when the answer has no store, and is never back-filled from the member's current store — the CRM renders 「—」.

The v0.13 cross-schema filter axes (`brandEnum` / `brandGroup` / `memberType` / `gender` / `enrolledFrom` / `enrolledTo` / `memberQuery`) are resolved to id sets **before** the page is cut, so `totalItems` and the page boundaries are correct. `brandEnum` resolves through `answers.store_id → stores.brand_enum` and **intersects** with `storeId` rather than overriding it. `brandGroup` (JOYFIT / FIT365 — every sub-brand under it) resolves through `stores.brand_group` and intersects with both. A filter matching more than 10 000 members is a 400 telling you to narrow it — never a silently shortened page.

`sort=memberNumber` is accepted but ordering falls back to `submittedAt`: a filter can narrow to an id set, an ORDER BY key cannot be borrowed from another schema.

A `staff` sees its own stores only (`OwnStores`: its store, or every store of its FC company) — applied after `brandEnum` / `brandGroup` are resolved, so they intersect.

`observer` is denied (E-AUTH-100). A `trainer` sees only the **counseling** answers of the members booked on sessions it is assigned to (G-04 担当予約者のみ): the booked set is resolved from lessons-svc and AND-ed into the query, `category` is pinned to `counseling`, and a trainer with no bookings gets an empty page. If the booked set cannot be resolved the request is refused (E-AUTH-100) — never widened.

The locker array is keyed `lockers` (what legacy actually returned and what the app parses — its Swagger said `locker` through an annotation name), holds **at most one** entry, `lockerArea` is the A–Z cabinet-area letter, and `code` is parsed to an int, so a non-numeric slot code becomes null.

Compat endpoint matching the mobile `MembersApiClient.members`, which the Share-Routine screen calls to populate its list. Legacy`s `InfinityPaginationResultType` envelope: the array is **`data`**, not `items`.

The canonical `GET /api/v1/social-profiles` (API-144 EP1) answers a different question and cannot stand in: it takes `q` where the app sends **`filter`** (and its query schema is strict, so `filter=` is rejected outright), answers `{items,…}`, names the fields `memberId`/`displayName`/`avatarDisplayUrl`, and **does not exclude the caller** — you would be offered your own name to share with.

Members blocked in either direction are absent, as they are from every social read. A member whose avatar is a preset reports `avatar: null`: legacy read the uploaded file only.

get.summary: [legacy] Member picker — the people you can share a routine with

get.description:
Compat path matching the mobile `RestApiPath.memberVerify` (`/v1/fitness-member/members/verify`). The launch gate: `memberStatus` (profile-completeness enum), `memberContractStatus` (asked of contracts-svc, the owner), `isCompletedCounseling`/`lastCounselingId` from survey-svc (API-132), and `unacceptedTerms` from API-076 scoped to the member’s brand.

`unacceptedTerms` keeps legacy’s type scope: 会員規約 / 個人情報 / 決済 always, a 休会 document only while a 休会 is pending or running, a 退会 document only while a 退会 is pending — the set `CheckTermsPage` can actually accept.

**Id types are UUID strings** (`lastCounselingId`, `unacceptedTerms[].id`), consistent with every other surface. Counselling and terms are best-effort: an outage in either degrades to “nothing outstanding” rather than failing the whole bootstrap call.

200.description: Launch gating. **`memberStatus` is the mobile profile-completeness enum (0–3), not the backend lifecycle status.**

post.description:
Compat path matching the mobile `MemberApiClient.createMemberEmpty` (`POST /v1/fitness-member/members/create`), which the app fires right after signup and again on the account-transfer screen before reading `members/me`.

**It creates nothing.** Legacy had a Yamauchi user with no fitness `members` row and this endpoint minted one; in the new design the member row IS the identity the JWT `sub` names, so it always exists by the time a token can be presented. The call is kept as an idempotent existence check so the shipped build keeps its flow: it resolves the caller (404 E-MEM-001 if the record is missing or soft-deleted, which legacy could not express) and returns the legacy `{message}` the client ignores. Legacy answered 400 "Members already exists" on a second call; this returns 200 every time — the app treats it as success and immediately re-reads `members/me`.

200.description: The member record exists. The message mirrors the legacy string; the client ignores the body.

get.description: Compat endpoint returning the legacy mobile `MemberInfo` shape, mapped from the new-design member record. `id`/`userId` are the member UUID; `memberId` is the **family parent’s** UUID (legacy self-join) and `null` unless the caller is a family child — the app gates the unpaid banner on it; `appAvailable` is `true`; the `approveOf*Notice` flags are the member's stored per-channel approvals (the same values `members/setting-page` reads); `imageMember` mirrors the face photo (`faceReferenceImage`) as a legacy image entity; columns with no new-design source (`taxRate`, `stopGateStatus`, `referralCode`, `familyCode`, `fieldUpdateTimes`, …) are `null`.

200.description: The fitness half in the legacy `MemberInfo` shape. `id`/`userId` are **the same UUID**; `memberId` is the family parent (null for a non-child); `appAvailable` is hardcoded `true`; the `allow*Notify` / `approveOf*Notice` flags are the member's real settings, as `members/setting-page` reads them.

patch.description: Compat path matching the shipped mobile `MembersApiClient.updateMemberMe` (JSON `PATCH /v1/fitness-member/members/me`). The legacy body (`emergencyContact*`, name, birthDate, optional email/phone) is normalised to the canonical shape and delegated to the same `MemberService.UpdateProfile` as `PATCH /api/v1/members/me`. `bloodType` + `rhesusFactor` (血液型 ABO / Rh, the 会員情報登録② pair) are both persisted — `rhesusFactor` since 2026-09-08, Mobile Dev Q&A 2026-09-03. Changing `email` / `phoneNumber` does not apply immediately — it starts a Yamauchi OTP flow and returns **202** (confirm via `POST /v1/fitness-member/members/change-contact-confirm`). On a plain profile update the full legacy `MemberInfo` is returned; the shipped client ignores the body. Multipart (face-image) upload is NOT handled here — that is a separate follow-up.

200.description: The updated member. **Only for changes that apply immediately** — an email or phone change returns 202 with a pending-change body instead.

202.description: **A different body from the 200**: the change is NOT applied yet, an OTP was sent, and `pendingField` says which field is waiting. Branch on the status before assuming you got a member object.

400.description: Body failed schema validation / no fields supplied (E-VAL-001).

403.description: Not editable for this member: Type C / vendor (E-AUTH-100), Yamauchi field on Type B (E-MEM-100), or email/phone on the App Store review account (E-MEM-206).

409.description: New email/phone already registered to a Yamauchi account (E-MEM-203 / E-MEM-204) — including the member's own: a "change" to the current email/phone is refused the same way, without contacting Yamauchi.

422.description: Non-active Type B member cannot edit (E-MEM-200).

502.description: Yamauchi User/System API timed out (E-EXT-001), or failed / refused the call in a way that is not the member's doing, e.g. the System API IP allowlist (E-EXT-002).

patch.summary: Legacy member update (MemberInfo edit) — members/me PATCH

post.description: Compat path for the shipped mobile `MembersApiClient.changeContactConfirm` (`POST /v1/fitness-member/members/change-contact-confirm`). Second step of an email/phone change started by `PATCH /v1/fitness-member/members/me`. A single endpoint handles both: the body is either `{ email, verificationCode }` or `{ phoneNumber, verificationCode }` (the legacy `verificationCode` is mapped to `code`). Delegates to the same `MemberService.ConfirmEmailChange` / `ConfirmSmsChange` as the canonical `POST /api/v1/members/me/confirm-email` / `confirm-sms`. Answers **204 No Content**, as fitness-api did — re-read `members/me` for the applied value. A body carrying BOTH `email` and `phoneNumber` is rejected (400 E-VAL-001 naming both fields), as fitness-api rejected it — it is not a request to change two things at once.

requestBody.description: Exactly ONE of the two shapes below. Both carry `verificationCode` (the legacy key for the 6-digit OTP); which contact field accompanies it selects the branch. Sending both `email` and `phoneNumber` is not a valid request.

204.description: Confirmed and applied. **No body** — fitness-api answered 204, and so does this.

400.description: Body missing email/phoneNumber, carrying **both** of them, or otherwise failing validation (E-VAL-001). `details[]` names the offending field(s).

401.description: OTP invalid/expired (E-AUTH-023) or bad Fitness JWT (E-AUTH-002 / E-AUTH-003).

403.description: The App Store review account cannot change its email or phone (E-MEM-206).

409.description: Email/phone already registered to another Yamauchi account (E-MEM-203 / E-MEM-204).

502.description: Yamauchi confirm unavailable or timed out (E-EXT-001 / E-EXT-002).

post.summary: Confirm a pending email/phone change (OTP) — members/change-contact-confirm

get.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `MyPageApiClient.getMemberProfile` (My Page) **and** `FeedsApiClient.getMemberProfile` (the Other People Profile screen), `GET /v1/fitness-member/members/profile`. The social (SNS) profile — displayName / avatar / bio / follow counts — mapped to the legacy `Member` shape, backed by social-svc. `memberId` is the member UUID.

• **No `memberId`, or your own id** — your own profile; every relationship flag is `false`.
• **Another member's `memberId`** — THEIR profile, with the five legacy flags relative to you (`isFollow` you follow them · `isFollowingMe` they follow you · `isMute` · `isBlock` you block them · `isReport` you have reported them). Gender and date of birth are `null` unless that member made them visible.

Legacy's block rule, deliberately not the canonical one: **only a block BY THAT MEMBER is a 404**. If you are the one blocking, the profile is served with `isBlock: true` — the screen's unblock control reads it — where `GET /api/v1/social-profiles/{memberId}` answers 404 for a block in either direction.

`memberId` used to be ignored, so the Other People Profile screen showed the caller's own profile for anyone.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: Member **UUID** whose profile to read (the Other People Profile screen). Omitted, or your own id = your own profile.

200.description: The **SNS** profile in the legacy `Member` shape — yours, or the requested member's.

404.description: No such active member, or that member has blocked you (E-SNS-030) — legacy answered 404 for both.

get.summary: Legacy member profile (SNS `Member` shape) — mine, or another member's

get.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `HomeApiClient.getReferralFriend` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/invitations`, API-140 EP1). Lists the members who redeemed the caller's own referral code (the "invited friends" — name + join date, **oldest first** per §4.1), the caller's `referralCode`, and `point` — the **accumulated referral award** (§6.2: SUM of the caller's `referral` point rows, legacy's sum of invitation points), not the spendable balance. `invitedAt` is a JST calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`); an unresolvable invitee name is the literal `"Unknown"` (§6.3).

A member with no code yet gets one **issued on this read**, as legacy did (`getInvitationMember` generated and saved it) — the open TBD-A140-CODE-PROVISION, decided by the 2026-09-11 build-against-legacy ruling. It is attached to the brand of the member's current contract; with no contract, or no referral campaign for that brand, it stays `null`.

200.description: Invited friends plus the caller’s code and accumulated referral points. Note the **singular `member` key holding a list**. `referralCode` is null only when none could be issued (no contract / no referral campaign for the brand).

get.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `RestApiPath.planOptionsMe` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/plan-options/me`), which backs the point-exchange screen.

**Not an alias of the canonical `GET /api/v1/members/me/contract/plan-options`** (API-151 §4) — that one is a different list in two ways the app depends on: it omits the **plan line**, and it keys `id` on the contract LINE rather than the master.

`fee` is **tax-inclusive**, like legacy's: `contracts.fee` / `options.fee` were 「料金(税込)」, so the 税抜 master is converted (floor, API-085 §17). Until 2026-09-25 it was passed through and every point price read one tax application low.

The app reads all four fields: `fee` is rendered as the point price, and `memberContractId` is sent back as `scopeId` when the exchange is confirmed — dropping it breaks the confirm step, not just the display. Ids are UUID strings (ADR-038 D8); the app still declares them ints.

`[]` when the member has no active contract (never 404), as legacy did.

200.description: The plan line first, then active monthly options by start date.

get.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `RestApiPath.billingHistories` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/members/billing-histories`, API-150 #1). Thin pass-through of the canonical `GET /api/v1/members/me/billing-histories`.

**Two id renames the app must absorb** (ADR-038 D8, §11.2): legacy `saleId` → `billingId` and legacy `clearId` → `paymentId`, both int → UUID string. `invoiceDate` is now `null` on an uncollected line instead of legacy's (wrong) today-date.

200.description: Legacy PaymentHistoryResponse. **A bare `{}` when nothing qualifies** — legacy returned that rather than empty buckets or a 404.

get.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `GymApiClient.getPaymentDetail` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/members/payment-details?clearId=&saleId=`) — the 支払い詳細 screen opened from a line of `members/billing-histories`.

Send the ids that line carries: **`clearId` = its `paymentId`** opens the PAID view, and **`saleId` = its `billingId`** alone opens the UNPAID one (legacy's two entries; `clearId` wins when both are sent, and `saleId` then picks the billing when one payment settled several). Both are UUIDs (ADR-038 D8).

Lines are the billing's stored amounts; lines excluded from the charge are left out, and a billing with no charged line is 404 rather than empty arrays (the app reduces both). Anything not the caller's is the same 404 as anything missing.

parameters.name: clearId
parameters.description: Payment **UUID** — `paymentId` on the history line (legacy `clearId`).

parameters.name: saleId
parameters.description: Billing **UUID** — `billingId` on the history line (legacy `saleId`).

200.description: Legacy PaymentDetailResponse.

400.description: Neither id, or an id that is not a UUID (E-VAL-001).

404.description: No such payment / billing for the caller, or a billing with no charged line (E-BIL-001).

get.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `GymApiClient.exportInvoice` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/members/export-invoice?clearId=&username=&companyName=`, API-150 #2) — the 発行 button of the 支払い詳細 screen.

As in legacy, nothing comes back but `{ message }`: the 領収書 PDF is rendered for the payment and **emailed to the member's registered address** (`members.email`), from 「{BRAND}会員管理」. Unlike legacy the mail is sent before answering, so a 200 means SES accepted it.

- `clearId` = the `paymentId` of a `members/billing-histories` line (UUID, ADR-038 D8). The receipt covers that whole payment: its received total and every billing it settled.
- `username` → the 宛名 (legacy required it; when blank the registered name is used).
- `companyName` → printed above the 宛名 when given (legacy required it too).

The issuer printed is 株式会社ヤマウチ (登録番号 T3470001004116) for every brand — legacy printed another company's store and number. No 12-month limit and no member-status gate, as legacy (TBD-A150-INVOICE-12MONTH / TBD-A150-MEMBER-STATUS-GATE).

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: 宛名, ≤100 chars. Default: the member's registered name.

parameters.name: clearId
parameters.description: Payment **UUID** — `paymentId` on the history line (legacy `clearId`).

400.description: clearId missing or not a UUID, or a name over 100 chars (E-VAL-001).

404.description: No settled payment with charged lines for the caller (E-BIL-001) — the same 404 for someone else's.

422.description: The member has no registered email address (E-MEM-230).

get.description: Compat path matching the shipped mobile `TrainingApiClient.getMeasurementsByOption` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/members/measurements?type=&date=`, API-131). Thin pass-through of the canonical `GET /api/v1/members/me/measurements` — same query enums, same `{ name, total, during, unit, data[] }` envelope, no mapping (§11.2 is field-for-field identical).

200.description: Field-for-field identical to the canonical `/members/me/measurements`. **`3_month` applies no window at all** and returns the whole history (TBD-A131-3MONTH-WINDOW).

put.description:
Maps `snsName`→`displayName`, `link`→`profileUrl`, `sex`→`gender`, `birthDate`→`dateOfBirth` and delegates to social-svc `UpdateOwnProfile` (the same downstream as `PATCH /api/v1/social-profiles/me`), which forwards gender/DOB to MemberService.

`profileImage` is the `avatarUrl` returned by `POST /api/v1/social-profiles/me/avatar/presigned-url` **after the client has uploaded the bytes to `presignedUrl` itself**. Send that value, never the `presignedUrl` — its signature expires in ~15 minutes and would be persisted verbatim. A full S3 URL is accepted and reduced to its object key.

Send only the fields you want changed; `""` on `bio`/`link` clears them. No file upload: this endpoint takes JSON only.

422.description: Avatar not issued by our presign endpoint (E-SNS-032) or clearing the last avatar (E-SNS-034); invalid profile URL (E-SNS-035), gender (E-SNS-036) or date of birth (E-SNS-037).

200.description: The account in the legacy `UserInfo` shape. Several fields are hardcoded null (`addressId`, `city`, `provider`, `socialId`, the `pending*` pair, `deletedAt`) — see the DTO.

patch.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `UsersApiClient` PATCH methods (`updateUserMe` / `updateMailMe` / `updatePhoneMe`), all of which PATCH `/v1/users/me`. Delegates to the same new-design `MemberService.UpdateProfile` as the canonical `PATCH /api/v1/members/me` (API-063 §4); the shared Zod schema normalises the legacy body (`sex`→gender, `birthDate` ISO→date, `address1`/`address2`→streetAddress/building, dropping `city` / `addressId` / `type`).

Send only the fields to change; at least one is required (`E-VAL-001`). Changing `email` or `phoneNumber` does **not** apply immediately — it starts a Yamauchi OTP flow and returns **202** (confirm via `POST /api/v1/users/change-email-confirm` / `change-sms-confirm`). On a plain account update the full legacy `UserInfo` (post-change) is returned; the shipped app ignores the body.

200.description: The updated account. **Only for changes that apply immediately** — an email or phone change returns 202 with a pending-change body instead.

202.description: **A different body from the 200**: the change is NOT applied yet, an OTP was sent, and `pendingField` says which field is waiting. Branch on the status before assuming you got an account object.

400.description: Body failed schema validation / no fields supplied (E-VAL-001).

403.description: Not editable for this member: Type C / vendor (E-AUTH-100), Yamauchi field on Type B (E-MEM-100), or email/phone on the App Store review account (E-MEM-206).

409.description: New email/phone already registered to a Yamauchi account (E-MEM-203 / E-MEM-204) — including the member's own: a "change" to the current email/phone is refused the same way, without contacting Yamauchi.

422.description: Non-active Type B member cannot edit (E-MEM-200).

502.description: Yamauchi User/System API timed out (E-EXT-001), or failed / refused the call in a way that is not the member's doing, e.g. the System API IP allowlist (E-EXT-002).

post.description: Compat path for the shipped mobile `UsersApiClient.sendUserEmailConfirm` (`POST /v1/users/change-email-confirm`). Second step of the email change started by `PATCH /api/v1/users/me`: submits the new email + OTP to Yamauchi (the legacy `verificationCode` field is accepted and mapped to `code`). Delegates to the same `MemberService.ConfirmEmailChange` as the canonical `POST /api/v1/members/me/confirm-email`. Returns the post-change legacy `UserInfo`.

200.description: The account with the new email applied.

401.description: OTP invalid/expired (E-AUTH-023) or bad Fitness JWT (E-AUTH-002 / E-AUTH-003).

403.description: The App Store review account cannot change its email or phone (E-MEM-206).

409.description: Email already registered to another Yamauchi account (E-MEM-203).

502.description: Yamauchi confirm unavailable or timed out (E-EXT-001 / E-EXT-002).

post.summary: Confirm a pending email change (OTP) — /v1/users/change-email-confirm alias

post.description: Compat path for the shipped mobile `UsersApiClient.sendUserSMSConfirm` (`POST /v1/users/change-sms-confirm`). Second step of the phone change started by `PATCH /api/v1/users/me`: submits the new phone (E.164) + OTP (legacy `verificationCode` → `code`). Delegates to the same `MemberService.ConfirmSmsChange` as the canonical `POST /api/v1/members/me/confirm-sms`. Returns the post-change legacy `UserInfo`.

200.description: The account with the new phone applied.

401.description: OTP invalid/expired (E-AUTH-023) or bad Fitness JWT (E-AUTH-002 / E-AUTH-003).

403.description: The App Store review account cannot change its email or phone (E-MEM-206).

409.description: Phone already registered to another Yamauchi account (E-MEM-204).

502.description: Yamauchi confirm unavailable or timed out (E-EXT-001 / E-EXT-002).

post.summary: Confirm a pending phone change (SMS OTP) — /v1/users/change-sms-confirm alias

get.description: Public compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/terms/{type}`. Resolves one terms document for the given Y-04 terms_type and optional `brand`, and returns it in the account-API `GetTermsResponse` shape the signup viewer reads. `content` is markup, because the app feeds it to `WebView.loadHtmlString`: the stored `body_text` when the document has one, otherwise a generated wrapper around the PDF.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Y-04 terms_type (e.g. `account_terms` on the signup screen).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: JOYFIT | FIT365 (defaults to brand-agnostic docs)

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Exact version; omitted, the currently-effective document is returned.

200.description: The signup-flow terms viewer shape. `content` carries the document markup; `description` is null (it is the fitness-side field of the shared DTO).

get.summary: Legacy terms fetch by type (public, signup)

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/terms`. Returns the currently-effective terms as the legacy `TermResponse[]` shape (int ids mapped from API-076 UUIDs, per-member `isAccept`/`showAgreeButton`). `type` in the response is the Y-04 terms_type (`membership`, `payment`, …). Optional `type` filters by Y-04 terms_type(s). Without `type` all 8 Y-04 types come back (including `account_terms` / `digital_ticket`).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: joyfit | fit365 (defaults to brand-agnostic docs).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Y-04 terms_type(s) to filter by, repeatable: membership | privacy | payment | suspension | withdrawal | companion | account_terms | digital_ticket.

200.description: Currently-effective terms. `brands` echoes the `brand` query — it is `[]` when none was sent, not the document’s real applicability. `parentTerm` and `startDate` are always null.

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/terms/new`. Same as `terms` but returns only documents the member still needs to consent to (`consentRequiredNow`).

200.description: The documents the member still owes consent for. **A DIFFERENT shape from `terms`**, exactly as in fitness-api: that endpoint projected onto a 9-field DTO, this one returned the raw `Terms` entity — so this carries the versioning columns (`termId`, `startDate`/`endDate`, `displayOrder`, `parentTerm`, row timestamps) and has no `isAccept`/`label`.

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `TermFitnessApiClient.getTermsByType` (`GET /v1/fitness-member/terms/{brand}/{type}`, where the app passes `type` as "brand/type" — e.g. `fit365/membership`). Returns one API-076 document as the legacy `GetTermsResponse`. `version` pins an exact revision; omitted, the currently-effective document is returned. This endpoint has no API-076 counterpart (the spec has only the list + consents), so the shape is a legacy-only projection: `description` is the viewer markup (the stored body, else generated HTML wrapping the stored PDF) and `id` is null (the legacy int id has no UUID mapping).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: joyfit | fit365

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Y-04 terms_type.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Exact version; defaults to the effective one.

200.description: A legacy-only projection with no API-076 counterpart: `content` is always null, `description` is the viewer markup (the stored body, else **generated HTML** wrapping the PDF link), and `id` is always null (the legacy int has no UUID mapping). The app reads `content ?? description`.

get.summary: Legacy terms document by brand + type

post.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/member-term/accept`. Keeps the API-076 UUID `termIds` that still map to an effective document and records consent (`source: revision_reaccept`). Ids that no longer map to an effective document are dropped.

200.description: fitness-api's bare `{message}`. **Ids that no longer map to an effective document are silently dropped**, and the message is the same either way — it does not report a count.

get.description: Compat path for the shipped app. Brand is resolved from the caller’s `members.brand_group` (the app sends none), so the tree covers the whole brand family. Response is the legacy `{ region: [{ name, prefectures: [{ name, stores: [{ id, name }] }] }] }` wrapper, unchanged.

parameters.name: isJoinging
parameters.description: Legacy param name (typo preserved). Only `true` is honoured — see TBD-A135-ISJOINING.

200.description: Area → prefecture → store tree under a singular `region` key. Area and prefecture `name`s are Japanese display names (e.g. `関東`, `東京都`), never the stored codes, and are empty strings when unset. `isJoinging` is accepted but ignored.

404.description: Caller resolves to no member record (E-MEM-001).

get.summary: Legacy store list grouped by area/prefecture (API-135 §11 compat)

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/withdrawal-recess/check`. Returns the caller's **newest** application across the two new-design tables, projected back onto the legacy single-table shape, or `{ data: null }` when they have never applied.

The legacy status is derived, not stored: an `active` 休会 reads `recessing` once its `startDate` has arrived and `processWaiting` before it. `applicableDate` is always null.

200.description: `data` is null when the member has no application at all — that is the normal answer, not an error.

get.summary: Legacy 休会/退会 status check

patch.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `PATCH /v1/fitness-member/withdrawal-recess/cancel`, which sends no body and no id. Cancels whichever of the caller's two newest applications is current and still cancellable:

• **休会** — only before the recess starts (the canonical API-152 EP3 rule; once `startDate` has arrived the member is already `suspended` → 409 E-SUS-214).
• **退会** — while the application is still `active`, i.e. the withdrawal-due batch has not completed it (→ 409 E-WDR-200). The API-152 §6B.5 family cascade filed with it is reverted in the same transaction, and the member goes back to `active`.

A member with no application at all gets 404 E-SUS-001. **This is the one place the facade diverges from fitness-api on purpose**: legacy answered a bare 400 for both "nothing to cancel" and "too late", where this uses the catalogued 404/409 the rest of the codebase uses. The success body is legacy's, verbatim.

200.description: Cancelled. The body is fitness-api's `MessageResponseDto`, verbatim — the same string for both types.

404.description: The member has never filed a 休会/退会 application (E-SUS-001).

409.description: Recess already started / already finished or cancelled (E-SUS-214), or the withdrawal is no longer cancellable (E-WDR-200).

patch.summary: Cancel the caller's latest 休会/退会 application

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/withdrawal-recess/recess` (`WithdrawalRecessApiClient.createRecessRequest`, the Recess Checkout screen). Files the canonical API-152 EP1 application, so every rule is the canonical one (member must be `active`, no application already in flight, contract owned by the caller).

**The window is legacy's, and fixed**: the 1st of next month to the last day of the month two months later (JST) — always exactly three calendar months, inside EP1's cap. Legacy never let the member choose (it ignored a `startDate` in the body) and the app sends none.

`primaryMemberContractId` → `contractId`; `description`, when sent, → `reason`; `termId` is ignored (the app records the consent through `member-term/accept`). Answers legacy's `{ message }` with 201; the app declares `Future<void>`.

201.description: Application filed. Legacy's message, verbatim.

400.description: Body failed the legacy schema, or the window failed EP1's date rules (E-VAL-001).

404.description: Contract not found or not the caller's (E-CTR-202).

409.description: Member not active (E-SUS-210) or an application already in flight (E-SUS-211).

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/withdrawal-recess/withdrawal` (`WithdrawalRecessApiClient.createWithdrawalRequest`, the Withdrawal Checkout screen). Files the canonical API-152 EP2 application, so the canonical rules hold: member `active` (E-WDR-210), no application in flight (E-WDR-211), contract owned by the caller (E-CTR-202), no outstanding arrears (E-WDR-214), and the §6B.5 family cascade.

**The date is the earliest one the plan allows**, since the app sends none: the last day of this month (JST) when the plan allows a same-month withdrawal, otherwise the last day of next month. **Nothing is charged here** — unlike the canonical route there is no immediate settlement and no 解約手数料, because the app's screen shows neither; the months the contract is still live are billed by the regular monthly run.

`primaryMemberContractId` → `contractId`; `description`, when sent, → `reason` (else a fixed placeholder — EP2 requires one); `termId` and `startDate` are ignored. Answers legacy's `{ message }` with 201; the app declares `Future<void>`.

201.description: Application filed. Legacy's message, verbatim.

404.description: Contract not found or not the caller's (E-CTR-202).

409.description: Member not active (E-WDR-210) or an application already in flight (E-WDR-211).

422.description: Outstanding arrears — pay them first (E-WDR-214).

put.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `PUT /v1/fitness-member/withdrawal-recess/recess/restore` (`WithdrawalRecessApiClient.restoreRecess`, no body, no id). The app shows it while `check` reads `recessing` and promises 「休会は今月末までとなり、来月からは通常会員に戻ります」 — which is what happens: the recess end moves to the last day of the current JST month, and the daily lifecycle batch reinstates the member (and resumes the contract) on the 1st. The status does not change now, so `check` keeps reading `recessing` with the new `endDate` until then.

**It never lengthens a recess**: one already ending this month answers 200 with nothing changed (so a second tap is harmless). This month stays a recess month for billing.

Refusals are catalogued where legacy sent a bare 400: no application (404 E-SUS-001); the newest application is a 退会, or the 休会 has not started (cancel it instead), has ended, or the member is not suspended yet (409 E-SUS-215); an HQ 一時休会 (403 E-SUS-212); the recess moved while restoring (409 E-SUS-216). The app declares `Future<void>`.

200.description: Restored (or already ending this month). fitness-api's body, verbatim: `{ "message": "RESTORED_RECESS" }`.

403.description: The running recess is an HQ temporary recess (E-SUS-212).

404.description: The member has never filed a 休会/退会 application (E-SUS-001).

409.description: No running recess to end early (E-SUS-215), or it changed meanwhile (E-SUS-216).

put.summary: Legacy 早期復帰 — end the caller's running 休会 at the end of this month

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/app-versions/info?brand=`. Returns the brand's latest effective `app_versions` row and the app maintenance window **currently in progress**, each null when absent. Unauthenticated (pre-login), as in legacy.

The canonical replacement is `GET /api/v1/mobile/app-status` (API-077 §4), which additionally computes force-update from `os` + `currentBuild`; this facade computes nothing, because the shipped client's own force-update check is a hardcoded `false` and only `maintenance` drives UI.

200.description: Both keys are independently nullable. `maintenance != null` means a window is running now.

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `MyPageApiClient.getSettingPageInfo`. Returns the eight booleans `MembersService.getSettingMember` returned and nothing else — despite the legacy summary saying 身体情報, this endpoint only ever served notification flags.

The five `allow*Notify` are reduced from the ten API-067 topics ("true while any topic in that class is opted in"). The three `approveOf*Notice` are the member's stored per-channel approvals, as legacy kept them; a member who never changed them reads `true` (the legacy column default). A notification-svc outage degrades to the legacy defaults (all `true`) rather than reporting the member as opted out of everything.

200.description: The eight legacy notification booleans.

patch.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `MyPageApiClient.updateSettingPageInfo`. Every field is optional and an omitted class leaves its topics alone, exactly as the legacy DTO behaved.

`approveOf*Notice` are **stored** per member and read back by the GET. As in legacy they gate one notification type only — N-028 広告配信停止通知 — on their own channel (push / email / SMS); every other notification ignores them. `allowAiTrainingNotify` and `allowReminderNotify` share the `training_reminder` topic, so setting them to different values is contradictory: opt-out wins.

Returns legacy's `Members-{id}を更新しました。` message.

200.description: Preferences written; legacy message returned.

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `MyPageApiClient.getListPost` (My Page) **and** `FeedsApiClient.getPersonalFeeds` (the Other People Profile screen). Returns the legacy `FeedResponseDto[]` — **a bare array, not a pagination envelope**, as fitness-api returned.

This is the **same card** `GET /feeds` serves, from the same serializer: legacy filled one `FeedResponseDto` for every screen, so comments, the liker avatars behind `profileAvatar`, the full `feedFiles` list and the `workout`/`aerobicRecord` detail are all present here too. Newest first.

• **No `targetMemberId`, or your own id** — your own posts, at every visibility (`onlyMe` included).
• **Another member's `targetMemberId`** — THEIR posts, with the visibility of `GET /api/v1/social-profiles/{memberId}/posts` (D-04): public ones, plus followers-only ones while you follow them, and **nothing across a block in either direction**. Legacy had no block check here; this path does not widen the canonical rule. This used to be ignored, so the Other People Profile screen listed the caller's own posts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Defaults to 20; capped at 50 by social-svc.

parameters.name: targetMemberId
parameters.description: Member **UUID** whose posts to list (the Other People Profile screen). Omitted, or your own id = your own posts.

200.description: That member's posts that you may see, newest first.

get.summary: Legacy posts list of one member — feeds/personal

delete.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `MyPageApiClient.deletePost`. Delegates to social-svc `DeletePost`, which enforces ownership. Returns legacy's message; the shipped client reads the status, not the body.

parameters.name: feedId
parameters.description: Post **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

200.description: Deleted.

403.description: The post is another member's (E-SNS-007).

404.description: No such post, or already deleted (E-SNS-004).

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `RoutinesApiClient.getRoutineCalendar`. One entry per day in the requested month that has something on it.

All three of legacy`s `calendarType` branches are served:
• **`routine`** (the app`s default) — days holding a training PLAN, `completed` when a session for that plan`s routine/aerobic exists on the day and `scheduled` when it does not.
• `body` — days with a body record.
• `timeline` — days whose activity timeline has a completed item.

Only the `routine` branch can answer `scheduled`; on the other two a day is present because something was recorded, which legacy always called `completed`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Any date in the target month (`YYYY-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to the current month.

parameters.name: calendarType
parameters.description: Defaults to `routine`, as in legacy.

200.description: Days with something on them, ascending.

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `TrainingApiClient.getChartTrainingData`. Sums the caller's sessions into the current week / month / year and returns **one point per slot**, value `0` where nothing falls — legacy mapped over a generated slot array rather than listing the days that had data, and a chart with gaps is a different chart.

The range is the CURRENT period, not a trailing window: `1_week` is Monday-Sunday of this ISO week even when asked on a Tuesday, `1_month` one slot per week of this month, `1_year` its twelve months. Buckets are JST.

`chartRangeType` takes legacy `DateRange` wire values - `1_week`, not the Dart member name `oneWeek`. `3_month` is refused: legacy's trainings/chart never handled it (no date filter, every record keyed `undefined`, seven zero points) and the app does not send it. As in legacy's `ChartTrainingDto`, a value outside the enum is a 400; only an absent `chartRangeType` / `category` takes the default, and `type` is required.

`type` picks what is summed: `volume` and `rep` come from training sessions, `distance` from aerobic sessions, and `duration` from whichever the `category` admits - matching legacy, where a training contributed 0 distance and an aerobic record contributed 0 volume/reps.

parameters.name: chartRangeType
parameters.description: Current period and bucket size. Optional - legacy defaulted to `1_week`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which quantity `value` carries. Required, as in legacy.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Which records are summed. Optional - legacy defaulted to `training`.

200.description: One point per slot in the range, in order.

400.description: `type` missing, or a query value not one of the legacy values (E-VAL-001).

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/verify-campaign-code`. Field-for-field identical to legacy's `CampaignIdDto` — the canonical `/api/v1/campaigns/verify` already returns exactly `{ id, campaignName, campaignCode }`, so this only repoints the path. Unknown code, store missing, or campaign not available at this store today (API-088 §19.1a: accepting, JST today within recruitment_start..recruitment_end, linked and published to the store) → 404 E-CMP-001.

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Store **UUID** (legacy int).

200.description: The campaign the code resolves to.

404.description: Unknown code, or campaign outside API-088 §19.1a at this store (E-CMP-001).

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/members/referral-code/verify`. Passes the canonical verify result straight through, including `referralCode`. An earlier version dropped that field on the belief that legacy answered only two — the shipped app declares three (`referralMemberId`, `referralCode`, `referralMemberName`) and read the dropped one as blank.

200.description: The referring member.

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/contracts/companies`. Legacy `ListCompanyResponse` is `{ id, name, type }`; the canonical DTO calls the third field `corporateType`, so it is renamed back.

Only the calling app's brand group is listed — the `x-api-key` brand, else the member JWT's `brandGroup`, else the `brandGroup` query. Legacy had one static list for both apps.

parameters.name: brandGroup
parameters.description: Used only when neither the key nor the JWT names a brand.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: The app's brand key (`F3-…` FIT365 / `JF-…` JOYFIT) — narrows the list to that brand group.

200.description: Corporates selectable at enrolment.

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/contracts/company/verify`. Legacy's `VerifyCompanyResponse` is only `{ companyId, companyCode }`, so the canonical `name` / `corporateType` / `codeVerified` are dropped.

**The code is required but not matched.** `corporates` has no code column yet (TBD-A139-CORPORATE-CODE-COLUMN) and legacy's Kiosk check is not wired, so a 200 means: the corporate exists, is active, and a code was given for types A / C (type B needs none). The canonical `codeVerified` is always `false` for that reason and is not a rejection — reading it as one made every call a 404.

corporation_no.description: Legacy field name for the corporate code (sent by the type A and C forms).

user_id_1.description: Employee no. (A) / member id (B) / symbol (C) — accepted, not checked.

user_id_3.description: Branch number (C, optional) — accepted, not checked.

confirm_code.description: Confirmation code (A) — accepted, not checked; it is not the corporate code.

200.description: The corporate, with the submitted code echoed back.

400.description: Missing corporate id (E-VAL-001), or no code for a type A / C corporate (E-CRP-002).

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/members/visits`. Maps the canonical trial-visit read onto legacy's `MemberVisitResponseDto`: `trialVisitId`→`reserveId`, `scheduledStartAt`→`startTime`, the status onto legacy's reserve vocabulary (`unsettled`/`settled`/`attendance`/`absent`/`deny`/`cancel`), `storeName` looked up per store, and `updatedAt` the row's last change. Newest booking first, as legacy.

200.description: The caller's store visits.

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/members/visit`. Maps legacy's `{storeId, startDate, startTime}` onto the canonical API-141 create — `scheduledStartAt` is that date and time read as **JST** — and answers legacy's `{message}`: **200, not 201**, as fitness-api did. The created id is not echoed; re-read `members/visits` for it.

The canonical guards apply, and legacy had none of them: an already-active member (E-VST-002), missing name / phone / email / face photo (E-VST-003), a time in the past (E-VST-004), and a second open visit to the same store that day (E-VST-005).

200.description: Registered.

400.description: Body failed the legacy schema, or `startDate` is not a calendar date (E-VAL-001).

409.description: Already an active member (E-VST-002), or a visit to this store is already booked that day (E-VST-005).

422.description: Visitor info incomplete (E-VST-003), or the time is in the past (E-VST-004).

patch.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `PATCH /v1/fitness-member/members/visits/{reserveId}` (`MembersApiClient.cancelVisitor`). Delegates to the canonical API-141 cancel and answers legacy's `{message}`.

**Only the caller's own visit, and only before it is used.** Legacy put no guard on this route — any caller could cancel any reservation id, lesson bookings included. Here another member's visit is a 404 (E-VST-001, existence not disclosed), and one already cancelled, rejected or entered is a 409 (E-VST-002).

parameters.name: reserveId
parameters.description: The `reserveId` from `members/visits` — the trial-visit UUID (legacy int).

200.description: Cancelled.

404.description: No such visit for this member (E-VST-001).

409.description: The visit can no longer be cancelled (E-VST-002).

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/members/visit/active`: the QR the visitor screen shows for a booked store visit. Answers legacy's `MyQrCodeResponse` `{ qrCode }`, **200, not 201**.

Issued under legacy's rule: the caller's own visit, whose start time has passed by less than 7 days. Unlike legacy, a cancelled or rejected visit gets none.

**The QR does not open the gate** — neither did legacy's. Gate entry for a trial visitor is undecided (`TBD-A141-QR-FACADE`); until then the payload is an opaque placeholder.

200.description: A fresh QR string on every call.

404.description: No such visit for this member (E-VST-001, existence not disclosed).

409.description: The visit has not started yet, started 7 days ago or more, or was cancelled / rejected (E-VST-002).

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/members/form-update-card` (`MemberProcedureApiClient.getHTMLUpdateCardPage`) — the update-card screen fetches the page it loads into its payment WebView from here, and renders blank without it. Legacy answered `{html}` with its SBPS token template; this answers the same key with the v2 **`mint`** page, the one `GET /api/v1/members/me/cards/form?mode=mint` serves raw and the new-card screen already loads.

The page only tokenises the card, then posts `{token, tokenKey, tds3Token, tds3TokenKey, saveCard}` to the `messageHandler` channel — the payload legacy's update-card template posted — so the rest of the screen is the canonical API-147 flow, unchanged: 3ds-requests → 3DS → 3ds-results → `POST /members/me/cards`, which retires the member's previous card.

**201**, as legacy (no `@HttpCode`).

201.description: The card-entry page.

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/lockers/lockers-slot?lockerId`. Re-encodes the canonical slot (API-136) into legacy's `LockersSlotResponse` types, per API-136 §11 — the app parses these with `as num?` / `as String?`, so a canonical type passed through is a Dart TypeError that fails the whole list, not one blank cell:

• `code` — **number**, `Number(slotCode)` (so `"012"` → `12`); null when the code is not all digits.
• `status` — **number**: `1` in use, `2` available, `3` cleaning (§11.3). `2` also needs a fee option on the slot, as in legacy (`isAvailable && optionId`): an unpriced slot cannot be contracted.
• `lockerSlotSize` — **object** `{ widthCm, heightCm, depthCm }` in cm, the shape the app decodes (it used to be the §11.4 string `"w30xh40xd45"`, which the app cannot read); null when the slot has no size.
• `fee` — **tax-inclusive**, like legacy `options.fee` (「料金(税込)」), which the app reads as `priceAfterTax`. `fee` / `taxRate` are `0` on an unpriced slot, as in legacy.

`pinCode` is always null — the canonical member read does not expose it (the PIN reaches the member through the contract endpoints).

**`storeId` is no longer required** (fixed 2026-09-15). It used to be, on the grounds that the canonical route is store-keyed — but legacy took only `lockerId`, and so does the shipped app (`GetListLockerSlotRequest` carries that one field), so every call the app could make answered `400 E-VAL-001`. The store is now derived from the cabinet (`lockers.store_id`). Send either parameter, or both; `lockerId` alone is the legacy call. A `lockerId` that names an unknown, inactive or deleted cabinet answers `[]`, the same as a known cabinet with no visible slots.

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Store UUID. Omit when `lockerId` is given — the store is derived from the cabinet.

parameters.name: lockerId
parameters.description: Cabinet UUID. The legacy call sends only this.

200.description: Slots, optionally filtered to one locker unit.

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/member-join-flow`. Legacy declared `Promise<void>` and answered **200 with no body**, so that is what this returns — the canonical `POST /api/v1/members/me/enrollment` receipt (`applicationId`, `status`, `nextStep`, …) is deliberately not echoed, because the legacy client is not built to read it. Use the canonical route when you want the receipt.

The body is **mapped** onto the canonical one per API-153 §11.2 (`contractId`→`planId`, `campaignDetailIds[0]`→`campaignId`, `optionIds`/`optionSetDetailIds`/`locker`→`selectedOptionIds[]`, `joiningFeeIds` dropped), `paymentMethod` is fixed to `sbps_credit`, `parentId`/`introducerId` are resolved to the matching `promotionCode`, and the initial charge is computed server-side (FR-M006). It is NOT forwarded verbatim.

200.description: Submitted. **No body**, as in legacy.

400.description: Body failed the legacy join-flow schema (E-VAL-001).

404.description: `parentId` / `introducerId` names a member holding no such code (E-PRM-001).

422.description: The canonical enrolment refused it: usage date (E-ENR-004), already enrolled (E-ENR-013), incomplete PII (E-ENR-001), no card on file (E-CARD-005), bad refs (E-PLN-005 / E-OPT-001).

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/plan?storeId`. Projects the canonical plan read onto legacy's 15-field `ListPlanResponse`: `cancellation_fee_months` becomes `addMonthForRetiring` (same quantity, v2 name), `isCurrent` is derived by comparing each plan against the caller's active contract, and `securityFee` / `limitOfSex` are null (see the DTO). The canonical extras (`campaign`, `vitality`, the two description fields) are dropped — legacy never sent them. Filtering follows legacy `listContractByStore`: `name` is the contract type (`general` = v2 `general` + `family`, since legacy family plans were `general` plans flagged `family=true`), and `memberId` (the family-code owner) narrows to the store's family plans.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Contract type (legacy `planDto.name`). `general` lists v2 `general` + `family`; `groupDiscount` / `vitality` / `flex` have no v2 type and apply no filter.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: Family lane: the family-code owner (`familyMemberId` from the family-code verify). Lists the store's family plans; `name` is ignored.

200.description: Plans selectable at the store, brand-filtered to the store brand (API-084 ★v0.6 d3). `originalPrice` is **tax-inclusive**: legacy `contracts.fee` was 「料金(税込)」 and the app reads it as `priceAfterTax`; the v2 master is 税込 too (API-087 v0.14), passed through.

get.summary: Legacy plan list for a store

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/option-stores/options?storeId`. Projects the canonical option read onto legacy's 21-field `ListOptionByStoreResponse`; `paymentType`, `feeDuringRecess` and `limitOfSex` are null (see the DTO), and the canonical extras (`categoryName`, `tieInOptions`, `descriptionForMember`) are dropped.

200.description: Options selectable at the store, brand-filtered to the store brand (API-084 ★v0.6 d3). `originalFee` is **tax-inclusive** (legacy `options.fee` was 「料金(税込)」); `taxRate` is the row's own rate.

get.summary: Legacy option list for a store

get.description: Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/sales/estimate-joining-fee`. Field-for-field identical to legacy's `EstimateJoiningFeeResultDto`, as the canonical route returns it: tax-inclusive lines, the plan one line per prepaid month, negative discounts, `totalAmount` = their sum.

parameters.name: contractId
parameters.description: Plan **UUID** (legacy int).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Usage start; defaults to today.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: Family lane: the family-code owner (`familyMemberId` from the family-code verify), as on the plan list. The child joins fee-free.

200.description: { contracts, options, optionSetDetails, joiningFees, campaignDetails, totalAmount }.

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/body-information`. v2 split what legacy kept in one row across TWO tables — body composition (`body_records`) and circumferences (`body_measurements`) — so this reads both for the requested day and merges them, renaming the `*Cm` / `*Kg` suffixes back to the legacy names.

`condition` / `note` come from a THIRD table — the API-030 condition record for the day, which is where the upsert below writes them. Two legacy fields stay constants with the reason stated in the DTO: `evaluations` (legacy scored each measurement against a standard) and `images` (body-scan gallery).

`hasBodyPlaner` is legacy's `getOptionsIsBoughtByName([member], [体組成計], any store, stillActive = false)`: has the member EVER held a Body Planner option (`options.subcategory = body_planner`). The Body Data tab opens the receipt scanner (`body-information/scan-qr`) only when it is true and offers to sell the option otherwise — a constant false sent every holder to the shop. A contracts-svc failure reads as false.

A day with no record at all is a 200 with every field null, not a 404 — legacy answered the same way, and the screen renders an empty state from it.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Target day (`YYYY-MM-DD`). Defaults to today (JST).

200.description: The merged body record for the day.

get.summary: Legacy body information for a day

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/body-information/upsert` — the one legacy write that v2 split in two: `POST /members/me/body-records` (composition) and `POST /members/me/body-measurements` (circumferences). This takes the single legacy body, fans it out to both, and answers in the legacy `BodyInformations` **entity** shape.

**The response is NOT `GET /body-information`'s.** Legacy returned the saved row straight out of `upsert`, so it carries `memberId` / `createdAt` / `updatedAt` and has no `evaluations` or `hasBodyPlaner` — those two are assembled only on the read path.

**Merge, not replace.** Legacy wrote field-by-field onto the day's row and left the rest alone; v2's same-day overwrite replaces the whole row. So the facade reads the day first and carries over what the body omits. A field sent as an explicit `null` still clears — absent and null are different here, exactly as they were in legacy.

**`0` means empty.** The app sends `0` for a measurement the member left blank, so a `0` in `height` / `weight` / `bodyFatPercentage` / `muscleMass` or a circumference is read as `null` (cleared; for `height`, left alone) instead of failing the save.

**What a manual save cannot keep (BR-BOD-003).** `source` is `manual`, which accepts only weight, body-fat % and skeletal muscle. `bmi` is accepted and then re-derived server-side from weight ÷ height²; `basalMetabolism` and the six other Body-Planner-only fields are accepted and dropped. If the Body Planner already wrote that day, a manual save clears them — the same thing the canonical `POST /body-records` does on an overwrite.

**Which tables are touched** depends on what the body carries: the composition row only when a composition field (or `height`) is present, the measurement session only when a circumference is, and the API-030 condition record only when `condition` or `note` is. A note that arrives without a condition keeps the day's condition, or defaults to `normal` — legacy's NOT NULL column default.

**Ordering.** The condition write goes first: API-030 refuses a future day or one more than 90 days back (legacy took any date), so a rejection leaves the day untouched instead of half-saved. The two body writes are not transactional with each other.

`height` is a **profile** value in v2 (APP-B-01 FR-M005), not a column on the row: sending it overwrites `fitnessProfile.heightCm`, and sending null leaves it alone rather than clearing it. `images` is accepted nowhere — v2 has no body-record image store.

200.description: The day after the save, in the legacy entity shape (34 keys).

400.description: Body failed schema validation, or the condition date is outside the API-030 window (E-VAL-001).

422.description: Member type not eligible for body records / measurements / condition records (E-BDY-101 / E-BDY-111 / E-BDY-140).

post.summary: Upsert body information for a day (legacy)

patch.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `PATCH /v1/fitness-member/body-information/{id}`. The shipped app uses it for exactly one thing: the 体調 chip on the Body Data tab, which sends `{condition}` alone against the id the sibling `GET /body-information` returned.

**The id is the addressing, not decoration.** The PATCH body carries no date — legacy took the day from the row it was updating, so the facade reads the record, derives its JST day and writes that day. Resolving the id is also the ownership check: a record that does not exist, or belongs to another member, is `E-BDY-002`.

From there it is the same three-table fan-out as `POST body-information/upsert` — `body_records`, `body_measurements` and the API-030 condition record — with the same field-level merge, the same `manual`-source limits and the same condition-first ordering. Read that endpoint for the detail; every deviation it documents applies here too.

The answer is legacy's fixed `{message}` string. `createdAt` is accepted only when it names the record's own day: moving a record to another day would mean deleting and re-creating rows in three tables with no transaction across them, so a different day is a 400 rather than a silent no-op. No client sends it.

parameters.name: bodyInformationId
parameters.description: Body-record **UUID** (legacy int) — the `id` from `GET /body-information`. Unlike before, it is read rather than ignored: it is what says which day to write.

200.description: Legacy's fixed success message.

400.description: Body failed validation, `createdAt` named another day, or the condition date is outside the API-030 window (E-VAL-001).

404.description: No body record with that id belongs to the caller (E-BDY-002). Legacy answered 422 here; the app treats both the same.

422.description: Member type not eligible for body records / measurements / condition records (E-BDY-101 / E-BDY-111 / E-BDY-140).

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/app-training-settings`. v2 split legacy's one `app_training_settings` table in two — behaviour on `member_training_settings` (API-018) and timer chrome on `member_timer_settings` (API-019) — so this reads BOTH and merges them back into legacy's single 15-field shape. Legacy's `mapToResponse` returned exactly those 15, so `id` / `memberId` / `routineId` / `isExpertMode` / timestamps are not part of the contract and are not invented here.

Three fields are not a straight rename — `breakTimeDefault` (one seconds figure vs v2's minutes/seconds pair), `volume` (v2 `volumePercent`, different app-initial value) and `displayTimer` (v2 `displayMode` under a different vocabulary). The DTO states each one.

**Lazy, and it stays lazy.** Legacy INSERTed a default row on first read; API-018/019 return app-initial values without writing. Nothing observable differs — the same values come back either way, and the first PATCH creates the row.

**Type C is a 403 here where legacy answered 200.** That is API-018 §認可 and API-019 §認可 as written (`Type A / B のみ。Type C → 403 E-AUTH-100`), so it is a spec rule and not the copied gate that was removed from the daily-activities read. Flagged rather than worked around: a pre-enrolment member opening the settings screen sees an error.

200.description: The member's settings in the legacy 15-field shape.

403.description: Type C / out-of-scope member (E-AUTH-100).

patch.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `PATCH /v1/fitness-member/app-training-settings`. The legacy body mixes both halves of the split, so the facade **fans it out**: `alarmSound`, `volume`, `displayTimer` and `vibration` go to API-019's timer settings, the other eleven to API-018's training settings. A half the body does not touch is not called at all, so a partial body cannot reset the other half.

Both v2 updates already merge field-by-field over what is stored, which is what legacy's `repository.merge` did — so a partial body behaves the same. Answers with the legacy `{message}` instead of the updated row.

The two writes are **not** transactional with each other: a body spanning both halves that fails on the second leaves the first applied. Legacy had one table and one save, so this is a real difference — it is accepted rather than papered over because the alternative (write nothing until both validate) still cannot roll back a committed first write, and every value here is an independent UI preference rather than part of one invariant.

200.description: Legacy success message.

400.description: Body failed validation, or a value is outside the v2 range legacy did not bound (E-VAL-001).

403.description: Type C / out-of-scope member (E-AUTH-100).

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `GET /v1/fitness-member/exercises/get-category`. The create-exercise screen calls it three times, once per `type`, to fill its pickers.

`image` is **always null** — so was legacy's, which returned a literal `{name, image: null}` for every row. The swagger diff flagged `image` as a field v2 does not return, but there is no image to source: legacy hard-coded the null.

`name` is the CODE, matching legacy's raw enum values. Two axes come from the master tables API-129 built to replace them (`mst_exercise_categories`, `mst_muscles`); `equipment` comes from the TOOL code list, because `mst_tools` belongs to the equipment service with no read reachable from training-svc — the same kind of fixed code list legacy itself served.

**The code SETS differ from legacy's**, and that is master data rather than contract: legacy listed 5 categories / 27 muscles / 30 tools after exclusions, v2 seeds fewer. A picker option the member had before can therefore be missing. Worth a seed pass, not a code change here.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which axis to list. Required, as in legacy.

200.description: The axis, in master order.

400.description: `type` missing or not one of the legacy values (E-VAL-001).

get.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `FeedsApiClient.getExercisesRanking`. The five exercises that the most distinct members in one age band did, optionally narrowed by sex.

**"By week" means the LAST COMPLETED week, not the current one.** Legacy's materialised view windowed on `DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) - 7 days … DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW())`; the boundary is Monday midnight JST here. That is also why this is not `GET /api/v1/training-stats/rankings`, which ranks by **day**, splits strength from cardio, and has no demographic axis.

`age` is a bucket floor (10/20/30/40/50/60, where 60 means 60-and-above); omit it and the caller's own age is bucketed, falling back to 20 when no birth date is on file. `sex` takes every value a member's gender can hold — the app's filter sheet offers all four; legacy's `SexEnum` had only male/female — and omitted (or unknown) it ranks all genders together. Both are echoed in the response, because the caller usually sends neither.

⚠️ **An empty `exercises` array is a correct answer, not a missing feature.** BR-SOC-024 hides any exercise fewer than five distinct members did — legacy published raw counts — so on a small or early population most weeks legitimately rank nothing.

`rank` is **0-based** (legacy emitted `rank: index`).

parameters.name: age
