post.description:
Compat path matching the shipped mobile `PointApiClient.usePointInternal` (`POST /v1/fitness-member/point/use`), the 交換する button of the point-exchange screen. **No canonical counterpart**: `POST /api/v1/points/transactions` is system/HQ-only.

As in legacy: the balance drops now (1 point = 1 yen 税込), and the points are deducted from the chosen line on **next month's** bill — BAT-006 on the 2nd puts every use of the previous JST month on the bill as a negative line against that plan / option line. Unlike legacy, a part the bill cannot absorb (the line is not on that month's bill, or is smaller than the points used) is given back to the balance by BAT-006 instead of being lost.

**Refused while next month is a recess month** (E-RWD-007): a use whose month bills the recess fee is voided by BAT-006 — never taken off the recess fee, never given back — so it is not taken in the first place. "Recess month" = the member has an open suspension that leaves the contract suspended on that month's billing day (the 2nd).

`scopeId` must be the `memberContractId` of one entry of `GET plan-options/me` (the caller's current plan line or a monthly option line) — legacy took any id with the member id from the body; here the member is the JWT subject and `memberId` is ignored. `usePoint` is capped at that entry's `fee` and at the balance, the two caps the app itself applies. Each call is a new use (no idempotency key in the legacy contract).

200.description: Spent. The app declares `Future<void>`; the body is informational.

400.description: `usePoint` not a positive integer, or `scopeId` not a UUID (E-VAL-001).

403.description: Member type not eligible for points — Type C (E-AUTH-100).

404.description: No current contract (E-CTR-202), or `scopeId` is not one of its lines (E-OPT-004).

422.description: More than the line's `fee` (E-RWD-002), more than the balance (E-RWD-003), or next month is a recess month (E-RWD-007).

A hyphen in the code is ignored. Anything that is not 7 digits after that matches nothing and answers `[]`, as legacy did — only a missing or empty `postalCode` is a 400. Requires a login but no membership (the lookup runs during sign-up).

Serves the active `enrollment` questionnaire of API-133 in legacy's `MemberListSurveyResponseDto` list: `questionId`→`id`, `text`→`context`, `displayOrder`→`displayRank`, `multipleAnswers` = `format === "multiple_choice"`, and each choice under the same four names.

The questionnaire must cover the store's sub-brand (or be brand-agnostic); without `storeId`, any sub-brand of the member's brand group.

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/answer` (`MemberProcedureApiClient.submitAnswer`). Maps legacy's `{storeId, answers: [{questionId, answerIds}]}` onto the API-133 submit — `answerIds` become `choiceIds`, and the `questionnaireId` the legacy body never carried is looked up — and answers legacy's `{message}` with **201**, as fitness-api did.

An entry with no `answerIds` means "not answered" and is dropped, as legacy did; a body with nothing answered is acknowledged without storing anything, as legacy stored nothing for it. A member who already answered gets the same acknowledgement — the first answer stands.

201.description: Answered (or already answered).

400.description: Body failed the legacy schema — ids must be UUIDs (E-VAL-001).

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/connected-devices/authenticate-and-control` (`ConnectedDevicesApiClient.authenticateControlDevice`). The app parses the sticker `…/unlock?major=<storeCode>&minor=<qrId>`; the store is found by its club code (`stores.club_code`), the device by `connected_devices.qr_id` within it (set in the CRM device ledger, API-103).

**Entry / exit gate** → the API-108 judgment for the member of the token (check-in at an entry gate, check-out at an exit gate, the 5-guard chain, the audit row, the unlock), answered `type: entry` with the gate's display message.

**Option device** (hydrogen water, tanning, body composition, protein, other) → fitness-api's sequence on v2 data: a main contract, inside the store (「入館していません。」), the API-103 §7.8 usage-control rule (main-contract axis OR service-type axis — a live monthly option or an unused per-use ticket; no axis set = nobody), no family member inside, then `SON{outputPort}`; a per-use ticket that granted the start is used up. Holding nothing answers 「これらのオプションを購入する必要があります。」 with the store's `optionIds` + `storeId`, and the app offers the ticket shop.

Every option-device attempt writes one `connected_device_usage_logs` row (`equipment` / `use`) — the rows the CRM オプション利用履歴 card and the app Timeline read.

**201** on success, **400** with the same body (+ `statusCode`) on every refusal, as legacy.

201.description: The device started (or the gate opened).

400.description: A refusal, in the legacy body — `success: false` plus `statusCode: 400` (unknown store / device, no main contract, not inside, not entitled, family inside, device error). A body that fails validation is the usual E-VAL-001 envelope instead.

post.summary: Start a device from its QR sticker (legacy Scan QR, STT 125)

post.description:
Compat endpoint matching the mobile `POST /v1/fitness-member/body-information/scan-qr` (`BodyInformationApiClient.scanBodyInformation`) — the Body Data tab's 「レシートを読み込む」 and the Scan page, for a QR starting `DF870`.

**Gate (fitness-api `getOptionsIsBoughtByName(…, storeId, stillActive = false)`)**: the member must have bought a Body Planner option (`options.subcategory = body_planner`) registered at `storeId` — at any time, used or not: the ticket is spent starting the machine, before the receipt is scanned. Otherwise 400 「これらのオプションを購入する必要があります。」 with the store's `optionIds` + `storeId` (the app offers the ticket shop), or 「ボディプランナーのオプションが見つかりません」 when the store sells none.

**Write**: the eleven analyser values become one `body_planner` body record (API-024; lean mass derived per BR-BOD-061) overwriting that day's — the day printed on the receipt (`SY`/`SM`/`SD`), as legacy filed it, so a receipt scanned later still lands on its own day; a date that is today, in the future or missing is now. The app then opens that day's Body Data summary.

Not legacy: a missing or non-numeric value is null (legacy wrote 0), and a receipt with no weight is refused as 「QRコードが読み取れません。」 rather than saved as a 0 kg reading. Body records are Type A/B only (E-BDY-101), which legacy did not check.

**200** on success, **400** with the legacy body (+ `statusCode`, and `code` when it is a catalogue refusal) otherwise.

200.description: `message` = 「BodyInformation ID:{id}を作成しました」, `connectedDeviceName` = the Body Planner option's name.

400.description: A refusal, in the legacy body (see above). A body that fails validation is the usual E-VAL-001 envelope instead.

Compat path matching the shipped mobile `InquiriesApiClient.createInquiry` (`POST /v1/fitness-member/inquiries`). Stores the inquiry (an API-143 row filed under the category folded from `type`, plus the store and the contact email / phone / method the member typed), mails the support mailbox (`INQUIRY_REPORT_EMAIL_TO`; not sent when unset) and the member (to the typed `email`), as fitness-api did, and answers legacy's `{message, inquiryCode}`.

`inquiryCode` is legacy's 受付番号 shape — the type's letter A–G + 8 characters. The app shows it on the completion screen and does not open that screen without it.

201.description: Received. The mails are best-effort and never fail the submit.

400.description: Body failed validation, or `storeId` is not a store (E-VAL-001, details[]).

post.description: Compat path matching the shipped mobile `PayUnpaidApiClient.payUnpaid` (`POST /v1/fitness-member/sbps-link/request`, `Future<HttpResponse<String>>`). Answers an **HTML page** for the app's WebView: the amount of the selected bills (税込) and a 「お支払いに進む」 button. **Nothing is charged here** — pressing the button charges the registered card (API-148) and sends the WebView (303) to a **fixed** URL on this backend: `{API}/api/v1/fitness-member/sbps-link/done/ok` when every selected bill is paid, otherwise `{API}/api/v1/fitness-member/sbps-link/done/ng`. The app watches for those two URLs; it sends no return URL (the legacy `ok_return_url` / `ng_return_url` fields are accepted and ignored). The page is payable once, for 15 minutes.

isPositionAssigned.description:
`false` when the staff has **no 職位 yet** and sits on the role's `未割当` position (API-070 §3.5.5) — the state an invitation with no `positionId` creates, and the one `PATCH /admin/staff/{id}` with `positionId: null` returns them to.

**It does NOT mean "the role's basic permissions".** 未割当 is deny-by-default: every entry in `permissions` below is `false`, so the CRM should render 「職位が未割当です」 rather than an empty screen with no explanation. Note the two layers disagree on purpose — `role` still admits the staff to role-gated endpoints, but every permission-flag-gated action is denied until a 職位 is assigned.

Detect it with this field, not by comparing `positionName` to `未割当` — the name is display text and may be renamed; the flag is computed from the reserved id block.

nameKana.description: Kana name. API-069 §10 excludes it from this endpoint deliberately — do not build on it.

storeCode.description: Home store code (`stores.code`) for the header (D-01 「所属店舗」). Null for pattern B / no store, or when the store directory is unreachable.

storeName.description: Home store name (`stores.name`) for the header — the only store-name source for trainer / observer (the store master is 403 for them). Null for pattern B / no store, or when the store directory is unreachable.

storeIds.description: Every store the staff works in: the 所属店舗 (multi-select for every role since Dev Q&A 2026-11-07, no primary store), `storeId` first, then — for FC-company staff — every store of the FC company, closed ones included. It is the set the BE scopes store-scoped screens by for manager / staff / observer. system / headquarter are not limited to it. A **trainer** gets its 所属店舗 only, never the FC company's stores (the BE scopes a trainer by its own stores and assigned schedules). If the FC company's stores cannot be read, only the 所属店舗 are listed.

stores.description: The same stores as `storeIds`, same order, with the fields the header and the CRM store pickers read.

fcCompanyId.description: FC company (Pattern B). Null unless FC-scoped.

position.description: Superseded by the flat `positionId` / `positionName`; kept for clients that already bind it.

permissions.description: All 58 permission flags of the staff's position, read fresh per call so a mid-session position change shows on the next fetch. **Keys are `permissionKey` (snake_case)** — the identical set `GET /api/v1/admin/permissions` returns, per API-069 §10 / API-082 §12.1. Gate routes and actions on this: `role` alone cannot decide most operations. NOTE: before 2026-08-30 this map was keyed by the camelCase column names (`canViewMember`), which did not match the catalog — a guard looking up `can_view_member` silently got `undefined` and denied.

email.description: The staff email to mail a one-time sign-in link to.

accepted.description: Always true — the endpoint never discloses whether the email matched a staff record.

token.description: One-time token from the sign-in link (43-char base64url).

authProvider.description: google | cognito — drives the CRM login UI

staffName.description: Staff display name (snapshot at invitation time)

idToken.description: Provider-issued ID token (Google / Apple / LINE), independently verified before proxying to Yamauchi.

lastName.description: Apple-only: family name, returned by Apple only on the first authorization. Ignored for Google / LINE.

refreshToken.description: Fitness refresh token used to rotate the session.

token.description: Single-use magic link token from the MobileApp deep link (non-empty).

email.description: Staff email (RFC 5322). Used with the auto-detected auth provider for the duplicate check (E-STF-002).

positionId.description: Position master ID. OMIT to leave the staff unassigned — the role's 未割当 position is applied and the staff can log in with no permissions until a Manager assigns a real one. When given, its role must equal `role`.

storeIds.description: Pattern A — the staff's stores (所属店舗, multi-select for every role, managers included; Dev Q&A 2026-11-07). The staff works in each store with what its role allows; there is no separate primary store. The FIRST id is returned as `storeId` and decides the brand of the staff's member record. Duplicates are folded. Every id must be an existing store → `E-VAL-001` with `details[{ field: "storeIds.<i>", code: "not_found" }]` otherwise. Exactly one of `storeIds` (or `storeId`) / `fcCompanyId`.

storeId.description: Pattern A, one store — shorthand for `storeIds: [storeId]`, kept for clients written before `storeIds`. Send `storeIds` or `storeId`, not both (`E-VAL-001`).

fcCompanyId.description: Pattern B — FC company affiliation (every store of the company). Provide exactly one of `storeIds` (or `storeId`) / `fcCompanyId` (XOR).

lastName.description: Staff last name.

memo.example: 2026年4月 新店オープン要員
memo.description: CRM operational notes (Y-01 FR-002 備考) → `staffs.memo`.

staffId.description: Newly created staff record ID.

staff.description: Invitation rows. Emails must be unique within the request.

role.description: CRM role — applies to every row.

positionId.description: Position — applies to every row. Omit for the role's 未割当 position.

storeId.description: Pattern A, one store — shorthand for `storeIds: [storeId]`. Send one or the other.

fcCompanyId.description: Pattern B affiliation — applies to every row. XOR with `storeIds` / `storeId`.

memo.description: Notes written to every created staff row.

status.description: Row outcome. The endpoint is all-or-nothing, so a 200 carries only `ok` rows and a rejection carries only `failed` ones.

staffId.description: Created staff ID.

authProvider.description: Auth provider resolved per row — a batch may mix google and cognito.

errorCode.description: Why THIS row was rejected — `null` on success, and `null` on the other rows of a failed batch. The endpoint is all-or-nothing, so a rejection marks exactly one row with a code and leaves the rest `failed` / `null`: that is how the CRM knows which address to highlight in a 50-row form.

ok.description: Rows created. `0` on a rejection — nothing is created unless everything is.

failed.description: Rows not created. Equals the whole batch size on a rejection.

deactivatedReason.description: 無効化理由. Optional (API-070 v0.14 §6.2) — omitted, `null`, `""` or whitespace-only is stored as `null`. A reason is trimmed and must be 1–500 characters. Stored on the staff row and returned by the list and detail endpoints.

staffId.description: Updated staff record ID.

isActive.description: Current active state after the update.

email.description: ★v0.10 §6.3 — the staff's current login address after the call (every 200: edit, no-op, deactivate, reactivate).

idpSync.description: Deactivate / reactivate only — whether the sign-in account followed the CRM row. `ok`: the Cognito account was disabled / re-enabled. `failed`: the CRM change IS saved, but the Cognito account did not follow — after a reactivation the staff still cannot sign in with a password (nor receive a password-reset mail) until reactivate is called again, which retries the re-enable. `skipped`: Google-route staff, whose Workspace account is not managed from here. Absent for a plain field edit.

reinvite.description: Email change of a staff who has not signed in yet (招待中) only — the old invitation link is revoked and a new invitation is sent to the new address after the change is saved (the same as `POST /admin/staff/{id}/reinvite`; do not call it again). `sent`: new link + temporary password mailed. `failed`: the email change IS saved but no new invitation went out — the staff stays 招待中; re-send with 「再招待」 on the list / detail. `skipped`: the staff is deactivated, so no invitation is sent — reactivate first, then 「再招待」. Absent for every other PATCH.

sessionId.description: The Redis session id. Matches `sessionId` on the login-history row that created it, which is how the ログイン履歴 tab marks 現在のセッション.

createdAt.description: When the session was opened (the session's own stamp).

lastSeenAt.description: The panel's 最終アクティブ — when this terminal last made a CRM request, stamped by the BFF guard and refreshed at most once a minute (so it can trail real activity by up to 60s). `null` only for a session opened before this was recorded.

expiresAt.description: Derived from the key's remaining TTL, not stored — so it stays correct after a token refresh re-arms it. `null` when the key carries no expiry.

loggedInAt.description: The login-history row that opened this session. `null` if that row is gone (retention) — the session is still live.

ipAddress.description: Joined from the opening login row; `null` for sessions opened before that row started capturing it.

userAgent.description: Raw User-Agent of the browser that signed in — render the device / browser label from this.

isCurrent.description: `true` when this is the CALLER's own session, i.e. the panel's 現在のセッション. Computed at the edge by comparing against the caller's JWT `sessionId`; force-logging-out your own session is allowed but signs you out.

sessions.description: Every terminal the staff currently holds, newest first — 0 to `maxConcurrent` of them. Empty when nobody is signed in (never signed in, logged out, TTL lapsed, evicted by a newer login, or deactivated).

session.description: DEPRECATED — the newest entry of `sessions`, or `null` when there are none. Present only so the pre-multi-session response shape keeps resolving; read `sessions` instead.

maxConcurrent.description: How many terminals one staff may hold at once, as enforced by auth-svc (`CRM_MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS`). Served rather than hard-coded so the panel footer 「同時ログインは最大3デバイスまで」 cannot drift from the limit actually applied.

sessionId.description: The single terminal to end — the panel's per-row 強制終了 button. Omit (or send no body) to end EVERY session the staff holds, which is the pre-multi-session behaviour and the right answer for a lost account.

authProvider.description: Provider resolved from the email domain via the domain master; null when the domain is not registered.

available.description: Advisory only — the authoritative check is the unique constraint at invite time.

reason.description: null when available. `domain_not_registered` / `domain_inactive`: the domain cannot be invited at (API-071). `email_too_long` (v0.15): the domain resolves to `cognito` and the address is over 128 characters (§3.5.6). `duplicate`: a non-deleted staff holds this (authProvider, email).

isActive.description: `false` deactivates (optional `deactivatedReason`); `true` REACTIVATES a deactivated staff, and is idempotent when they are already active. Send it ALONE (only `deactivatedReason` may go with `false`): any other field in the same body → `E-VAL-001` (400). Before, the other fields were silently dropped.

deactivatedReason.description: 無効化理由. Optional (API-070 v0.14 §6.2). With `isActive: false`: trimmed, 1–500 characters; omitted, `null`, `""` or whitespace-only is stored as `null`. A non-blank reason on any other request → `E-VAL-001`; a blank one is ignored.

email.description: ★v0.10 §6.5.3 — new login address (cognito-route staff only). Send it ONLY when the operator changed it: the same address (case-insensitive) is a no-op for the email part, other fields still apply. Checked in this order: google-route staff → `E-STF-016` (422); bad format, over 254, or over 128 characters (new or current address, Cognito limit) → `E-VAL-001` (400, `details[].code = too_long | invalid_format`); domain not registered / inactive → `E-DMN-006` (422); domain on the other route → `E-STF-016` (422); held by another staff → `E-STF-002` (409). Cognito is updated before the DB: a Cognito failure → `E-STF-005` (502, nothing saved, safe to retry). The linked member's email follows; a staff who has not completed the first login loses the pending invitation link — re-invite to send one to the new address.

role.description: Y-01 Bug-No19 — new CRM role (FR-005, **HQ only**; a manager sending it → `E-AUTH-103`). Without a `positionId` (or with `null`) the staff gets the new role's 未割当 position (all permissions off, still able to sign in) and a `role_change` history row. With a `positionId`, that position must belong to this role → otherwise `E-VAL-001` (an unknown id is `E-STF-009` first). Sending the staff's current role with no `positionId` keeps the current position.

positionId.description:
New position master ID (UUID). A position of another role **changes the role** (FR-005, HQ only; `role_change`). Unknown id → `E-STF-009`.

`null` **un-assigns**: the staff is parked on the role's 未割当 position (all permissions off, still able to sign in), which is what §3.5.5 assigns when an invitation carries no `positionId`. It is not a NULL column — `position_id` is NOT NULL and the JWT role claim resolves through it — and the sentinel ids are not listable via `GET /admin/positions`, so the server picks the right one for you.

storeIds.description: The staff's stores (所属店舗) — **full replace**; omit to leave them unchanged. `[]` or `null` removes them all, which is how a staff moves to an FC company (send `fcCompanyId` in the same request). The first id becomes `storeId`. Exactly one of stores / `fcCompanyId` must remain AFTER the patch (`E-VAL-001`). Each id must be an existing store → `E-VAL-001` with `details[{ field: "storeIds.<i>", code: "not_found" }]`. History: one `store_unassign` per store removed, one `store_assign` per store added. HQ only (a manager → `E-AUTH-103`).

storeId.description: One-store shorthand for `storeIds`: a value = `[value]`, `null` = `[]` (kept for clients written before `storeIds`). Send `storeIds` or `storeId`, not both. Unknown store → `E-VAL-001` with `details[{ field: "storeId", code: "not_found" }]`.

fcCompanyId.description: FC company affiliation (UUID); `null` clears it. See `storeIds` for the XOR rule. Must reference an existing (not deleted) FC company — `E-VAL-001` with `details[{ field: "fcCompanyId", code: "not_found" }]` otherwise.

managedStoreIds.description: A **manager**'s store scope; `[]` for every other role. Since Dev Q&A 2026-11-07 a manager's 管轄 is its 所属店舗, so this equals `storeIds` for a manager. Prefer `storeIds`.

loggedInAt.description: Attempt timestamp, UTC. MAX over the `success` rows is `staffs.last_login_at` — a refused attempt deliberately does not move it.

result.description:
Y-13 FR-M009 結果 — 成功 / 失敗 / ロック.

`failure` covers the refusals fitness-api can see AND attribute to someone: unregistered account (`E-AUTH-033`), deactivated account (`E-AUTH-034`), an email domain outside the Y-14 allowlist (`E-DMN-007`), an expired CRM magic link (`E-AUTH-030`).

**A wrong password is NOT among them.** The CRM authenticates against Cognito directly (SRP), so a failed password produces no request to this backend — see API-069 §3.4. The same holds for Google Workspace, which FR-M008 itself leaves to Google.

`lock` is defined but never written yet: Cognito locks an account internally and publishes no event for it, and there is no unlock API to pair with FR-M008 either.

email.description: FR-M009 記録項目 メールアドレス — the address the attempt was made with. On a refusal this need not equal the address on the staff record the row is filed under. `null` on rows written before migration 040.

failureReason.description: Which refusal it was: `E-AUTH-033` / `E-AUTH-034` / `E-DMN-007` / `E-AUTH-030`. `null` when `result` is `success`. Beyond FR-M009, which asks only for 結果 — a bare 失敗 gives the operator nothing to act on.

authProvider.description: Which sign-in lane was used. `null` when not captured.

sessionId.description: The Redis session this login created, so a forced logout traces to the session it ended. Compare against the caller's own `sessionId` to mark 現在のセッション. Always `null` when `result` is not `success` — a refused attempt opens no session.

items.description: Sign-in attempts on this page, newest first (`logged_in_at DESC`, not client-sortable). Successes and refusals are interleaved — read `result` per row.

staffId.description: Staff ID that made the change.

displayName.description: Display name; null when the staff row is gone.

role.description: v0.11 — The changer's CURRENT CRM role (staffs.position_id → positions.role, read at request time) — not the role held when the change was made. Null only when `displayName` is null.

staffId.description: The staff this history row belongs to.

changedBy.description: `{ staffId, displayName, role }` of the staff that made the change. Was a bare uuid, which the CRM rendered as an empty cell; `displayName` is null when the staff row is gone.

changedAt.description: When the change was applied (ISO 8601 UTC).

changeAction.description: Change action recorded for the row (staff_change_action).

changeDescription.example: スタッフを無効化しました（理由: 退職）
changeDescription.description: The change as a Japanese sentence, ready to render. Built server-side because the rows carry a whole-record snapshot with no before/after diff, so a per-field description is not derivable client-side. An action with no mapping falls back to its raw code rather than an empty string, so a newly added action looks unlabelled instead of looking like nothing happened. A `role_change` / `position_change` row adds the old and new position names, e.g. 「ロールを変更しました（店舗スタッフ → マネージャー）」; when either name cannot be resolved (an older row, or a position deleted since) only the label is returned.

snapshot.description: Full JSON snapshot of the staff record at the time of the change. Shape follows the staff table, not a fixed contract.

totalAllItems.description: Baseline row count (every OPTIONAL query parameter reset to its default, scope still applied). Present only when `includeTotalAll=true`; may be `null` under load — degrade gracefully.

domain.description: Email domain (RFC 1035). The part after `@` of a staff email, without the `@`: at least two labels, an alphabetic TLD, no scheme or trailing dot. Anything else (`test.2`, `@example.co.jp`, `https://example.co.jp`) is `400 E-VAL-001` with `details[].code = invalid_format`, because no staff email at it could pass invitation (API-070). A label (the text between dots) over 63 characters is reported on its own as `{ field: "domain", code: "too_long" }`. At most 252 characters, or 126 when `authProvider` is `cognito` (the route's email limit minus 2, so `a@<domain>` fits); over it is `400 E-VAL-001` with `details[]` = `{ field: "domain", code: "too_long" }`. Normalized to lowercase server-side; must be unique (E-DMN-001).

message.description: Dialog body; a line break separates the two requests.

minAge.description: The brand's minimum enrollment age (JOYFIT 15, FIT365 16). Null when the account has no brand.

isMinor.description: Under 18. When true, show `minorNotice` before going on.

minorNotice.description: The guardian notice to show when `isMinor`; null otherwise. The member may go on after it.

id.description: The member **UUID** (the legacy int projection was removed).

addressId.description: **Always null** — the new model has no separate address entity.

pendingEmail.description: **Always null.** An in-flight email change is not surfaced here; the PATCH returns a `PendingChangeDto` instead.

pendingPhoneNumber.description: **Always null**, for the same reason as `pendingEmail`.

provider.description: **Always null** — social-login provider is not tracked on the member record.

lastName.description: Family name. Null when unset.

firstNameKana.description: Given name in kana. Null when unset.

lastNameKana.description: Family name in kana. Null when unset.

prefectureCode.description: **Always null.** The v2 member row has ONE `prefecture` column that holds either the JIS X 0401 code or the name, with no separate code column — deriving one would be guessing which form the stored value is in.

cityCode.description: **Always null** — v2 stores no city component at all (see `city`).

city.description: **Always null** — the new model stores one `street_address` with no separate city component.

address1.description: Street address — the whole line, since `city` is not split out.

sex.description: Gender, under the legacy field name `sex`.

birthDate.description: Date of birth. Null when unset.

status.description: The **backend** member lifecycle status — not the mobile `MemberStatus` enum that `members/verify` returns.

deletedAt.description: **Always null** — deletion is not exposed through this facade.

status.description: `granted` — the member allows gym staff to see their body data, and the CRM tab is readable. `denied` — the member said no (CRM: 「会員が情報連携を拒否しています」). `pending` — never answered (CRM: 「この会員はCRMへのボディデータ連携に同意していません」). Only `granted` opens `GET /admin/members/{id}/body-data`; the other two answer 403 E-BDY-100.

grantedAt.description: When the member consented (`members.body_data_crm_consent_at`). Null unless `granted`.

deniedAt.description: When the member refused (`members.body_data_crm_consent_denied_at`). Null unless `denied`.

granted.description: The toggle 「ジムスタッフへのボディデータ共有を許可する」. `true` → `granted`; `false` → `denied` (turning it off after agreeing revokes at once).

payload.description: The whole scanned text of the QR, **exactly as obtained** — the app never parses it. Send the same value to `link-existing/preview` and `link-existing` afterwards (`linkMethod: "qr"`).

expiresAt.description: When this QR stops being accepted (300 s after it was issued). The preview and the link must be sent before then — after it they answer `E-MEM-212`, and the member has to have the QR shown again.

linkMethod.description: How the member names their record (APP-F-02 v2.3). `member_number` — the member number they typed (FR-M003). `nfc` — the member card read over NFC. `qr` — the link QR the CRM / store tablet shows (API-066 §9). `deeplink` — reserved for the old app's hand-off; the old app does not run against v2, so it always answers `E-MEM-211`.

payload.description:
- `member_number`: the number as typed (≤ 64 chars). The server folds full-width to half-width, upper-cases and drops spaces / commas / hyphens before the lookup, so `ＪＦ－０００ ０３３５` = `JF0000335`.
- `nfc`: the card UID as 16 hex characters (`E004…`; case-insensitive).
- `qr`: the whole scanned text of the CRM link QR (AES-256-GCM, base64url, valid 300 s — `E-MEM-212` after). Sent **exactly as obtained** — the server decrypts; the app never parses it.

verificationLastNameKana.description:
APP-F-02 FR-M005 — compared with the stored kana after normalising both sides: full-/half-width, hiragana/katakana, spaces (any width) and `・`, small kana (`ッ`→`ツ`), long-vowel / dash variants, half-width voiced marks. Hiragana input is fine.

The kana pair and `verificationDateOfBirth` are sent together. **Required for `member_number`.** With them the server verifies identity before it returns anything about the member. Omitting all three (`nfc` / `qr` only) is the pre-v2.3 unverified preview, kept for app builds already shipped.

- `nfc`: the card UID as 16 hex characters (`E004…`; case-insensitive).

firstNameKana.description: Given name in katakana. Null when unset or anonymized.

Null when the member has no contract at all (legacy members, applicants who never enrolled). If contracts-svc is unreachable the cached ids are still returned with `plan.name`/`plan.code` null.

hasGateStop.description: Whether an open gate-stop exists for this member.

hasBlacklist.description: Whether an active blacklist entry exists. **HQ-only — the key is absent entirely for other roles** (and filtering on it as non-HQ returns E-AUTH-100).

items.description: Members on this page (soft-deleted rows excluded, store-scoped for non-HQ roles).

lastName.description: Emergency contact last name (姓). All three fields are null for members enrolled through the CRM route — API-098 does not collect an emergency contact, and only the mobile app can register one.

firstName.description: Emergency contact first name (名). Null when unset.

phone.description: Emergency contact phone — JP domestic, no hyphens. Null when unset.

lastName.description: Family name. Null once anonymized.

lastNameKana.description: Family name in katakana. Null when unset.

firstNameKana.description: Given name in katakana. Null when unset.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. Null when unset.

email.description: Email. Null when unset or anonymized.

phone.description: Phone, E.164 as stored (v0.14 — a number under another country code is returned as is, e.g. `+84…`). Null when unset or anonymized.

postalCode.description: 7 digits, no hyphen — the same form the PATCH/PUT body takes. Null when unset.

prefecture.description: 2-digit JIS X 0401 prefecture code (`01`–`47`), NOT the name — the same form the PATCH/PUT body takes. There is no prefecture-master endpoint: the frontend holds the 47-entry code/name table (Otaki 2026-08-21). Null when unset.

bloodType.description: Blood group, ABO half. Null when unset.

rhesusFactor.description: Blood group, Rh half. Legacy enum verbatim (`rh+` / `rh-`), **not** `+` / `-`. Null when unset — which is every member enrolled before 2026-09-08 and every CRM-route enrolment, since API-098 does not collect it.

facePhotoUrl.description: Face photo as a **pre-signed URL** (unlike most image fields in this API, which return the raw S3 key). Null when no photo is stored.

name.description: Guardian name for minor members. Null for adults.

kanaName.description: Guardian name in katakana. Null for adults.

approvalAt.description: When guardian approval was recorded (ISO 8601 UTC). Null when not applicable.

isTestAccount.description: Current state. This field alone decides it — `clearedAt` can be non-null while the flag is on again (set → clear → set).

setAt.description: When the flag was last set. Null if never set.

setBy.description: Who last set it. `displayName` is null when the staff row is gone — deleted staff keep their audit id.

clearedAt.description: When the flag was last cleared. Null if never cleared.

topic.description: `notification_topic`. The array always carries all ten, in this order.

isOptedIn.description: True = receiving. A topic the member has never touched comes back `true`.

updatedAt.description: When the member last changed this topic. **Render null as blank** — it means they never changed it.

brandEnum.description: Brand, derived from the corporate `brand_group`.

billingPattern.description: Who pays what — drives the F-01 billing split.

corporateType.description: A 健保組合 | B 福利厚生サービス | C 直接契約.

memberNumber.description: Member number.

displayName.description: `lastName firstName`. Null once the member is anonymized.

memberStatus.description: Membership status of the referenced member.

isSelf.description: True on the member currently being viewed. **Key the 「本人」 badge on this**, not on comparing ids.

role.description: Which side of a family plan this member is on. `none` when neither.

parent.description: The family-plan parent. Null unless `role` is `child`. (This replaced the retired top-level `familyParent`.)

members.description: The WHOLE household, resolved from the parent — so opening a child lists its siblings too, and the viewed member is in here with `isSelf: true`. **Order is guaranteed**: parent first, then children by member number ascending. Withdrawn and deleted members are excluded. Empty when `role` is `none`.

remainingSlots.description: The N in 「あと N 名追加可能」 — `3 - children`, floored at 0. **Null when `role` is `none`**: "no slots left" and "not a family plan" are different states and the screen shows them differently.

unpaidTotal.description: The N in 「家族の未納あり（合計 N円・回収先: 主会員）」 (A-01 FR-004): the unpaid (`uncollected`) bills of the whole household in yen, the viewed member included. Show the line when it is above 0; the collector is the household parent (`parent`, or the viewed member when `role` is `parent`). `0` when nobody owes. **Null when `role` is `none`.** The top-level `unpaidAmount` stays the member's own amount.

name.example: 春の入会キャンペーン

feeAdjustmentId.description: The fee adjustment in force today.

startDate.description: First day of the adjusted period.

endDate.description: Last day of the adjusted period.

adjustmentPattern.description: API-115 FR-012 pattern axis. API-094-filed rows are always `fixed_amount`.

adjustmentValue.description: Pattern-dependent value. Null for `fixed_amount`, where the figure is `adjustedAmount`.

reason.description: Why the fee was overridden.

status.description: Only these two reach the head-up — expired and cancelled rows are excluded.

suspensionApplicationId.description: The live recess application. **This is the member-axis handle the CRM had no endpoint for** — `GET /admin/suspension-applications/{id}` is keyed by application id, so the detail page had no way to reach it. Pass this id there for the full record.

endDate.description: Recess end (YYYY-MM-DD). Null for an open-ended recess.

status.description: Application status — always `active` here.

reasonCode.description: Recess reason code. Null when unset.

fee.description: 休会費 — the **tax-included (税込)** snapshot taken when the application was filed (`plans.suspension_fee`, BR-SUS-003; API-087 v0.14 — older rows converted by auth migration 051). Null on rows filed before the snapshot lanes were wired, and for legacy contracts with no resolvable plan.

source.description: Where the reservation came from: an individual FR-006 application, or a bulk job from the A-01 list. The two are mutually exclusive, so this is a single object rather than a list.

sourceId.description: The application ID or the bulk job ID, per `source`.

scheduledChangeDate.description: Apply-from date. Always the first of a month.

toPlan.description: The plan the contract will move to. `name` / `code` are null for a bulk reservation — the job stores only the plan id.

scheduledWithdrawalDate.description: Scheduled withdrawal date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when not yet scheduled.

cancellable.description: Whether `POST /admin/withdrawal-applications/{id}/cancel` would go through — the API-092 §6.4 chain, evaluated here so the 退会取消 action on this screen needs no second call. Permission is **not** folded in (caller attribute, not row state). Read-time snapshot: §6 re-evaluates the same chain when the cancel is sent.

cancellationBlockedReason.description: Null when `cancellable` is true; otherwise the first blocking condition in §6.4 order — same values as API-092 §5.3.

status.description: Where the application sits in the approval chain. Terminal statuses (completed / rejected) never appear — the field is null instead.

scheduledTransferDate.description: Scheduled transfer date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null until set by the approval flow.

contractId.description: Contract ID.

startDate.description: Contract start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when unset.

endDate.description: Contract end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null for open-ended contracts.

usageStartDate.description: Date the member may start using the contract (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when unset.

cancellationFeeUntil.description: BR-WDR 解約手数料期間 end, **exclusive** — the CRM gates the FR-005 移籍 button (and the option buttons) on it. **Derived**, not stored: `startDate` + `COALESCE(campaigns, plans).cancellation_fee_months` months (the enrollment campaign's months win over the plan's), the first day OUTSIDE the period, so the contract is inside it while today (JST) < this date — the predicate the API-094 option guards (E-OPT-011) and the transfer auto-eligibility apply. Null when that COALESCE gives null or 0 months (a campaign's 0 still wins over the plan) or the contract has no start date.

plan.description: The contracted plan. Null only when the contract could not be resolved on the SoT.

store.description: The store the contract is held at — **not** necessarily the member `primaryStore`.

campaign.description: Campaign applied at enrollment. Null when none was.

activeFeeAdjustment.description: Fee adjustment whose period covers today. Null when none.

activeSuspension.description: Live recess application. Null when the member is not on recess.

pendingPlanChange.description: Filed-but-not-applied main-plan change. Null when none is pending — and the API-093 §14 bulk job refuses members that have one (E-BPC-205).

pendingWithdrawal.description: Outstanding withdrawal application. Null when none is pending.

pendingTransfer.description: In-flight transfer application (移籍申請中). Null when none — the A-01 banner and the transfer-button disable key off this field. Present from the moment of application through the approval chain; clears on completion/rejection.

recessStartDate.description: Recess window start recorded on the contract itself (set only while `contractStatus` is `suspended`).

recessEndDate.description: Recess window end recorded on the contract itself.

setAtStore.description: **Not the blocked range** — a stop always covers every store. This is the store whose staff set it, for the audit trail. Null when set by HQ/system, and on stops set before migration 032.

messageType.description: What the terminal does after the staff confirm dialog.

message.example: フロントまでお越しください
message.description: Custom message shown at the gate.

pattern.description: Which gate behaviour applies. A row that exists never carries `always_open` — that value IS the not-blocked state, so it only appears as the absence of a gate stop. Null on stops set before migration 024. (This used to be documented as free text; the four values were confirmed 2026-07-23.)

reasonCategory.description: Why the stop was SET. A different value set from the release reason — see the DELETE response. Null on stops set before migration 024.

reasonDetail.description: Free-text detail behind `reasonCategory`. Required when the category is `other`.

setAt.description: When the stop was set (ISO 8601 UTC).

setBy.description: Staff that set the stop. Null for system-set stops.

type.description: `temporary` = 5 failed identity checks within 30 min (lifts on its own at `lockedUntil`); `permanent` = 15 in total, stays until a link completes or staff release it (`POST …/app-link/unlock`). The app shows E-MEM-222 / E-MEM-217.

lockedAt.description: When the lock was set (ISO 8601 UTC). Permanent: when the 15th failure was recorded. Temporary (A-01 FR-027 / APP-F-02 FR-M006): the strike that reached 5, derived as `lockedUntil` − 30 min — exact to the second, since that strike re-arms the counter for 30 min and nothing is counted while locked.

lockedUntil.description: When the temporary lock lifts (ISO 8601 UTC). Null for a permanent lock.

failTotal.description: Failed identity checks counted against this member number in total (reset by a link or an unlock).

consecutiveFailures.description: A-01 FR-027 / APP-F-02 FR-M006 連続 — consecutive failed identity checks behind a temporary lock (the 30-min counter that reached 5; with several counters on this number, the one that lifts last). Null for a permanent lock — its count is `failTotal`.

status.description: A-01 FR-027 連携状態: `linked` (連携済み) when a Yamauchi account is linked; otherwise `locked` (ロック中) when the member number is locked (see `lock`), else `unlinked` (未連携). v0.15 retired `invalidated` (the API-066 3-strike account lock).

linkedAt.description: 連携日時 (ISO 8601 UTC). Null while unlinked. Links made before 2026-11 carry the date the account was attached, or the member's registration when it enrolled through the app.

linkMethod.description: 連携経路: `nfc` (NFCカード読取), `member_number` (会員番号入力), `tablet_qr` (入館用タブレットの連携用QR), `manual` (手動紐付け), `deeplink` (pre-v2.0 app route). Null while unlinked, and for links made before 2026-11 or accounts that enrolled through the app.

lock.description: The lock on this member number, or null. Can be set while `linked` too (failures against a linked number still count).

linkedBy.description: A-01 FR-027 手動紐付け — staff that made the current link, from the newest manual `app_linked` history row. Non-null only when `linkMethod` is `manual`; null for every other route and while unlinked.

invalidatedAt.description: Deprecated (v0.15) — newest `linking_invalidated` history row. Nothing writes that row any more.

invalidatedReason.description: Deprecated (v0.15) — the `reason` on that invalidation row.

inboundFlag.description: Whether the member enrolled with a `member_referral`-scoped promotion code. Resolved from `promotion_code_uses` in contracts-svc — the full outbound list (誰を紹介したか) stays on API-097 §3.

byMember.description: The inviting member (the code owner), name resolved. Null when `inboundFlag` is false or the code has no owner.

code.description: The referral code redeemed. Null when `inboundFlag` is false.

usedAt.description: When the code was redeemed (ISO 8601 UTC). Null when `inboundFlag` is false.

isActive.description: Only active entries reach the head-up, so this is always `true` here — bound directly rather than inferred from the object being non-null.

reason.description: Reason for the entry. Null when unset.

registeredAt.description: When the entry was registered (ISO 8601 UTC).

registeredBy.description: Staff that registered the entry. Null when unknown.

memberNumber.description: Member number.

legacyMemberCode.description: Legacy member code. Null for members created in this system.

yamauchiUserId.description: Yamauchi platform user id. Null when the account is unlinked.

yamauchiUserStatus.description: Yamauchi-side account status. Null when unlinked.

personalInfo.description: PII block. Fields are nulled by the anonymize flow.

brandGroup.description: Raw `members.brand_group`. `brandEnum` is the display form derived from it; the CRM filters on this one.

unpaidAmount.description: 未納額 (§4.3 v0.5) — Σ outstanding `delinquencies` over billing months not covered by a `delinquency_exemptions` row (the §8.3 aggregate). `0` when none, never `null`. Open bills are not counted.

testAccount.description: API-093 §4.3 (v0.9) 動作確認用アカウント state. An OBJECT, never null — it was a bare boolean, which left the FR-025 card no source for 最終更新（設定者・設定日時 / 解除者・解除日時）. Reporting-only for gating purposes: it opens the app during maintenance (Y-06 FR-M007) and changes no contract or billing behaviour. Read by every role but `trainer`; written only by `PATCH /admin/members/{memberId}/test-account`. BREAKING for clients generated before this change: `testAccount` is no longer assignable to `boolean` — read `testAccount.isTestAccount`.

notificationPreferences.description: Per-topic push opt-ins from notification-svc, composed at the BFF (auth-svc has no client for it). **Always exactly 10 items in the order below** — never a subset and never keyed by topic; the screen renders them as a fixed list. Read-only: the CRM has no write endpoint, members change these in the app. **`null` means notification-svc could not be reached** — the rest of the bundle is still complete.

primaryStore.description: Home store, name resolved. Null when unset.

corporate.description: Corporate contract owner, name / brand / billing pattern resolved. Null for individual members.

family.description: Family-plan position: which side this member is on, the parent, the whole household, and how many slots are left.

currentMainContract.description: Current main contract, read from contracts-svc (the SoT) with plan / store / campaign / fee-adjustment / plan-change joined. Null when the member has no live contract. If contracts-svc is unreachable the block degrades to the id + status from the local mirror with the joined fields null, rather than failing the request.

registrationDate.description: When the member record was created (ISO 8601 UTC).

enrolledAt.description: Enrollment date, taken from the contract start. Null without a contract.

lastEntryAt.description: Last gate entry (ISO 8601 UTC), live from gate-svc and falling back to the cached column. Null when the member has never entered.

gateStop.description: Open gate stop. Null when the member is not blocked.

referral.description: Referral provenance — currently stubbed, see the DTO.

memo.description: Internal staff memo. Null when unset.

anonymizedAt.description: When the member was irreversibly anonymized (ISO 8601 UTC). Null for live members.

bodyDataCrmConsentAt.description: When the member consented to CRM body-data access. Null blocks API-096 §6 with 403 E-BDY-100.

bodyDataConsent.description: FR-013 同意確認 as the body-data tab renders it: `granted` (readable), `denied` (「会員が情報連携を拒否しています」), `pending` (never answered). `bodyDataCrmConsentAt` above stays for the clients that already read it.

blacklist.description: Active blacklist entry. **HQ-only — the key is absent entirely for other roles**; null for an HQ caller when the member is not blacklisted.

email.description: RFC 5322. Yamauchi-mastered — proxied to `PATCH /v1/system/users/{id}`; a duplicate is 409 E-MEM-203.

phone.description: JP domestic, no hyphens, or E.164 with any country code (§18.3 v0.14). Hyphens, spaces and full-width digits are dropped before validation. Stored, sent to Yamauchi and recorded in the change history as E.164 (`09012345678` → `+819012345678`); the `phone` §4.3 returns can be sent back as is. Yamauchi-mastered; a duplicate is 409 E-MEM-204.

lastName.description: 姓. Yamauchi-mastered.

dateOfBirth.description: YYYY-MM-DD, must be in the past. Yamauchi-mastered.

prefecture.description: 2-digit JIS X 0401 prefecture code (`01`–`47`), the form `members.prefecture` stores and §4.3 returns. There is no prefecture-master endpoint — the frontend holds the 47-entry code/name table (Otaki 2026-08-21). Yamauchi-mastered.

streetAddress.description: 市区町村 + 番地. Yamauchi-mastered.

building.description: 建物名・部屋番号. The ONE Yamauchi-mastered field `null` clears — every other one rejects `null`, because the Yamauchi contract makes them non-nullable and a cleared value could not be mirrored (§18.3).

bloodType.description: Blood group, ABO half. fitness-mastered — never proxied.

rhesusFactor.description: Blood group, Rh half (血液型 Rh). Legacy enum verbatim — `rh+` / `rh-`, **not** `+` / `-`; same values as the member-facing API-063 path. fitness-mastered — never proxied.

emergencyContactPhone.description: JP domestic, no hyphens (Dev Q&A #145); hyphenated input is normalised. fitness-mastered.

memo.description: CRM 運用メモ (staff-entered). fitness-mastered, and the only write path `members.memo` has — §18.3 lists it as non-editable, which would leave the column read-only everywhere. Flagged for the spec owner rather than dropped.

phone.description: JP domestic, no hyphens, or E.164 with any country code (§18.3 v0.14); stored as E.164. Yamauchi-mastered.

dateOfBirth.description: YYYY-MM-DD, must be in the past.

rhesusFactor.description: Blood group, Rh half. `rh+` / `rh-`, **not** `+` / `-`. Required like every other key on PUT — an omitted key is written as `null`.

emergencyContactPhone.description: JP domestic, no hyphens; hyphenated input is normalised.

pattern.description: WHICH gate behaviour applies. `always_open` is **not accepted here** — it means "no gate stop", i.e. the released state, so sending it is the release operation and belongs on `DELETE` (E-VAL-001 otherwise).

messageType.description: What the terminal does after the staff confirm dialog.

message.description: Message shown at the gate.

reasonCategory.description: WHY the stop is being set — the four values confirmed 2026-07-23, matching the prototype's radio group. (The seven values this used to advertise were never signed off and shared only `other` with the form.)
WHY the stop is being released. **A different value set from the setting reason** — a block is not lifted for the reason it was applied, so filing a release as 「未納金」 was never meaningful.

note.description: The prototype's 詳細 field. Required when `reasonCategory` is `other`.

comment.description: Retired spelling of `note`; still accepted and folded into it.

reasonDetail.description: Internal column name; `note` is the field to send.

gateStop.description: Always null — the stop was just cleared. Present so the client can reuse the detail shape.

clearedAt.description: When the stop was cleared (ISO 8601 UTC).

clearedBy.description: Staff that cleared the stop (the caller).

clearedReasonCategory.description: Why the stop was RELEASED. **A different value set from the setting reason** — this is the substance of the 2026-07-23 correction: the release path used to validate against the setting vocabulary, so an operator lifting a block had to file it as 「未納金」. Nothing is undone for the reason it was done.

clearedNote.example: 本人と面談し未納分を精算済み
clearedNote.description: The prototype's 詳細 field. Required when the category is `other`. (Renamed from `comment`.)

anonymizedBy.description: Staff that performed the anonymization (the caller).

reasonCategories.description: Why the member is being listed — MULTI-select, 1–5 distinct values (confirmed 2026-07-23 §3). An array because the legacy system modelled this as one: 「未納金 かつ 機器破損」 is a real case. A single-select UI sends a one-element array. (The five values this used to advertise shared **no** value with the confirmed set, so every option the CRM form offered was rejected.)

memo.description: メモ（任意）, 0–2,000 chars. Stored as the entry's `reason`; an empty string or null stores no memo.

reason.description: Retired name for `memo`. Still accepted and folded into it — the Q&A re-defined the mandatory 登録理由 as this optional note.

level.description: **Do not send.** BR-BLK-010 has no severity criteria yet, so an operator-picked level is uninterpretable. Omitted / null means 未分類.

payload.description: The encrypted QR payload (AES-256-GCM, base64url, valid 300 s) the member scans in the app to link their account. Render it into the QR as-is; the app posts it unchanged as `payload` with `linkMethod: "qr"` to `POST /api/v1/members/me/link-existing{,/preview}`. This is the name API-093 §11.6 gives the field.

qrPayload.description: The SAME value as `payload`, under the name this service shipped with. Kept so the deployed CRM keeps working; new clients should read `payload`. Renaming outright was the alternative — it would have broken the live screen for a field the FE reads on every link issue.

expiresAt.description: When the payload stops being accepted (ISO 8601 UTC).

issuedAt.description: When the payload was issued (ISO 8601 UTC).

isTestAccount.description: true = mark as a 動作確認用アカウント, false = clear the flag.

memberId.description: The member the flag was set on.

testAccount.description: The flag and its audit pair after the write.

comment.example: 本人確認のうえロック解除
comment.description: Recovery reason / staff note, stored on the `linking_unlocked` history row.

status.description: `linked` when the member holds an account; otherwise `locked` when the member number is locked (see `lock`), else `unlinked`.

linkMethod.description: 連携経路 of the current link (`manual` after §25). Null while unlinked, and for links made before 2026-11.

lock.description: The lock on the member number, or null. Always null after §25 / §26 (both lift every lock); §27 leaves a lock as it was.

memberId.description: The member whose member number was unlocked.

memberStatus.description: The member status (unchanged). Lets the screen re-render the header without a second read.

linking.description: `linked` or `unlinked` as before the unlock, `linkMethod` unchanged, `lock: null`.

unlockedAt.description: When the lock was released (ISO 8601 UTC).

unlockedBy.description: Staff that released the lock (the caller).

phone.description: Masked phone of the account (FR-M002 mask).

accountStatus.description: Yamauchi account status: `inactive` (never finished its OTP — not linkable) | `provisional` | `active` | `verified`.

provider.description: How the account signs in (`email`, `sms`, `google`, `apple`, `line`…). Null when the search ran on the local copy.

createdAt.description: A-01 FR-027 アカウント作成日 — when the Yamauchi account was created (ISO 8601 UTC), as Yamauchi reports it. Null when Yamauchi does not return it, and when the search ran on the local copy (User API off) — the member row's own date is not the account's.

linkable.description: Whether §25 would accept this account for the member.

reason.description: Why not: `linked_to_other_member` (already linked to another member of this brand — E-MEM-232; the other member is not disclosed) or `account_not_usable` (E-MEM-234).

hasProvisionalRow.description: The account already opened this brand's app and waits unlinked; linking merges that empty account into the member and signs the app out once.

memberId.description: The member the accounts were judged for.

items.description: Accounts holding exactly that email / phone — usually 0 or 1.

yamauchiUserId.description: The Yamauchi account linked to the member. Null while unlinked.

email.description: Account email, masked like the §24 candidates: the first two characters of the local part, then `***@domain`. Null while unlinked, when the account has none, or when Yamauchi no longer has the account.

phone.description: Account phone, masked like the §24 candidates: domestic form, the first three digits, then `-****-****`. Null while unlinked, when the account has none, or when Yamauchi no longer has the account.

yamauchiUserId.description: The Yamauchi account to link — `items[].yamauchiUserId` from §24.

comment.example: 運転免許証で本人確認
comment.description: Staff note stored on the `app_linked` history row (e.g. how identity was checked).

replace.description: A-01 FR-027 紐付け直し (APP-F-02 「連携済みの誤り」). `true` moves a member that already holds an account to `yamauchiUserId` in one transaction — on the 手動紐付け permission (staff and above), without 連携解除. The new account is checked first (E-MEM-219 / E-MEM-234 / E-MEM-232); a refusal leaves the old link as it was. One `app_linked` history row marked `replaced` keeps the old account, and every app session of the member ends. Same account as the current one → 409 E-MEM-235. On a member with no account it is a plain manual link. Omitted / `false`: a linked member is refused with 409 E-MEM-215.

memberStatus.description: The member status after the link (`provisional` becomes `active` when the member holds an active contract, as in the app's own link).

linkedYamauchiUserId.description: The Yamauchi account now linked to the member (also on the `app_linked` history row).

linkedAt.description: When the link was made (ISO 8601 UTC).

linkedBy.description: Staff that made the link (the caller).

replacedYamauchiUserId.description: A-01 FR-027 紐付け直し — the Yamauchi account the member held before a `replace` (also on the `app_linked` history row, as `replacedYamauchiUserId`). Null for a plain manual link, including `replace` on a member that held no account.

comment.description: Staff note stored on the history row.

memberStatus.description: The member status (unchanged — the contract stays).

linking.description: `linkMethod: null`; `status` is `unlinked`, or `locked` with `lock` set when the member number was locked (an unlink does not lift a lock).

unlinkedYamauchiUserId.description: The Yamauchi account that was removed (also on the `app_unlinked` history row).

unlinkedAt.description: When the link was removed (ISO 8601 UTC).

unlinkedBy.description: Staff that removed the link (the caller).

memberId.description: The member who referred this one — the OWNER of the code this member redeemed.

usedReferralCode.description: The code consumed when THIS member enrolled (`promotion_codes.code`).

applicationId.description: This member’s own membership application — the one the code was spent on.

applicationNumber.description: Null when enrollment-svc could not be reached.

applicationCreatedAt.description: When the application was filed — i.e. when the code was used. Null when unresolved.

status.description: Returned raw — API-097 §3.2 design decision 4 makes this enum the UI’s label source rather than a derived `displayStatus`.

memberNumber.description: Null if the invitee row is not readable from auth.members.

usedStoreId.description: The store the code was redeemed at.

applicationStatus.description: The invitee’s `membership_applications.status`. All five states are returned on purpose (§3.2 design decision 5): "used the code but never enrolled" is exactly what CS needs when a member asks why no reward arrived, and a boolean would collapse submitted / under_review / rejected / cancelled into one indistinguishable value. Null when enrollment-svc could not be reached, or the invitee has no application row.

enrolledAt.description: FR-S001 招待実績 入会日 — the approved application’s `usageStartDate` (the same enrollment anchor as BR-ENR-003 / API-093 `enrolledAt`). Null for an invitee who has not (yet) enrolled — submitted / under_review / rejected / cancelled — and when enrollment-svc could not be reached.

pagination.description: Nested here rather than at the top level: `invitees` is the only paginated block (§3.2 design decision 2). `totalAllItems` only with `includeTotalAll=true`.

totalReferred.description: Every redemption of this member’s code — including people who applied and never completed enrolment.

approvedCount.description: Of those, how many applications reached `approved` — the reward-eligible subset (API-097 §3.2 design decision 6), and what the 特典付与済み column binds. The DIFFERENCE from `totalReferred` is the pending count, which is the point of returning both. **Null means enrollment-svc could not be reached**, never zero. Actual point GRANTING is not this endpoint: FR-S001’s step-up calculation belongs to the reward batch, and the balance is `GET /members/{id}/points`.

inviter.description: WHO REFERRED THIS MEMBER. Null when they did not enrol through anyone’s code — a normal state. (Their own code is `ownReferralCode`.)

ownReferralCode.description: This member’s own referral code. Null when none has been issued — also normal; there is no lazy issuance on read.

storeId.description: Purchase store — `contracts.store_id` via `option_contracts.contract_id`. Purchase store = use store (API-097 §4.3), so there is no separate use-store field.

storeName.description: `stores.name`.

optionId.description: `option_contracts.option_id`.

passType.description: Mapped from `options.category`: `oneday_pass` → 1DayPass (当日 2 回入館可), `one_time_pass` → 1TimePass (1 回入館で終了).

status.description: `option_contracts.contract_status`.

purchasedAt.description: `option_contracts.start_date` — the purchase date for an immediate start, the 1st of next month for a deferred one.

validUntil.description: API-computed = `purchasedAt` + 6 months (never stored — API-097 §4.3 Design Rationale 1).

usedAt.description: `option_contracts.end_date` when `status = used` (the use date). Null for every other status — on a cancelled row `end_date` is the cancellation date, not a visit.

contractId.description: The main contract the pass hangs off. Beyond §4.3.

fee.description: Price paid, denormalised at purchase — it survives a later master price change. Beyond §4.3.

staffId.description: ID behind changed_by.

displayName.description: Display name; null when the staff row is gone.

role.description: The changer's CURRENT CRM role (staffs.position_id → positions.role, read at request time) — not the role held when the change was made. Present only on staff rows (absent on member / system ones); null when the staff row is gone.

source.description: Which of the five history tables the entry came from. All five are served; use it as the discriminator when rendering, since the snapshot shape differs per source.

id.description: Synthetic id, `"<source>:<uuid>"`. The five tables have independent UUID spaces, so the raw ids can collide once merged into one array — this is the stable list key.

changeAction.description: What happened. On `member` / `option_contract` this is the table’s `change_action`; on the three status sources it is the DESTINATION status (`to_status`), because a status table has no verb of its own.

changedByType.description: Whether a staff member, the member themselves, or the system made the change. Null on the four sources whose tables do not record an actor type — read `changedBy` instead.

changedBy.description: `{ staffId, displayName, role? }` of the staff who made the change — was a bare uuid, which the CRM rendered as an empty cell. `displayName` is null when the staff row is gone; the object itself is null for a system-driven change.

changeDescription.example: 会員ステータスを変更しました
changeDescription.description: The change as a Japanese sentence, ready to render. Built server-side from the shared change-action vocabulary (`@fitness/common`), the same one the staff history uses, so one action reads identically on every screen. An action with no mapping falls back to its raw code rather than an empty string.

snapshot.description: Snapshot captured for the change. Null when the row carries none.

changedAt.description: When the change was applied (ISO 8601 UTC).

items.description: History entries on this page, merged across all five sources and ordered by `changedAt`.

sourcesUnavailable.description: Sources that could not be read for this request — today only `option_contract` / `plan_change_application`, which come from contracts-svc. Normally empty. It exists so a partial timeline is distinguishable from a member who genuinely has no such history; a silent three-of-five looks identical to "nothing ever happened".

pagination.description: `totalItems` counts the FULL history of every requested source, not the merge window. The five streams live in two databases, so they are merged in memory (up to 500 rows per source) rather than UNIONed in SQL — reporting the window size as the total would make later pages disappear.

storeId.description: Store the scan happened at.

storeName.description: Store name; null if the store row is gone.

result.description: `allowed` or the denial reason code (`denied_blacklist`, `denied_delinquent`, …). Denied rows ARE returned — the audit tab is what they are for.

authChannel.description: Credential channel; null for non-gate devices.

items.description: Access-log rows, newest first by default. Served by gate-svc.

pagination.description: `totalAllItems` is present only when the request carried `includeTotalAll=true`.

date.description: JST calendar day the taps happened on — the card's 日付 column.

storeId.description: Store the device sits in.

storeName.description: Store name; null if the store row is gone.

optionName.description: The オプション名 column, resolved server-side: the service type's Japanese name, else the device kind's, else the device name. This label IS the group key.

serviceType.description: The device's single service type (`connected_devices.allowed_service_types` with exactly one entry), reported only when EVERY tap in the group agrees on it — two devices can reach the same label by different routes (one gated on the service type, one merely of that device kind), and naming one of the two would be a guess. Null otherwise, including for devices listing several service types.

times.description: The 回数 column — taps in this 日付 × 店舗 × オプション名 group.

items.description: One row per 日付 × 店舗 × オプション名 with its count, newest day first. Served by gate-svc.

pagination.description: Counts GROUPS, not taps — `totalItems` is how many rows the table has. `totalAllItems` is present only when the request carried `includeTotalAll=true`.

band.description: Two-hour JST band the member entered in most often, as the card prints it.

entries.description: Entries that fell in this band.
Entries at this store in the window.
`entry` events in the window — `exit` is the same visit from the other side, and `companion_entry` is somebody else on this member's badge.

days.description: Distinct JST days with at least one entry.

total.description: オプション利用数（今月）— all equipment taps in the window.

breakdown.description: The 水素水 3 / プロテインサーバー 1 / … line under the total, most-used first.

count.description: Bookings that still hold a seat in the window — `reserved` / `pending` / `attended`. Cancellations and no-shows are excluded; the card counts 予約数.

previousCount.description: The same count over the immediately preceding window of equal length — the 前月比 baseline.

delta.description: `count - previousCount`, precomputed so every client shows the same delta.

window.description: The window actually applied (JST, both ends inclusive) — the current JST month unless the request named one.

previousWindow.description: The comparison window behind `lessons.previousCount`: the equal-length period immediately before `window`.

frequentTimeBand.description: よく利用する時間帯. Null when the member did not enter in the window — a different statement from "their favourite band is 00:00-02:00". Ties break to the earlier band.

frequentStore.description: よく利用する店舗. Null on no entries; ties break to the lower store id.

visits.description: The denominator the two cells above are shares of — saves a separate /access-logs call for `pagination.totalItems`.

optionUsage.description: オプション利用数（今月）and its per-option breakdown.

lessons.description: レッスン予約数（今月）+ 前月比, served by lessons-svc. NULL when lessons-svc could not be reached — the other three cells are gate-svc's and still render, and a 0 here would read as "no bookings" rather than "not known".

fee.description: CURRENT master price, tax-included yen (API-111 §6.9) — not what this booking was charged. That is `feeCharged`, a snapshot taken when the booking was made (design decision 5).

name.description: App nickname when the trainer has one, otherwise 姓 名. Null only when the trainer row is gone — `trainers` has no display_name column, so this is composed.

displayOrder.description: Presentation order. Assigned instructors are NOT ranked (D-01 FR-003 v3), so this is the only ordering.

scheduledAt.description: When the session is held (JST). API-096 §4.3 `lessonSchedule.scheduledAt`.

scheduledDate.description: The date half of `scheduledAt`, for a table that renders date and time in separate columns.

endTime.description: `HH:mm` JST. Stored, not recomputed — a later change to a trainer buffer cannot move a past session.

storeName.description: Resolved by the BFF from contracts-svc. Null when the store row could not be resolved.

studioId.description: Null for personal training, which has no studio.

isCancelled.description: The SESSION was cancelled (all its bookings with it) — distinct from this booking being cancelled.

optionContractId.description: The option contract a `monthly_plan` booking draws its session from.

feeCharged.description: Fee actually charged, tax-included yen (API-096 v0.4.2), snapshotted when the booking was made — the master price may have changed since. Null for a monthly-plan booking and a free trial.

studioSeatId.description: Seat for a studio lesson; null for personal training.

cancelledBy.description: WHO cancelled, derived from `status` (API-096 §4.3). Null unless the booking was cancelled. A pending hold that expired reads as `member` — see TBD-A096-CANCELLEDBY-SYSTEM.

cancelledByStaffId.description: The staff who operated the cancellation. Null when the member cancelled. Audit only — for the column header "who cancelled", read `cancelledBy`.

pendingExpiresAt.description: Mode-B holds expire; the sweeper cancels them after this.

lesson.description: The rest of the lesson master, for the detail panel. Null when the master row is gone.

trainers.description: The 担当 column. An ARRAY, not one trainer: assignment is the M:N `lesson_schedule_trainers` (D-01 FR-003 v3), where API-096 §4.3 still writes a single `trainerId`/`trainerName`. Empty when the session has no trainer assigned yet.

lessonSchedule.description: The session this booking is for. Null only if the schedule row is gone.

code.description: Master code. `aerobics` has no name column — localized names live in `aerobic_descriptions`, and the row's own `title` is the display string.

trainingType.description: Which table the row came from. API-096 §5 is a UNION of `training_sessions` and `aerobic_training_sessions`, and the metrics differ per kind.

id.description: Session id within its own table. Both are uuid v7, so the union cannot collide.

title.description: Session title. Aerobic sessions carry one; `training_sessions` has no title column, so weight rows are null.

startedAt.description: `started_at` on both tables — the union sorts on this, descending, and FR-012 fixes it that way.

endedAt.description: Weight sessions only. The aerobic table has no `ended_at` — an aerobic session logs `durationSeconds` instead.

status.description: Weight: `active` | `completed` | `abandoned`. Aerobic has no lifecycle (logged after the fact) and always reads `completed`.

durationSeconds.description: The FR-012 duration column. Weight: the member override when set, otherwise ended−started. Aerobic: the logged total. Null on a weight session still in progress.

durationEdited.description: True when the member overrode the measured duration. Always false for aerobic.

totalVolumeKg.description: Weight sessions only — mobile computes it as SUM(weight × reps) over the session's sets.

totalSets.description: Weight: the persisted `total_sets`. Aerobic: counted from `aerobic_training_sets`, which is why it can be 0 rather than null.

totalCalories.description: The FR-012 calorie column, kcal. Returned for BOTH kinds — §5.3 says weight is always null, but `training_sessions.total_calories` exists and FR-012 asks for the figure.

caloriesEstimated.description: Aerobic only — whether the calories were estimated rather than measured. Null for weight.

aerobic.description: The aerobic master this session was logged against. Null for weight.

condition.description: Self-reported condition. **The value set depends on `trainingType`** — weight: `good` | `normal` | `slightly_bad` | `bad`; aerobic: `good` | `neutral` | `poor`. Each source's raw value is projected; they are not merged into one enum. Null when the member skipped the check-in.

memo.description: Free-text session note. Aerobic only — the column is `caption`; neither table has a `memo`, which is the name §5.3 gives this field.

routineId.description: Set when the session was started from a routine. Always null for aerobic.

routineName.description: The FR-012 routine-name column, from `routines.name`. Null on an ad-hoc session.

sessions.description: Sessions started from this routine within the same filter.

totalCalories.description: 合計消費カロリー, kcal, both kinds.

topRoutine.description: 最多ルーティン — the routine with the most sessions. Null when every session was ad-hoc. Routines only ever hang off a weight session.

bodyFatPercent.description: 体脂肪率 (%). Null on a `body_measurement` row.

date.description: JST calendar day of the record.

value.description: The indicator’s value on that day.

unit.description: Display unit. Empty string for unitless indicators.

points.description: Points in ascending date order. `[]` when nothing in the window carries this indicator.

transactionType.description: Which side of the ledger the row is (the 種別 column). `payment` = money in, `refund` = money out. The two come from different tables — a refund is NOT a negative `payments` row — so the payment fields below are null on a `refund` row and the refund fields are null on a `payment` row. Same vocabulary as the F-01 ledger (API-116 §7).

billingId.description: Billing this attempt paid; null for an unallocated payment.

amount.description: JPY. Positive on a `payment` row (money in), NEGATIVE on a `refund` row (money out) — BR-TXN-006, so the tab can sum to a running balance.

paymentMethod.description: billings.dbml `payment_method`. Same value set as the `paymentMethod` filter. Null on a `refund` row — see `refundMethod`.

paymentStatus.description: billings.dbml `payment_status`. This used to advertise only 3 of the 7 values, so a `refunded` row looked like a contract violation to the client. Null on a `refund` row — see `refundStatus`.

refundMethod.description: `refunds.refund_method` — how the money went back. Null on a `payment` row.

refundStatus.description: `refunds.status`. Null on a `payment` row. Only `succeeded` has actually moved money — a `pending` row is an approved application that has not run yet. These are the values the writer stores; the DBML column comment (`executing` / `executed`) is stale.

paidAt.description: `payments.paid_at`, or `refunds.refunded_at` on a `refund` row — the date column of the tab.

failureReason.description: Gateway reason on a failed attempt.

description.example: 2026年6月分 月会費
description.description: The 内容 column, trimmed to 200 chars: `payments.description` (F-01 free text) on a `payment` row, and the operator's 返金事由 (`refund_applications.reason`) on a `refund` row. Null on rows written before the column landed.

storeName.description: Store the payment belongs to (`payments.store_id` → stores, current name — not point-in-time). Null when the store is unknown or contracts-svc did not answer.

salesTotal.description: 売上合計 — sum of the `success` payments among the filtered rows whose `paidAt` falls in the window. Same definition as API-114 `paymentTotal` (tax-inclusive). 0 under `transactionType=refund`.

refundTotal.description: 返金合計 — sum of the `succeeded` refunds among the filtered rows whose `refundedAt` falls in the window, as a POSITIVE number; the card renders its own minus sign. 0 under `transactionType=payment` or a `paymentMethod` / `paymentStatus` filter, which leave no refund row in the ledger.

lastPaidAt.description: 最終入金日 — the latest `paidAt` among the rows counted in `salesTotal`. Null when nothing was collected among the filtered rows (always under `transactionType=refund`).

items.description: The ledger: payments (successful AND failed) and refunds, newest first.

summary.description: The 支払いサマリー card. Present only when the request carried `includeSummary=true`. Totals the rows the ledger filters select — the `from`/`to` window AND `transactionType` (the 種別 select) / `paymentMethod` / `paymentStatus` — so the card moves with the table beside it: `transactionType=refund` answers `salesTotal: 0` and `lastPaidAt: null`. `page` / `limit` / `sort` never move it (it is dated on `paidAt` / `refundedAt`). It cannot be summed client-side: the list is paginated.

pagination.description: `totalAllItems` is present only when the request carried `includeTotalAll=true`. For this union the baseline counts BOTH sources.

billingType.description: billings.dbml `billing_type`. Same value set as the `billingType` filter.

collectionStatus.description: billings.dbml `billing_collection_status`. This used to advertise a stale set (`collecting`, no refund states), so refunded rows looked like contract violations.

sentAt.description: Invoice-send timestamp (`billings.sent_at`); null until F-01 issues it.
