brandGroup.description: Brand group the balance belongs to.

pointName.description: Display name of the point currency for that brand group.

balance.description: Live balance from rewards-svc for the member’s own brand; the other brand group is always 0 (BR-PNT-007).

lastUpdatedAt.description: When the balance last changed (ISO 8601 UTC). Null for the brand the member does not belong to, and for a member with no ledger rows.

earnedTotal.description: 期間内獲得合計 — sum of the positive deltas in the filtered window. `0` when there are none.

spentTotal.description: 期間内消費合計 — sum of the negative deltas, returned as a **positive magnitude** (the ledger stores them signed).

expiringPoints.description: 失効予定 — how many points expire on `expiringAt`. Under the configured expiry method (Y-12 FR-M002 年次リセット, run by BAT-064) the **whole** positive balance expires at once, so this is the member’s live balance, NOT a per-lot figure and NOT scoped to `from`/`to`/`eventType`. `0` when the balance is empty; **`null` when the ledger could not be read** (a member outside the app points gate, or rewards-svc unreachable) — `null` never claims that nothing expires. Both brands carry a value since TBD-007 closed. Do not try to derive this from `transactions[].expiredAt`: that column is the `rolling_days` method’s per-row stamp, which has no producer, and a per-row date cannot tell you which points were already spent.

expiringAt.description: The next 年次リセット date (JST). A day the target month lacks clamps to that month’s last day (BR-PNT-009). `null` together with `expiringPoints` when no expiry rule applies.

eventType.description: What earned or spent the points (`visit`, `admin_adjust`, …).

points.description: Signed delta — negative for a spend or an admin claw-back.

balanceAfter.description: Balance after this row was applied.

sourceType.description: What the row was derived from.

expiredAt.description: Point expiry date (API-095 §5.3). Null unless a rolling-days expiry method is configured.

totalItems.description: Total number of matching rows across all pages.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages (minimum 1, even when empty).

hasNext.description: Whether another page of transactions follows.

balance.description: **Both brand groups are always returned** (§5.3 BR-PNT-007), even for a member who only belongs to one — so a two-element array is the normal case, not an anomaly.

summary.description: Window totals for the ポイントサマリー card — independent of `page`.

transactions.description: The point ledger page from rewards-svc (WIRED 2026-08-24), newest first. Empty for a brand/member with no points programme — rewards is brand-isolated (BR-PNT-007).

brandGroup.description: Must equal the member’s own brand group — points are brand-locked (BR-PNT-007), so a mismatch is refused rather than redirected.

points.description: Refund amount as a POSITIVE integer; persisted as `+N`.

reason.description: Justification — FR-S001 証跡管理 is mandatory. Stored verbatim in `point_transactions.adjust_reason`.

sourceTransactionId.description: The deduction being undone (`spend` / `expire`, same member + brand, not already refunded). Omitted for goodwill refunds.

eventType.description: Always `admin_adjust` — the CRM cannot create any other event type.

adjustReason.description: The justification, stored on the row.

sourceTransactionId.description: The deduction this refund reverses, when one was named.

transaction.description: Single-key envelope holding the refund row.

memberId.description: Member ID — the only field guaranteed to be present.

memberNumber.description: Member number. **Absent when the member row could not be loaded.**

lastName.description: Family name. Absent when the member row could not be loaded; null once anonymized.

firstName.description: Given name. Absent when the member row could not be loaded; null once anonymized.

code.description: Store code. Null when the store directory does not answer.

brandEnum.description: Layer-1 sub-brand.

status.description: Outcome. `paid` — charged and settled. `declined` — SBPS business NG (card declined / insufficient funds); the payment row is `failed`, the bill is unchanged. `gateway_error` — SBPS timed out or errored, the 与信 was rejected as a duplicate (`999-96`), or the reconciliation inquiry could not resolve the prior attempt; the bill is unchanged (the attempt's payment row is `failed` when the 与信 got no response, `processing` when 確定 / 売上 failed — API-148 v0.6). **`gateway_error` stops the whole batch** — every bill after it comes back `not_attempted` with `amount: 0`, so a partial run is expected rather than exceptional. `not_payable` — not eligible before any charge (see `reason`).

amount.description: Amount charged for this bill, in yen. 0 for `not_payable` and `not_attempted`.

paymentId.description: The `payments.id` of the attempt: `paid` — the success row (a prior attempt's row when the reconciliation inquiry found it captured); `declined` — the failed row; `gateway_error` — the row of the attempt this request made (`failed` or `processing`). **Key absent** for `not_payable` / `not_attempted`, and for a `gateway_error` where this request made no new attempt (`999-96`, or the reconciliation inquiry / cancel stopped it — API-148 v0.6).

reason.description: API-148 §4.1 — why the bill was skipped. A concurrent tap on the same bill waits on the row lock and then answers `already_collected`. **Key absent** unless `status` is `not_payable`.

confirmedBy.description: Confirming staff; null when not confirmed.

status.description: Unified BR-TXN-002 status.

refundedAt.description: PSP execution time; null while pending/failed.

status.description: Unified BR-TXN-002 status (executing → pending).

applicable.description: True if a refund can be initiated from this sale (BR-TXN-001).

applicableAmount.description: Max refundable JPY by the API-118 §13.3 BR-REF-003 remainder (amount_with_tax − amounts held by pending_approval / approved-not-failed applications; discount / excluded lines count 0). List row (v0.7.3): that LINE's remainder. Detail (EP #3, v0.7.4): MIN(Σ over the billing's items, API-118 §13.3 billing-level cap) = API-114 `header.refundableAmount`. 0 when not applicable (detail only — the list returns null instead).

paymentMethod.description: v0.7.4 BR-TXN-001 #10: `payment_method` of the source payment (the latest `paid_at` success payment allocated to the billing; tie → larger id). Null when the billing has no success payment.

alertVariant.description: v0.7.4 BR-TXN-001 #11–#13 (API-118 §13.2 values) from the source payment: sbps_credit / sbps_link ≤ 90 days → sbps_void (> 90 days → not applicable); jaccs_bank → jaccs_manual_or_cashpost; convenience_store → cashpost; cash / card_onsite → cash; bank_transfer / manual / cashpost → bank_transfer. Null when not applicable.

linkedRefunds.description: §6.3 refunds touching this billing; empty when none.

refundApplyContext.description: Re-validated under a NOWAIT lock (the list value is derived lock-free).

receiptNumber.description: §6.4 `payments.receipt_number` (first-issue snapshot); null when no receipt issued.

rawResponse.description: Latest `sbps_transactions.response_raw` for this payment — returned only when includeRawResponse=true AND role ∈ {system, headquarter}; null otherwise or when there is no SBPS row.

paymentId.description: Original payment tracked for the refund; null for non-payment-linked refunds.

status.description: `refunds.status` (raw).

gatewayRefundId.description: SBPS void/refund tracking id / CASHPOST no. / JACCS reference.

rawResponse.description: PSP raw body — HQ + includeRawResponse only; otherwise null.

status.description: `refund_applications.status` (raw — F-01-03 workflow).

reason.description: Operator-entered reason (free text).

cancelledAt.description: Applicant cancellation time; null when not cancelled.

billingItemId.description: Target billing item; null for header-level lines.

refundAmount.description: Absolute JPY refunded on this line (positive).

refundTaxAmount.description: Tax portion of the line refund (inherits the item tax rate).

amount.description: Absolute JPY written off (positive; sign applied at row level).

writeOffRunId.description: `write_offs.write_off_run_id` — the API-119 write-off run that created the row (null for migrated rows).

indemnificationKind.description: JACCS indemnification classification (BR-DLQ-007); null for SBPS.

indemnifiedAmount.description: JACCS indemnified amount SoT (JPY); null when none/SBPS.

source.description: Delinquency origin.

memberName.description: Member display name, enriched from auth-svc. Null if unresolved.

memberCode.description: Member code, enriched from auth-svc. Null if unresolved.

storeName.description: Store display name, enriched from contracts-svc. Null if unresolved.

delinquency.description: Linked delinquency; null when the write-off had no prior delinquency.

billing.description: Billing headline; null when the billing row is gone.

transactionType.description: Source-table discriminator (derived in the UNION SELECT): `sale`=billing_items (+, a discount line −), `payment`=payments (+), `refund`=refund_application_lines (−), `write_off`=write_offs (−).

rowKey.description: v0.7.3 §3.5 unique row key: `sale:{billingItemId}` / `refund:{refundApplicationLineId}` / `payment:{paymentId}` / `write_off:{writeOffId}`. Use it as the list row key; equal sort values are ordered by it (ascending).

sourceId.description: PK of the PARENT source row (billing / payment / refund / write_off) — the EP #3 path key. v0.7.3: the lines of one billing / refund share it.

transactionDate.description: JST date. §3.3: sale=COALESCE(confirmed_at, created_at); payment=COALESCE(paid_at, failed_at, created_at); refund=COALESCE(refunded_at, created_at); write_off=document_date.

memberName.description: Member display name (`last first`), enriched from auth-svc. Null if the member row is gone or enrichment failed.

memberCode.description: `members.member_number` (human-readable member code), enriched from auth-svc. Null if unresolved.

storeId.description: Calculation store. Null only if the source row has no resolvable store.

storeName.description: Store display name, enriched from contracts-svc. Null if the store row is gone or enrichment failed.

billingId.description: Source billing header — sale=the line's billing (= sourceId); refund=the line's own `refund_application_lines.billing_id` (v0.7.3); payment=direct link, else the first allocation; write_off=write_offs.billing_id. Null when unresolved.

billingItemId.description: v0.7.3 (replaces `billingItemIds[]`) — 請求明細ID of this row: sale=`billing_items.id`; refund=`refund_application_lines.billing_item_id` (may be null); payment / write_off=null.

billingType.description: `billings.billing_type` when a billing is resolvable; null for payment/refund/write_off rows with no resolvable billing.

billingMonth.description: `billings.billing_month` (YYYY-MM). Null when no billing or a non-monthly billing.

amountExcludingTax.description: JPY, tax-exclusive, SIGNED. sale=the line's `amount_before_tax`; refund=−(refund_amount − refund_tax_amount) of the line; payment / write_off=amountIncludingTax − taxAmount.

taxRate.description: Tax percent (10 / 8). sale=the line's `billing_items.tax_rate`; refund=the rate of the line's item (null when the line has no billingItemId); payment / write_off=the one rate of the items of their billing(s), null when mixed or none.

taxAmount.description: JPY tax portion, SIGNED (§3.3 / §3.5). sale = the line's `tax_amount`; payment = Σ per-allocated-billing share (each billing's own tax ratio); refund = −the line's `refund_tax_amount`; write_off = the billing's ratio.

amountIncludingTax.description: JPY, tax-inclusive, SIGNED (BR-TXN-006): sale = the line's `amount_with_tax` (positive; a discount line negative — the sale rows of a billing sum to billings.total_amount); payment positive; refund = −the line's `refund_amount`; write_off negative (running-balance convention).

paymentMethod.description: payment rows: `payments.payment_method`; refund rows: derived from `refunds.refund_method` (API-116 MD:253) — sbps_void / sbps_partial_refund → sbps_credit, jaccs_manual → jaccs_bank, cashpost / cash / bank_transfer → same name; sale / write_off (v0.7 BR-TXN-001 #12): the member's CURRENT primary method (financial_infos is_primary AND is_active AND not deleted), null when none. Values = DBML `payment_method`.

status.description: Unified BR-TXN-002 display status mapped from the source raw enums.

rawStatus.description: Source-table raw status snapshot (audit aid). Keys vary by transactionType: sale→{confirmStatus, collectionStatus}, payment→{paymentStatus}, refund→{refundStatus}, write_off→{writeOffStatus}.

refundApplyContext.description: §4.4 / §7.1 BR-TXN-001 — derived per sale LINE lock-free (eventual-consistent; the detail EP re-validates under a NOWAIT lock). v0.7.3: `applicableAmount` = that line's remainder. Null for non-sale rows and when the line cannot be refunded (discount line, remainder 0, not refundable).

items.description: v0.7.3 §3.5: one signed row per sale LINE, refund LINE, payment and write-off in the window, sorted by `sortBy`/`sortDir` (default transactionDate desc; ties → rowKey asc). Counts and paging count these rows.

pagination.description: `{ page, limit, totalItems, totalPages }`, plus `totalAllItems` only when `includeTotalAll=true`.

name.description: File label — the document title, or `terms` when it has none.

path.description: PDF delivery URL (API-006) — the stored `public/terms/…` key on the public media origin, the same URL the CRM terms detail returns as `pdfUrl`. Readable without a token.

id.description: Terms document **UUID** — send these back verbatim on accept.

type.description: Y-04 terms_type.

brands.description: Brands the document applies to. **`[]` when the request sent no `brand`** — it echoes the query rather than deriving the real applicability.

description.example: ………
description.description: Viewer markup for `WebView.loadHtmlString` — the same document the by-type viewer serves: the stored `bodyText` (the CRM-extracted body, as a page) when the document has one, else **generated HTML** wrapping the stored PDF link. Null when the document has neither.

files.description: Attached PDF, as a single-element array. `[]` when the document has no stored file.

isAccept.description: Whether the member has accepted it. Computed as the negation of "consent required now".

showAgreeButton.description: Whether to show the agree button — the exact negation of `isAccept`.

termsIds.description: Terms version IDs the member consents to (1–20).

source.description: Consent context (terms_consent_source).

recorded.description: Newly-inserted consent rows. **Re-consenting to a version already accepted adds nothing**, so 0 can mean "all were already accepted" rather than a failure.

lastName.description: In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

firstName.description: In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

dateOfBirth.description: YYYY-MM-DD. In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

postalCode.description: 7 digits, no hyphen. In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

prefecture.description: JIS X 0401 code ("13") or the prefecture name ("東京都") — both accepted, as on PATCH /members/me. In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row). Note the legacy profile PATCH sends `addressId` instead, which is dropped — so a member who only went through the legacy profile screens still needs to supply this.

streetAddress.description: In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

phone.description: In the required merged set — only the SMS-OTP signup lane caches a phone, so an email-OTP or social-login applicant must supply one here. Yamauchi-mastered: written only when the member has no phone cached yet; an existing value is kept (change it via the OTP flow).

email.description: Yamauchi-mastered: written only when the member has no email cached yet (see `phone`).

emergencyContactLastName.description: Emergency contact last name (姓). In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

emergencyContactFirstName.description: Emergency contact first name (名). In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

emergencyContactPhone.description: Emergency contact phone — JP domestic, no hyphens. Hyphenated and `+81` input is normalised. In the required merged set. Send only if the stored member row does not already have it (server merges body over row).

facePhotoS3Key.description: API-006 face-photo S3 key. Body-only — the member row exposes a derived URL, not the key.

optionId.description: The option being contracted (`options.id`). For a locker this is the cabinet's fee option.

optionSetId.description: Option-set pick (`option_sets.id`). **Accepted, stored, and not yet expanded** into its member options — the set discount belongs to the API-145 pricing engine, so expanding it here would write full-price option contracts. Send the individual `optionId`s meanwhile.

lockerSlotId.description: The locker slot this option reserves (`locker_slots.id`). The slot is checked at submit and claimed inside the contract transaction, so it becomes `in_use` and is written back to `contracts.locker_slot_id`. At most one row in the array may carry one.

personalInfo.description: PII **top-up** for the members row (§3.4.1). Omit entirely when the row is already complete — the applicant reached this call only by passing the profile gate (`GET /members/me/verify` reports `empty`/`noImage` until the profile and face photo exist), so name / DOB / address / emergency contact are normally already stored. The server merges each field over the stored row and checks completeness on the merged result: `422 E-ENR-001` when a required field is missing from both.

promotionCode.description: Promotion / family / referral code as typed by the member; resolved server-side (§3.4). Send this OR `promotionCodeId`.

promotionCodeId.description: Pre-resolved promotion-code id. Prefer `promotionCode` — the spec defines only the typed code.

ogfType.description: OGF membership role — `owner` is the employee, `family` their household member. Accepted **only** alongside an `ogf_only` promotion code (the lane legacy keyed off a campaign code starting `OGF`); sent on any other lane the response is `400 E-VAL-001`. Requires `employeeCode`.

employeeCode.description: 従業員番号. Required when `ogfType` is set. One member at a time may hold a given code as `owner` — a second one is `400 E-VAL-001` with `details: [{ field: "employeeCode", code: "duplicate" }]`; family members reuse the employee’s code freely.

selectedOptionIds.description: Selected options, max 30. A bare option-id string is also accepted (legacy shape). A locker pick is an ordinary row carrying `lockerSlotId`; at most one row may carry one (two different slots → `400 E-VAL-001`).

calculatedAmounts.description: Accepted for compatibility and **ignored**: the initial charge is priced server-side from this body's `planId` / `selectedOptionIds` / `campaignId` (API-153 §5, the same computation as `GET /api/v1/sales/estimate-joining-fee`), and that is what is billed and recorded. A `totalInitial` that differs from the server price is logged, never used.

jaccsCallbackStatus.description: JACCS WebView callback status (only `completed` accepted for jaccs_bank).

usageStartDate.description: Plan usage start date (YYYY-MM-DD, today ≤ date ≤ today+2 months, JST). Same-day start is allowed.

parentApprovalAt.description: Parental consent timestamp (ISO 8601), required when the applicant is a minor.

termsConsents.description: OPTIONAL (API-153 §3.4 marks it required — optional until the spec owner rules). `[{ termsDocumentId, consentedAt? }]`. When sent, each termsDocumentId must exist, be active, published today and require consent (else 400 E-VAL-001), and one terms_consents row (enrollment_app) is written per entry. Omitted or [] → no consent row; the app can keep recording consent through POST /api/v1/mobile/terms/consents (API-076 §10) or the legacy member-term/accept facade.

memberStatus.description: **Always `provisional` at this point.** Activation happens in a downstream batch (BAT-016), so a successful submit does not make the member active.

kind.description: What happens next — e.g. staff review, or nothing further.

message.example: 申請を受け付けました。店舗スタッフが審査します。承認後にお知らせします
message.description: Ready-to-display Japanese message. **Null for kinds other than `under_review`** — render nothing rather than an empty string.

applicationNumber.description: A 10-digit human-readable receipt number, always exactly 10 digits.

status.description: Application state.

approvalMethod.description: How the application will be approved.

member.description: The member as of submission — `provisional`, not active.

nextStep.description: What the app should tell the applicant next.

memberId.description: Member ID — the only field guaranteed present.

memberNumber.description: Member number. **Absent when the member summary could not be loaded** (the object then carries `memberId` alone).

lastName.description: Family name. Absent when the summary could not be loaded.

firstName.description: Given name. Absent when the summary could not be loaded.

lastNameKana.description: Family name in katakana. Absent when the summary could not be loaded.

firstNameKana.description: Given name in katakana. Absent when the summary could not be loaded.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. Absent when the summary could not be loaded.

isMinor.description: Under 18 at the usage start date (FR-M004).

name.example: 2026 春の入会キャンペーン

status.description: Review status.

approvalMethod.description: How the application was approved (`manual` once approved). Null before approval.

enrollmentRoute.description: v1.19 FR-M001 入会経路, never null: `member_referral` code → `referral`; else `mobile_app` → `mobile`, `crm_direct` / `proxy` → `manual`.

member.description: The applicant. Degrades to `{ memberId }` when the summary lookup misses.

usageStartDate.description: Requested usage start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when unset.

blacklistMatchResult.description: Blacklist screen outcome. `unchecked` blocks the approval checklist.

blacklistMatchedAt.description: When the screen ran (ISO 8601 UTC). Null while `unchecked`.

appliedAt.description: When the application was filed (ISO 8601 UTC).

isReviewOverdue.description: v1.6 — the 「対応超過」 badge (C-01 FR-M001 L243). True when `status = submitted` and the row has been waiting longer than `reviewOverdueHours`. **Always false for any other status** — `under_review` means somebody has already started the review, so it is not 「未審査のまま」.

reviewOverdueHours.description: v1.6 — this row's brand threshold in hours (`stores.brand_enum → brands.review_overdue_hours`). Render the tooltip from this; never hard-code a threshold, and never compare `appliedAt` against the device clock. The value can differ per brand within one page.

pendingReviewCount.description: FR-M001 L242 「未審査件数」 — `COUNT(status = submitted)`. v1.6 corrected this: it counted `under_review`, which is the opposite of 未審査.

blacklistFlaggedCount.description: Applications whose blacklist screen returned a match.

overdueReviewCount.description: Supporting aggregate for the L243 alert — rows with `isReviewOverdue = true` in the caller’s role-scope baseline (v1.14 — not the filtered set), each measured against ITS OWN brand threshold. v1.6 corrected this too: it counted `under_review` rows against `updatedAt`.

items.description: Applications on this page, scoped to the caller (HQ sees all, manager their stores, staff their own store).

pagination.description: `totalAllItems` only when `includeTotalAll=true`.

kpi.description: Queue-wide counters for the review screen — computed over the caller’s role-scope baseline (no filters, page or sort). v1.14: absent when `includeKpi=false`.

value.description: **Always null.** The unmasked value is deliberately withheld.

masked.description: The masked rendering. Null when the source field is empty.
The masked rendering — prefecture plus a mask. Null when no prefecture is stored.

memberNumber.description: Member number.

yamauchiUserId.description: §4.3 v1.7 — Yamauchi API `User.id` (integer). Null until the account is linked.

originalMemberType.description: Member type before this application — the value a cancel rolls back to.

lastName.description: Family name. Null when unset.

lastNameKana.description: Family name in katakana. Null when unset.

firstNameKana.description: Given name in katakana. Null when unset.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth. Null when unset.

gender.description: §4.3 — renamed from `sex` in v1.3, matching the request field and `members.gender`. Null when unset.

ageAtApplication.description: §4.3 — age computed from `dateOfBirth` at the application `createdAt` (JST).

isMinor.description: Under 18 at the usage start date (FR-M004).

address.description: Address, masked. Every component is null except `masked`.

facePhotoSignedUrl.description: Asset URL; the BFF authorizes the staff reader and redirects to a short-lived signed URL. Null when no photo.

facePhotoRegisteredAt.description: members.face_photo_updated_at — null = unknown (photo stored before the column existed).

previousWithdrawalDate.description: §4.3 v1.5 — previous withdrawal date, snapshotted at application (from the 6a snapshot, not the live member row). Null when no previous withdrawal.

parentApprovalAt.description: When a guardian approved (ISO 8601 UTC). Null for adults.

name.example: 2026 春の入会キャンペーン

ownerMember.description: The code owner (referrer); null for codes without an owner.

enrollmentFee.description: JOYFIT 入会金 (tax-included, API-098 v1.11 §4.3); null for FIT365. Amounts are the stored snapshot — snapshots written before API-074 v0.8 hold tax-excluded values.

enrollmentFeeDiscount.description: Waiver / discount on the enrollment fee, any type. 0 = none.

maintenanceFee.description: FIT365 annual fee; not part of totalInitial.

prepaidMonths.description: `plans.prepaid_months` (N). The usage-start month is month 1 (API-098 v1.17 §4.3).

prepaidTotal.description: Plan months 1..N in the first charge (tax-included) = firstMonthProratedFee + monthly × (N − 1), each month an integer.

firstMonthProratedFee.description: Month-1 plan fee = floor(ceil(ceil(price × 100 / (100 + tax)) × D / L) × (100 + tax) / 100), price = the stored 税込 master (API-098 v1.22 §4.3); a start on the 1st is the full month.

nextMonthFee.description: Month-2 plan fee (full month, tax-included). Null when N = 1.

optionMonthlyTotal.description: Options, month 1 only (tax-included; prorated when the option prorates; per-use options excluded). 0 = no options.

campaignDiscountMonth1.description: Plan campaign discount in month 1 (positive, tax-included, prorated). Null when off or outside the apply window.

campaignDiscountMonth2.description: Plan campaign discount in month 2 (positive, tax-included). Null when off, outside the apply window, or N = 1.

campaignDiscountLaterMonths.description: Plan campaign discount for months 3..N together (positive, tax-included) — only on a plan prepaid 3 months or more, for the months inside the apply window. Null when none, or on an application recorded before months 3+ were discounted.

campaignOptionDiscountTotal.description: API-098 v1.17: option campaign discounts in the first charge (month 1 only, positive, tax-included). Null when none.

totalInitial.description: Render as returned — never re-sum the lines (TBD-C01-TOTAL-INITIAL-COMPOSITION).

matchedConditions.description: Subset of name_dob | email | phone | address, re-derived at read time.

matchedAt.description: When the screen ran (ISO 8601 UTC). Null while `unchecked`.

matchedRecords.description: Matched blacklist rows with their conditions re-derived at read time. Empty for none / unchecked.

displayName.description: Null when the staff directory has no name.

blacklistCheckCompleted.description: Derived — true once `blacklistMatchResult` is anything other than `unchecked`.

ageEligible.description: Age at the usage start date ≥ COALESCE(plans.min_age, brands.min_enrollment_age).

usageStartDateWithinTwoMonths.description: Derived — whether `usageStartDate` falls within 2 calendar months of today. False when the date is unset.

type.description: Discriminator. `event` rows carry `historyId`/`fromStatus`/`toStatus`/`comment`; `memo` rows carry `memoId`/`memo`/`canDelete`.

occurredAt.description: When it happened (ISO 8601 UTC) — the single sort key across both kinds.

actor.description: Who acted. Null for member / system events.

historyId.description: `event` rows only — the status-history row ID.

fromStatus.description: `event` rows only — status before the transition. Null for the first entry.

toStatus.description: `event` rows only — status after the transition.

comment.description: `event` rows only — comment pulled out of the history metadata.

rejectReasonCode.description: `event` rows only — the reject reason on a `toStatus=rejected` row; null on every other transition. Same value as the top-level `rejectReasonCode` for the latest rejection.

canDelete.description: `memo` rows only — whether **this caller** may delete it (own memo, or the `can_delete_others_application_memo` permission). Caller-dependent, so it differs per requester.

status.description: Review status.

approvalMethod.description: How the application was approved. Null before approval.

enrollmentRoute.description: v1.19 FR-M001 入会経路, never null: `member_referral` code → `referral`; else `mobile_app` → `mobile`, `crm_direct` / `proxy` → `manual`. The detail screen still shows the 2-value `applicationSource` (FR-M002).

member.description: The applicant with **masked** PII. Degrades to `{ memberId }` when the summary lookup misses.

corporate.description: Corporate contract as `{ corporateId, billingPattern }`. Null for individual applications.

usageStartDate.description: Requested usage start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Null when unset.

paymentMethod.description: Chosen payment method. Null when unset.

calculatedAmounts.description: §4.3 — the 17 keys from the application-time snapshot.

enrollmentFeeWaiver.description: v1.5 enrollment-fee waiver: `{ type: campaign|reenrollment|staff, reason, appliedAt, appliedBy }`. **Null = no waiver.** `reason`/`appliedBy` are non-null only for `staff`. Show the 「個別に免除する」 affordance only when status is submitted/under_review AND this is null AND `calculatedAmounts.enrollmentFee > 0`.

reenrollmentWaiver.description: v1.5 re-enrollment waiver rule state: `{ ruleDays, eligible, daysSinceWithdrawal, excludedReason }`, derived on read. **Null = the brand has no rule** → hide the 「再入会免除規則」 row entirely. Render `ruleDays`; never hard-code a day count.

sameDayCancelCount.description: v1.7 — same-day cancel count of the applicant member (every status, 0 included). Same counter as the §8 cancel guard.

sameDayCancelLimit.description: v1.7 — same-day cancel limit. Render 「当日取り消し回数 n / limit」 from these two fields; do not hard-code the 2.

blacklist.description: Blacklist screen state. `matchedRecords` is always empty here.

contract.description: The contract created on approval; null until approved.

approvalChecklist.description: Derived pre-approval checks. `ageEligible` is a placeholder — see the DTO.

timeline.description: Status events and memos merged and sorted ascending by `occurredAt`. Read `type` before reading the other fields.

appliedAt.description: When the application was filed (ISO 8601 UTC).

lastStatusChangeAt.description: When the status last changed. Falls back to `appliedAt` when there is no history yet.

approvedAt.description: Latest to_status=approved history row. Same rule for the fields below.

streetAddress.example: 札幌市中央区北1条西1丁目

phoneNumber.description: `members.phone` as stored — E.164 (v1.23.4; was the domestic form). Display formatting is the frontend's job.

optionSetId.description: The option set the option was picked from, when the plan offers sets.

lockerSlotId.description: Required for locker options — the specific slot; conflicts are rejected at approve time.

memberId.description: v1.5 — re-enrollment estimate: the §5.3 automatic-waiver judgement runs against this member.

enrollmentFee.description: JOYFIT 入会金 (tax-included, API-098 v1.11 §4.3); null for FIT365. Amounts are the stored snapshot — snapshots written before API-074 v0.8 hold tax-excluded values.

enrollmentFeeDiscount.description: Waiver / discount on the enrollment fee, any type. 0 = none.

maintenanceFee.description: FIT365 annual fee; not part of totalInitial.

prepaidMonths.description: `plans.prepaid_months` (N). The usage-start month is month 1 (API-098 v1.17 §4.3).

prepaidTotal.description: Plan months 1..N in the first charge (tax-included) = firstMonthProratedFee + monthly × (N − 1), each month an integer.

firstMonthProratedFee.description: Month-1 plan fee = floor(ceil(ceil(price × 100 / (100 + tax)) × D / L) × (100 + tax) / 100), price = the stored 税込 master (API-098 v1.22 §4.3); a start on the 1st is the full month.

nextMonthFee.description: Month-2 plan fee (full month, tax-included). Null when N = 1.

optionMonthlyTotal.description: Options, month 1 only (tax-included; prorated when the option prorates; per-use options excluded). 0 = no options.

isAccepting.description: Writable whatever the reference count (v0.16). false → acceptance_stop_reason = manual; true → cleared. true while the limit after this PATCH is non-null and appliedCount >= it → 409 E-CMP-019. Wins over the capacity transition when sent with capacityLimit.

capacityLimit.description: First-come capacity cap (FR-002, §5.2 v0.4). Integer `>= 1`, or null = uncapped (`< 1` → 400 E-VAL-001). Writable whatever the reference count (v0.13 / v0.16). Below the current appliedCount → 409 E-CMP-016. Without isAccepting in the body the capacity transition runs against the new limit in the same transaction: equal to appliedCount stops an accepting campaign (capacity_reached); null or above appliedCount resumes a capacity_reached stop. A manual stop is untouched.

changedByName.description: Staff display name from the auth-svc staff directory. The spec (§14.3) marks it not-null; the server returns null when the directory has no name for `changedBy` (decision 2026-10-08, same as plan history) instead of inventing a placeholder.

diff.description: Server-computed `{ field: { prev, next } }` against the row immediately before this one in the campaign's WHOLE history — the eventType / from / to filters are ignored for this, so a filtered view still shows the real change. Null for the first `created` event.

metadata.description: Event context — `{ operationPath }`. Null when the event carries none.

items.description: History entries, newest first (changed_at DESC, id DESC).

pagination.description: page / limit paging. No `totalAllItems` — this EP has no includeTotalAll (§14.2).

name.description: Name of the new campaign, used as sent (trimmed). The server adds no 「（コピー）」 suffix and does not reject duplicate names.

canDelete.description: Server-computed (§9.3): `activeContractCount = 0 AND pendingApplicationCount = 0` — whether DELETE passes the in-use guard (E-CMP-003).

from.description: Applied lower bound; null = open (all time).

to.description: Applied upper bound; null = open (all time).

manual.description: `application_source IN (crm_direct, proxy)` and not a referral.

referral.description: The application's promotion code has `scope_type = member_referral` (wins over the source).

period.description: The window actually applied. Both null = all time.

appliedCount.description: FR-S001 適用件数 — membership_applications with status IN (submitted, under_review, approved), filtered on created_at when a period is given (enrollment-svc).

activeContractCount.description: Active contracts under the campaign — point-in-time snapshot; the period is NOT applied.

sourceBreakdown.description: FR-S001 入会経路別内訳 — exactly mobile / manual / referral (0 when none); same filter as appliedCount.

deleteReason.description: `deleted` events: the mandatory delete reason (§6.3 / §7.3). Rows written before the change of record may lack it — fall back to `meta.reason`.

meta.description: Extra context when there is any (`action`, `reason`, `count`, `imageId`, `imageS3Key`, `duplicatedFrom`, `auditCode`) — e.g. which kind of `updated` event it was.

lessonId.description: The lesson the event belongs to.

eventType.description: What happened. Image add/remove/reorder and restriction replacements are `updated` (`snapshot.meta.action` tells them apart); BOTH delete outcomes — real delete and deactivate-instead — are `deleted`; reactivating a deactivated lesson (isActive false→true) is `restored` (§6.7). A duplicate is `created` on the new lesson.

snapshot.description: The §5.1 `Lesson` object as it stood right after the change (API-111 §5.2), at the top level. Stored with exactly the §5.1 fields — id, brand, storeId, name, description, lessonType, durationMinutes, feeType, fee, genderRestriction, isTrialCourse, note, isActive, `images[]` (id, imageS3Key, displayOrder, createdAt), `planRestrictions[]`, `optionRestrictions[]`, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt — with the plan / option names as they were then; a write whose names contracts-svc cannot answer is refused (E-SYS-001), so a snapshot is never partial. On read the images get their delivery `url`, as on the detail. Older rows (stored as `{ lesson: <raw row> }`) are reshaped to the same top-level shape on read, with today's names (a plan / option deleted since drops out). A `deleted` event adds `deleteReason` (§7.3); `meta` carries extra context when there is any.

changedBy.description: Staff ID that made the change.

changedByName.description: Display name of that staff (auth-svc directory). Empty string when the directory has no entry for them.

changedByRole.description: v0.9 — The changer's CURRENT CRM role (staffs.position_id → positions.role, read at request time) — not the role held when the change was made. Always set while the staff row resolves (null only on a staff-directory miss, where changedByName is '').

changedAt.description: When the change was applied (ISO 8601 UTC).

items.description: History entries on this page, newest first.

lessonId.description: Lesson master being run.

lessonName.description: Lesson name. (A schedule whose lesson was deleted is not a slot.)

fee.description: Pre-spec: per-use fee in JPY, tax-included (API-111 §6.9). Null for `free` / `monthly_plan`.

storeId.description: Store the session runs at.

studioId.description: Studio the session occupies. Null when none (personal training).

trainerIds.description: Assigned trainers, display order ASC. Never empty — a session nobody teaches is not a slot.

trainerNames.description: Trainer display names (`姓 名`), index-aligned with `trainerIds`.

startAt.description: Slot start: the store-local (JST) date + start time as an instant (ISO 8601 UTC).

endAt.description: Slot end as an instant: the stored end time, which includes the MAX post-buffer of the assigned trainers (§6.1.2). Rolls into the next day when the end time passes midnight.

durationMinutes.description: Lesson duration in minutes, buffers excluded (`lessons.duration_minutes`).

bufferBeforeMin.description: Pre-buffer: MAX `buffer_before_min` over the assigned trainers (most restrictive).

bufferAfterMin.description: Post-buffer: MAX `buffer_after_min` over the assigned trainers.

remainingCapacity.description: `capacity −` the live bookings API-113 §6.1 #12 counts — normal bookings only when `trialCapacityMode = additive`, every live booking otherwise (v0.11) — floored at 0 (PT / body care: 1 or 0, a trial booking included). A full session is still listed, with 0.

remainingTrialCapacity.description: Trial seats still open; null when the session takes no trials. `additive`: `trialCapacityLimit − live trial bookings`; `inclusive`: that, but no more than `capacity − every live booking` (the trial seats come out of the capacity) — API-113 §6.1 #9.

bookedCount.description: Pre-spec: live (reserved / pending / attended) NON-trial bookings.

trialCapacityMode.description: Trial-seat accounting mode. Null when trials are not configured.

trialCapacityLimit.description: Trial-seat limit. Null when trials are not configured.

items.description: Bookable slots on this page, by start ascending (paginated after the cut-off / lesson-type filtering).

available.description: Pre-spec: always true — the occupancy figures are live counts.

lessonId.description: Lesson (v0.10): existing, not deleted, active, and of the store brand (§6.9 #0).

studioId.description: Studio (v0.10): required for a studio lesson, optional for body care, forbidden for personal training; must be a studio of storeId (§6.9 #0).

daysOfWeek.description: Days of week, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; non-empty, no duplicates.

skipHolidays.description: Skip holidays when a recurrence built from this expands.

isActive.description: False hides the template from the new-recurrence picker; existing recurrences are unaffected.

storeId.description: Store the template belongs to.

otherBookerCount.description: Prototype addition, `view=trainer-self` only (null in other views): live bookers not named in `bookerNames` (the 他N名), trial ones included.

view.description: Echo of the requested `view`. **The payload shape does not change with it** — the view only pre-applies a scope (`trainer-self` = your own trainer).

warnings.description: Soft warnings. **Empty on a clean save (and always on a read); a non-empty array does NOT mean the write failed** — the schedule was stored either way.

lesson.description: The lesson being run — also when its master has been deleted since (`lesson.deletedAt` set; API-111 §6.3). Null only if the lesson row no longer exists at all.

studio.description: The room, with its physical capacity and buffer — also when deleted since (`studio.deletedAt` set). Null for sessions without a studio (PT).

recurrence.description: Additive (FE request; the spec is silent): the rule this session came from, for the repeat label. Null on a one-off (`recurrenceId` null).

trainerRows.description: One row per assigned trainer (display order ASC, trainer id as tie-breaker) for the FR-007 header — same ids as `trainerIds`; an id whose trainer row no longer exists is left out.

bookingSummary.description: Booking breakdown by status over every booking of the schedule (§5.1), plus the pre-spec occupancy keys.

affectedBookingCount.description: Live (reserved / pending / attended, trial included) bookings on the schedule when this edit moves its date, start time, studio or trainer SET (§6.2 #4 — a reorder or a resent unchanged value moves nothing); 0 otherwise. The members still due to come (reserved / pending) are each sent N-029 `changeLessonSchedule` after commit; re-pricing those bookings is not done here.

storeId.description: Store the session runs at.

studioId.description: Studio the session occupies. Null for sessions with no studio (e.g. personal training).

capacity.description: Row-level capacity (v0.8): auto-set from the studio (PT/body_care = 1), operator-overridable within the studio band. Bookings enforce against this.

isPublished.description: Whether the session is visible to members.

isCancelled.description: Whether the session was cancelled. Cancellation is idempotent and keeps the row.

trialCapacityMode.description: How trial-visit seats count against capacity — `inclusive` takes them from the lesson capacity, `additive` adds them on top. Null when trials are not configured.

trialCapacityLimit.description: Trial-visit seat limit. Null when trials are not configured.

schedule.description: The cancelled schedule (§5.1 shape). On an already-cancelled one (idempotent 200) it is returned unchanged.

affectedBookingCount.description: Bookings the booking cascade cancelled in the same transaction (§6.3 #4): every `reserved` / `pending` one (trial included) — `cancelled_by_trainer` for the trainer-absence categories, `cancelled_by_staff` otherwise — seat released; each member is sent N-030. Attended / no-show bookings stay as they are. `0` on an idempotent repeat (nothing cascaded by that call). Refund / remaining-count restore: not done here yet (same as API-113's cancel).

stopFurtherExpansion.description: True (default): also deactivate the recurrence so it generates no more. False: keep it active — it carries on generating past the cancelled stretch (e.g. a renovation gap).

recurrenceId.description: The recurrence the cancelled sessions belong to (a one-off anchor is E-LSC-017, never answered here).

affectedScheduleCount.description: Sessions cancelled: the anchor and every later NON-cancelled one of the recurrence (same date + later start included).

affectedBookingCount.description: Bookings the booking cascade cancelled across the cancelled sessions, in the same transaction — same rules as a single cancel (`reserved` / `pending` only, cause status by category, seat released, N-030 per member per session).

stoppedExpansion.description: Echo of `stopFurtherExpansion`: true when the recurrence was also deactivated (stops generating); false when it keeps generating past the gap.

fromDate.description: Pre-spec: the anchor date — sessions on and after this were cancelled.

cancelledIds.description: Pre-spec: IDs of the cancelled sessions.

startTime.description: New start time (HH:mm) for every target row; each row's endTime is recomputed server-side. `endTime` itself is not accepted.

studioId.description: New studio of the anchor's store. Judged per target row by that row's own lesson (§6.12 #4 / #4a): a personal-training row = 400 E-VAL-001; a studio-lesson row whose capacity is above the room's capacity + buffer = 422 E-LSC-004 (nothing is updated); body care takes it with no band.

trainerIds.description: New trainer set — full-replaced on every target row AND on the recurrence (future expansions). An empty array (the cohort holds published rows; `details[]` field `trainerIds`), an unknown / deleted or duplicate id (`details[]` field `trainerIds.<index>`) = 422 E-LSC-021.

changeReason.description: Audit reason, written to every affected row's history entry. Missing, null or blank = 422 E-LSC-022.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optimistic lock on the ANCHOR row's `updatedAt`; 409 E-LSC-014 when stale.

updatedCount.description: How many sessions received the change.

conflictedDates.description: Dates whose updated session now overlaps another schedule of an assigned trainer. SOFT: those rows were still updated — the operator resolves the clashes afterwards.

skippedCancelledCount.description: Sessions inside the date window that were skipped because they are already cancelled.

recurrenceId.description: The recurrence of the anchor occurrence (a one-off anchor is E-LSC-017, never answered here).

fromDate.description: The anchor date — the cohort is this occurrence and every later one.

fromTime.description: The anchor start time (HH:mm) — a later session on the same date is in the cohort, an earlier one is not.

scheduleCount.description: Sessions a from-here write would touch: the anchor and every later NON-cancelled one of the recurrence that exists now — no date window. Sessions an unlimited rule has not generated yet are not counted (they hold no bookings).

lastScheduledDate.description: Date of the last session in the cohort; null when the cohort is empty (e.g. the anchor and everything after it is already cancelled).

bookingCount.description: Bookings on those sessions a from-here write reaches — `reserved` / `pending`, trial included: the members update-from-here sends N-029 to and the bookings cancel-from-here cancels (N-030). Attended / no-show / cancelled bookings are not counted.

trialBookingCount.description: Of `bookingCount`, the trial bookings (`isTrial`). `bookingCount − trialBookingCount` = the paid / plan bookings (e.g. a per-use refund estimate).

byStatus.description: Every status present, as counted — keeps the cancellation causes apart. `{}` when the schedule had no booking.

bookingsAggregate.description: Booking counts by status at the time of the event (all zero on a `created` event). Null on entries written before 2026-10-06, which did not record them.

eventType.description: What happened to the schedule. `memo_updated` / `memo_deleted` are written by API-113 (session memo).

changeReason.description: Reason supplied with the change — always set on `updated` / `cancelled` / `cancelled_from_here`; null when none was given, and on a generated `created` row (recurrence fan-out / BAT-038 top-up — rows generated before this release carry a provenance text instead).

snapshot.description: The schedule as it stood after the event (§5.4). Null only on session-memo entries written before 2026-10-06, which recorded no schedule state.

changedBy.description: Staff ID that made the change. Null only on rows written by a batch with no acting staff (the BAT-038 recurrence top-up); every API write stamps the caller.

changedByName.description: Display name of `changedBy`, resolved from the staff directory (`last_name + " " + first_name`). Empty string when the staff id is unknown to the directory, the lookup is unavailable, or `changedBy` is null — never omitted.

changedByRole.description: v0.14 — The changer's CURRENT CRM role (staffs.position_id → positions.role, read at request time) — not the role held when the change was made. Always set while the staff row resolves (null only on a staff-directory miss, where changedByName is '').

items.description: History entries on this page.

storeId.description: Store the penalty was issued at.

from.description: Exclusive lower bound (ISO 8601 UTC): the LATER of `startAt − 7 days` (BR-PEN-002's trailing week) and the `startAt` of this member's previous penalty of the same `penaltyType` (BAT-040 §6.2 watermark — evidence already punished once is not counted again).

to.description: Inclusive upper bound (ISO 8601 UTC) = the penalty's `startAt` (BAT-040 issues at its own run time).

offenceType.description: `no_show` (無断欠席) or `late_cancellation` — a member cancellation of a confirmed booking inside the notice window (the strictest assigned trainer's `min_booking_hours` before the start).

eventAt.description: When the offence happened (ISO 8601 UTC): the session start for a no-show, `cancelledAt` for a late cancellation. The list is ordered by it, oldest first.

storeId.description: Store the penalty was issued at.

penaltyType.description: Which booking category the ban covers. **`body_care` is out of Phase 1** (BR-PEN-008), so only `studio` / `personal_training` are issued today.

clearedByName.description: Display name of the clearing staff (auth-svc staff directory). Null when not cleared or the staff id cannot be resolved.

clearedAt.description: When the penalty was cleared (ISO 8601 UTC). Null unless cleared.

clearReason.description: Reason given for clearing. Null unless cleared.

sourceWindow.description: Prototype-driven (D-01 penalty release dialog 「対象週」), derived — not in §5.3: the window `(from, to]` the no-show batch (BAT-040) counted offences over when it issued this penalty.

sourceBookings.description: Prototype-driven (D-01 penalty release dialog 「対象となった予約」), derived — not in §5.3: the member's offences of this `penaltyType` inside `sourceWindow`, oldest first, by the batch's own rule (any store). **Derived at read time from the bookings' CURRENT statuses** — nothing is snapshotted at issuance: a no-show later reverted to 未確認 (POST /lesson-bookings/{id}/revert-attendance) drops out, a booking marked no-show afterwards appears, so the length can differ from `noShowCount` (the snapshot at detection). `[]` for a type the batch does not penalise (`body_care`).

clearReason.description: Why the penalty is being lifted (BR-PEN-004 — mandatory, non-blank after trim; this overrides an automatic sanction).

remainingCount.description: Remaining this cycle (`option_contracts.remaining_count`, API-094 SoT) — decremented at attendance (§6.3 #6), reset on the 1st by BAT-067. A contract whose count was never seeded (the enrollment cascade, Yashio migrated data) reads as `monthlyTotal` (§5.5 v0.10).

carryoverCount.description: Carried over from the previous cycle. Phase 1: always 0 (TBD-D01-CARRYOVER — no carryover column yet).

carryoverExpiresAt.description: Carryover expiry (`YYYY-MM-DD`); null = no carryover or no expiry. Phase 1: always null.

effectiveRemaining.description: Bookable now = `remainingCount` + `carryoverCount` while `carryoverExpiresAt` is null or not past today (JST). The FE's 「あと N 回」. Phase 1: = `remainingCount`.

penaltyType.description: The lesson category the penalty bans (a studio penalty does not block a PT booking).

endAt.description: When the ban lapses (ISO 8601 UTC) — 「予約不可期間中（〇月〇日まで）」.

contracts.description: Monthly-plan option contracts in force; `[]` if none — or if `available` is false. For a manager / staff / observer only the contracts held at one of their stores (the option's store, else its contract's).

activePenalty.description: The penalty in force (`active`, `endAt` still ahead) that ends LAST; null when there is none. For a manager / staff / observer: the first of `activePenalties` as narrowed to their stores.

activePenalties.description: Additive: EVERY penalty in force, latest end first — a member can be banned from studio and PT at once, and the booking form needs the one matching its lesson type. For a manager / staff / observer only those issued at one of their stores.

available.description: Pre-spec key, kept. `false` only when contracts-svc could not be asked (down, or not yet deployed with ListLessonOptionContracts) — then `contracts` is empty because it is UNKNOWN, not because the member has no plan. Do not render "no sessions left" from it.

seatNumber.description: `studio_seats.seat_number` — `normal` seats only; null for equipment / structure / empty cells.

seatType.description: FR-007 colour code: `normal` (blue when held, white when free), `equipment` (orange — 器材席), `structure` (gray — 固定物/柱), `empty` (no seat in the cell).

rowIndex.description: 0-based grid row (`studio_seats.row_index`). `seats` is sorted (rowIndex, columnIndex) ASC.

bookingId.description: Set when `seatType=normal` AND an active booking (`reserved` / `pending` / `attended`) holds this seat; otherwise null. A `pending` hold is not a free seat — booking it is 422 E-LSB-009.

bookingStatus.description: Status of the booking in `bookingId` (`pending` = 仮予約). Null when `bookingId` is null.

memberId.description: Member of the booking in `bookingId` (the seat popover's 会員詳細 link). Null when `bookingId` is null.

memberDisplayName.description: Display name of the member in `memberId` (a `pending` holder included). Null when `bookingId` is null or the member cannot be resolved from the directory.

capacity.description: `lesson_schedules.capacity` — the schedule row's own capacity (PT / body care: 1).

trialCapacityMode.description: `lesson_schedules.trial_capacity_mode`; null = no trial bookings on this schedule. Drives `available` (§6.6).

confirmed.description: §4.3 — `reserved + attended` (v0.9 GAP-108; the `available` formulas read it). **Changed from the pre-spec meaning** (status `reserved` only, which is now `reserved`).

reserved.description: §4.3 — status `reserved` (予約済（確定）, not yet attended).

cancelledByStaff.description: Cancellations staff made on the member’s behalf.

cancelled.description: §4.3 (v0.14 — R-34) — `cancelledByMember + cancelledByStaff + cancelledByTrainer`, the FR-007 統計パネル キャンセル bar. `noShow` is not included.

noShow.description: Status `no_show` (無断キャンセル). A no-show frees its seat.

trialBookings.description: §4.3 — trial bookings among `confirmed` (`is_trial` and reserved / attended).

available.description: §6.6 — normal-bookable slots left. No trial mode or `inclusive`: `capacity − confirmed − pending`; `additive`: `capacity − (confirmed − trialBookings) − (pending − pending trials)`. Never below 0.

seats.description: §4.3 — the WHOLE seat grid of the session's studio, sorted (rowIndex, columnIndex). `[]` for PT / body care, or a studio with no layout.

memo.description: Session memo text (FR-011), trimmed, non-blank. The cap depends on the schedule's lesson type: **PT 1–10,000 chars, studio 1–5,000** (over the cap → 400 E-VAL-001 `memo`/`too_long`).

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optimistic-lock guard — the memo's last `updatedAt` (= the schedule's `updated_at`). **PATCH only**: a stale value is 409 E-LSB-017. Accepted and ignored on POST.

scheduleId.description: Pre-spec name of `lessonScheduleId` (same value). Kept while clients move over — read `lessonScheduleId`.

lessonType.description: The schedule's `lessons.lesson_type` — drives the FE input format and the memo length cap (PT 10,000 / studio 5,000). Null only if the lesson row cannot be resolved.

updatedAt.description: The schedule row's `updated_at` as of this memo write (ISO 8601 UTC). Send it back as `expectedUpdatedAt` on PATCH.

reason.description: Why the memo was removed. Recorded in the schedule history; omit for no reason.

memberDisplayName.description: §5.1 `last_name + first_name` (space-separated) from the auth-svc member directory — the only member-identifying field on a booking. Null only when the directory cannot resolve the member: unknown id, a profile with no name yet, or auth-svc unreachable (the booking is still returned).

optionContractId.description: Option contract the seat is drawn from. Null for per-use and trial bookings.

studioSeatId.description: Assigned studio seat. Null when the studio has no seat map or none was requested.

attendedAt.description: When the member checked in (ISO 8601 UTC). Null until attendance is recorded.

attendedVia.description: How attendance was recorded. Null until the member attends.

cancelledAt.description: When the booking was cancelled (ISO 8601 UTC). Null unless cancelled.

cancelledByStaffId.description: Staff operator who cancelled — `lesson_bookings.cancelled_by`. Null for a member-cause cancellation and for live bookings.

cancelledBy.description: Pre-spec name of `cancelledByStaffId` (same value). Kept while clients move over — read `cancelledByStaffId`. NOT the cancel cause: the cause is `status` here, and the `cancelledBy` request field of POST /cancel.

notes.description: Free-text staff notes on the booking. Null when unset.

pendingExpiresAt.description: When a `pending` booking lapses (ISO 8601 UTC). Null once confirmed or for bookings that never pend.

seatNumber.description: Additive (prototype スペース column): the NUMBER of the seat `studioSeatId` points at (`studio_seats.seat_number`). Null when the booking holds no seat (PT / body care, or a released seat).

hasActivePenalty.description: §4.1 — the member has a penalty in force (`active` and `endAt` still ahead) whose `penaltyType` matches THIS session's lesson type (ペナルティ中 badge). A studio penalty does not badge a PT booking.

activePenaltyEndAt.description: Additive (prototype 「ペナルティ中（4/20まで）」): `endAt` of that penalty (ISO 8601 UTC). Null when `hasActivePenalty` is false.

activePenaltyNoShowCount.description: Additive (prototype hover 「無断キャンセル2回」): `noShowCount` of that penalty. Null when `hasActivePenalty` is false.

optionName.description: §4.1 — plan display name (`options.name` of the bound option contract). Null unless `paymentType=monthly_plan` (render 都度 for `per_use`), and null when contracts-svc could not be asked or does not know the contract — the list itself is still answered.

monthlySessionCount.description: §4.1 — the plan's monthly total (`options.monthly_session_count`, the 「月4回」 part). Same nulls as `optionName`.

Same nulls as `optionName`. 残回数不足 is FE-derived: `remainingCount = 0` and `status` reserved / pending. Decremented at attendance (§6.3 #6), reset on the 1st (BAT-067); a contract whose count was never seeded reads the plan total (v0.10).

id.description: **Always null.** The row is UUID-keyed and the shipped client parses this slot as `(json.id as num?)`, which raises a Dart `TypeError` on a string — an `Error`, not an `Exception`, so it escapes every catch on the splash path and breaks launch. No client reads it. It can carry the UUID once the app moves the field to `String?`.

iosVersionCode.description: iOS user-visible version string (`ios_version_name`). Legacy called it a "code".

releasedAt.description: Release date (date-only column, serialised at UTC midnight).

adminId.description: **Always null**, for the same reason as `id`. The real value is `app_versions.created_by` (a staff UUID).

updatedAt.description: Null until the row is first PATCHed (the column has no `@updatedAt`).

id.description: **Always null**, for the same reason as `LegacyAppVersionDto.id`.

allowMemberIds.description: **Always `[]`.** Legacy allow-listed MEMBER ids; `app_maintenance_allowed_users` holds STAFF ids and its endpoints are deferred (API-073 §2). The app reads an empty list as "everyone is locked out", which is also what legacy did for a window with no allow-list.

endDate.description: Window end (`ends_at`).

brand.description: Echoes the requested `brand`. A window stored as `target_brand: all` matches every brand and still reports the brand asked about.

following.description: Whether the caller follows this author.

name.description: Routine name the session was started from. Null for a quick-start session.

time.description: Duration in seconds. Legacy named this `time`, not `duration` — the DTO said `duration` and the service returned `time`.

personal.description:
How many of the four personal bests — max weight, reps, volume, estimated 1RM — this workout holds for its author (legacy `achieved`, 0…4). It counts METRICS, not exercises, which is why it is not `training.personal_records` (best volume *per exercise*). Null when the batch lookup could not be reached; the card still renders.

Legacy's own feed emitted **4 for every workout with sets** — `feeds.service.ts` passed the session's own sets as the all-time-history argument, so each maximum was attained by definition. That constant is not reproduced: the real 0…4 that `trainings/history` shows is used on both screens.

title.description: Workout title. Mapped from the **post** title, which is what the create-post screen names the workout in v2.

profile.description: Author. The card names the avatar `avatar`; the Comment Page names the same value `image`.

workout.description: Null unless the post is attached to a strength session.

aerobicRecord.description: Null unless the post is attached to an aerobic session.

feedFiles.description: Every attached image/video, in sort order.

totalComment.description: Total comments on the post, excluding authors in a block relation with the caller. Stamps are a separate axis and are not counted here.

caption.description: Post body (legacy `caption`); falls back to the title when the body is empty.

shareScopes.description: Legacy `ShareScope`. **The key the app reads** — legacy's service emitted `shareScopes` while its DTO declared `shareScope`, so both are returned.

shareScope.description: Same value as `shareScopes`, under the name the legacy DTO/Swagger declared.

comments.description: The **two newest** comments — legacy's card carried a `ROW_NUMBER() … <= 2` preview, not the whole thread. The full list is `GET /feeds/comments/{feedId}`. Note the shape differs from that endpoint's rows: no `id`, `memberId` at the top level, and the profile key is `avatar`.

isReaction.description: Whether the caller has any reaction (like or stamp) on this post.

date.description: The day. Legacy emitted a raw `created_at` on the body branch; normalised to a date here.

status.description: Legacy `StatusCalendarEnum`. The `body` branch only ever produces `completed` — a record either exists or the day is absent.

date.description: Bucket key — `YYYY-MM-DD` per day, or `YYYY-MM` when `chartRangeType=1_year` groups by month.

value.description: The quantity named by `type`, summed over the bucket.

date.description: Bucket key. `YYYY-MM-DD` for `1_week`; the week-of-month index for `1_month`; `YYYY-MM` for `1_year`.

maxVolume.description: 最大ボリューム — the highest single-set `reps × weight` in the bucket.

maxVolumeString.description: 最大ボリューム文字列 — `reps`x`weight` of the set behind `maxVolume`. `0x0` for an empty bucket.

type.description: Union key of the app`s `CreateAerobicRecordRequest`. May be omitted when `runningMachine` or `bikeMachine` is present — either one identifies the discipline.

title.description: Falls back to a generated `ランニング YYYY/MM/DD`.

recordTime.description: When the session happened. Absent or unparseable → now.

runningMachine.description: Running discipline only. Matched against `mst_aerobic_machine_types.code`, which is spelled exactly like the app`s enum; an unknown code falls back to the category placeholder rather than failing the write.

bikeMachine.description: Bike discipline only. Same matching rule as `runningMachine`.

condition.description: Legacy vocabulary; stored as v2`s `good`/`neutral`/`poor`. Unknown values are stored as null.

distance.description: Kilometres, fractional. Required — `aerobic_training_sets.distance_km` is NOT NULL.

duration.description: Whole seconds, > 0. Required — `aerobic_training_sets.duration_seconds` is NOT NULL.

consumeCalories.description: Accepted and ignored. The app estimates from a hardcoded 70 kg; training-svc computes from the machine`s METs and the member`s registered weight.

trainingScheduleId.description: The Calendar aerobic plan this record fulfils — the `trainingSchedules[].id` from `GET /schedules`. Stored, and it is what flips that plan to `isCompleted: true` with its totals. Omit it for a record logged outside the Calendar. Refused when the plan is not the caller`s aerobic plan (404 E-SCH-002), already holds a record (400 E-AER-007), or is for the other discipline (400 E-AER-008).

startDate.description: Goal start. Must not be in the past — back-dating one would move the `startWeight` the chart measures against.

endDate.description: Target date, or null for an open-ended goal.

targetValue.description: Target body weight in kg (an absolute weight, not a loss).

id.description: A **UUID** in v2, where legacy returned an int.

memberId.description: A **UUID** in v2, where legacy returned an int.

id.description: Gate event **UUID** — the entry event when there is one, otherwise the exit (the app still declares an int).

entryTime.description: When they came in. **Null means the entry was never recorded** — that is what makes the popup say "check-in not confirmed".

exitTime.description: When they left. Null on an open visit.

storeId.description: Store of the anchor event.

stayTime.description: Seconds between the two halves; null unless the visit is complete.

entringFlag.description: Legacy 入館中フラグ — 1 while the visit is still open.

entrySeq.description: **Always null** — Yamauchi import column, no v2 source.

contractId.description: **Always null** — as `entrySeq`.

goal.description: The weight goal in force on `date`. **`{}` when the member has never set one** — legacy returned an empty object, not null, and the app spreads it.

currentWeight.description: Latest weighing at or before `date`. Falls back to the weight on the fitness profile, then null.

startWeight.description: The weighing the goal started from — the latest one before the goal`s start date. Null when the member had not weighed in by then.

value.description: kcal burned / kg lifted / km covered on that JST day.

startDayOfWeek.description: Weekday the goal window is anchored to (0 = Sunday). **1 when the member has no goal**, so the bar still renders a week.

targetValue.description: `0` is the "no goal set" signal, not an error.

processBar.description: Seven days from the anchor. **Legacy spelling** — the shipped app reads this key.

progressBar.description: Identical to `processBar`, under the name API-126 gave it. Emitted so both spellings resolve.

optionName.description: The connected device`s own name. Legacy read the member`s contracted option name; the option master lives in another service, and joining it per row would make a cross-service fan-out of a screen read.

optionImage.description: Always null — gate devices carry no image in v2.

id.description: A **UUID** in v2, where legacy returned an int.

type.description: Aerobic category code (`run` | `bike`).

duration.description: Minutes — v2 stores seconds and converts here, as legacy stored minutes.

runningMachine.description: Machine-type code, set only when the category is `run`.

bikeMachine.description: Machine-type code, set only when the category is `bike`.

secondaryMuscle.description: An array, as legacy`s enum-array column was. v2 stores ONE secondary muscle, so this is a 0- or 1-element array — `[]` when none is set. Declared nullable (array and items) to match the app`s `List<String?>?`; v2 never sends null.

image.description: Stable asset URL, resolved from the stored S3 key.

name.description: The routine`s name. Null for a free session — legacy rendered null rather than a placeholder.

duration.description: Minutes. A member-edited duration wins over the clock (API-019 §5).

activity.description: Either one of the five planned slots (`wakeUp` | `breakfast` | `lunch` | `dinner` | `sleep`) or one of the six recorded kinds (`bodyInfomation` | `training` | `aerobicRecord` | `getInStore` | `getOutStore` | `deviceLog`). `bodyInfomation` is legacy`s spelling, typo included.

id.description: The day`s row id, or **null for a future day** — legacy shaped a future day without storing it.

targetCalories.description: The day`s calorie target. Carried forward from the most recent earlier day, so it persists without being re-entered. Distinct from the weekly kcal goal.

timeline.description: The five planned slots merged with everything the member actually recorded that day, sorted by time.

date.description: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY/MM/DD`.

targetCalories.description: Cannot be set on a day already past — it would be a target for something that already happened.

activity.description: **Required whenever `startTime`, `endTime` or `isCompleted` is present** — without it there is no way to know which of the five slots the values belong to. Editing TODAY`s slot also pushes the new times onto every later day (flags and notes reset), because the times are a routine rather than one day`s log.

trainingId.description: The session that fulfilled this plan, or null while it is still outstanding. UUID.

categoryName.description: Routine category name, or null when the routine has no category.

coreMuscle.description: Distinct primary muscles across the routine's exercises, filtered to the values the app's `MuscleEffect` enum accepts — an unlisted code throws in the app rather than being ignored.

volume.description: Lifted volume (kg·reps). Present only once the plan is completed.

set.description: Recorded set count. Completed plans only.

totalExercises.description: Distinct exercises with at least one set. Completed plans only.

startedAt.description: When the member last did this routine: the fulfilling session's start if completed, else the latest earlier session for the same routine, else null.

type.description: Mapped from `mst_aerobic_categories.code` (`run` → `running`).

aerobicRecordId.description: The aerobic session that fulfilled the plan, or null. UUID.

duration.description: Seconds recorded. **0 while outstanding** — legacy fell back to the master's target duration, a column v2 does not have, so no goal is invented.

distance.description: Kilometres recorded. 0 while outstanding, for the same reason as `duration`.

id.description: Plan id (UUID) — this is what DELETE and duplicate address.

title.description: Routine name, or the aerobic's Japanese label (ランニング / バイク) while outstanding.

isCompleted.description: Whether a session for the same scope exists inside the day (JST).

data.description: Shape depends on `scopeType`: a routine block or an aerobic block.

date.description: The day, as an instant at JST midnight. Legacy stored a DATE but serialized a JS Date, and the app parses a `DateTime` — a bare `YYYY-MM-DD` would still parse, but the instant keeps the app's local formatting on the right day.

isDayOff.description: Member marked this a rest day.

trainingSchedules.description: Plans on the day, newest first (legacy `createdAt DESC`).

isDayOff.description: Mark the day a rest day (`true`) or a training day (`false`).

message.description: fitness-api success message, verbatim.

date.description: Day the copy lands on, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omitted → today (JST).

targetDistance.description: Target distance in km (legacy 目標距離).

targetDuration.description: Target duration in **seconds** (legacy 目標時間(秒)).

type.description: Legacy `AerobicRecordTypeEnum`.

id.description: Aerobic master **UUID** (the app still declares an int — ADR-038 D8; see the 2026-09-11 ruling).

targetDistance.description: Echoed back from the request. **Not persisted** — see the route description.

targetDuration.description: Echoed back from the request. **Not persisted**.

createdAt.description: Time of this call — legacy stored a row and returned its timestamps.

deletedAt.description: **Always null** — nothing is stored, so nothing is soft-deleted.

scopeId.description: Routine or aerobic to plan. A **UUID** in v2 (`training.routines.id` / `training.aerobics.id`); the app still declares an int. Must be the caller's own routine, or an HQ/official one.

date.description: Day to plan it on, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omitted → today (JST), as in legacy.

scheduleId.description: The day row this plan hangs off (`training.schedules.id`, UUID).

deletedAt.description: Always null on create; set once the plan is deleted (soft delete).

coreMuscles.description: Distinct muscles worked by the routine`s movements, filtered to values the app can decode.

routineCount.description: Routines listed below. Legacy dropped a routine with no movement from both the list AND the count, so this can be lower than the canonical `GET /routine-folders` `routineCount`.

duplicateRoutineId.description: The caller`s own copy of this master, if they made one — found through `routines.source_routine_id`. Null means "not added yet".

trainingScheduleId.description: The plan the caller already put on `date` for their copy — a `training_schedules.id` UUID (migration 023). Null when there is no copy or no plan that day.

id.description: Post **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

caption.description: Post body (legacy `caption`); falls back to the title when the body is empty.

images.description: Attached image/video URLs, in sort order. **The key the app reads** (`WorkOutFeeds.images`), which legacy declared on the client and never sent — its service emitted `feedFiles`. Both are returned, the same way the feed card returns `shareScope` and `shareScopes`.

feedFiles.description: The same files under the key legacy`s service actually emitted.

profileAvatar.description: Avatars of up to 3 members who liked the post — legacy`s `rowNumber <= 3` window (BR-SOC-012).

totalComment.description: Comments on the post, excluding authors in a block relation with the caller. Stamps are a separate axis and are not counted.

id.description: Training session **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

name.description: Routine the session was started from. Empty string for a quick-start session, as legacy returned.

time.description: Duration in seconds — the manual override when one was set, otherwise `endedAt - startedAt`. Null while the session is still running.

volume.description: Σ weight × reps over the confirmed sets, as legacy summed it — not a stored column.

personal.description: Legacy`s 自己ベスト score: how many of the four metrics — max weight, reps, volume, estimated 1RM — this workout holds for the member. **0…4, counting metrics, not exercises**; a first-ever workout scores 4, because legacy compared against a history that already included the session. Legacy called the field `personal` here and `achieved` on `trainings/history`; it is the same number.

feed.description: The member`s own post about this workout, or null. Deleting the post makes it null again, as it did in legacy.

coreMuscle.description: See `coreMuscle` on the catalogue list item.

secondaryMuscle.description: See `secondaryMuscle` on the catalogue list item.

unitType.description: Legacy `UnitTypeEnum`. Taken from the routine`s OWN snapshot of the type, so editing the master later does not rewrite old routines.

name.description: The name snapshotted on the routine, as legacy served it.

bestRecord.description: Best `reps × weight` this member has ever recorded for the movement. Legacy grouped by (movement, template set, workout) and summed before taking the max; that key names one recorded set, so the sum has a single term and it reduces to this.

image.description: Fetchable URL of the movement`s picture (a still or an animated GIF), signed at the BFF; null when it has none.

gif.description: **Always null** — v2 has no animation column for a movement; an animated GIF is served in `image`.

setType.description: `routine_sets.set_type`. v2 stores `normal`/`superset`; the app maps anything it does not know to `normal`.

position.description: Legacy `position` — the set number within the movement.

lastWeightKg.description: What the member actually did in this slot last time they ran the routine. Matched by (movement, set number) — legacy had an FK from the recorded set back to the template set and v2 has no such column, so re-numbering a routine`s sets between workouts lines these up differently than legacy would.

lastDistanceMeters.description: **Always null** — v2 records no distance on a strength set, so there is no last value to report.

note.description: **Always null.** Legacy carried the member`s note on the routine entry; v2`s `routine_exercises` has only `hq_comment`, which is HQ copy on official routines.

exercise.description: The WHOLE movement, embedded. The app declares this required, so it is never omitted.

routineExercises.description: Movements in `position` order, each with its sets in order.

routineDuplicatedId.description: The caller`s copy of THIS routine, via `routines.source_routine_id`.

distanceMeters.description: Accepted and ignored — `training_sets` has no distance column (see `distanceMeters` on the read).

routineId.description: Omit for a quick-start workout that follows no routine.

trainingScheduleId.description: The plan this workout fulfils (UUID), if it came from the Calendar.

duration.description: Elapsed seconds as the app measured them; stored as the session`s duration override rather than re-derived.

name.description: The routine`s name; empty string for a quick-start workout.
