description.description: **The routine`s NAME, not its description.** `calculateTrainingInfo` in legacy returns `description: routine?.name`; the app renders the field, so it is reproduced rather than fixed.

time.description: Legacy `time` — the duration sent in the body.

volume.description: Σ weight × reps over the submitted sets.

achieved.description: How many of {max weight, max reps, max volume, max estimated RM} this workout ties across the member`s whole history. The session`s own sets are part of that history by the time it is computed, so a first-ever workout scores 4 — legacy`s behaviour.

duration.description: Seconds. The member-edited duration wins over `endedAt - startedAt`.

volume.description: Strength only: `Σ weight × reps` over confirmed sets.

rep.description: Strength only: total reps over confirmed sets.

set.description: Strength only: number of confirmed sets.

totalExercises.description: Strength only: DISTINCT movements, not exercise blocks.

workoutMetrics.description: Legacy returned one of two shapes under this single key — `ResultTraining` for a strength session, `ResultAerobic` for an aerobic one. Both are folded into one schema here; the fields not belonging to the requested `scopeType` are absent, exactly as legacy left them.

trainingId.description: Strength session **UUID** to attach (legacy `trainingId`, an int then). Must be the caller's and not yet posted about.

aerobicRecordId.description: Aerobic session **UUID** to attach (legacy `aerobicRecordId`). Must be the caller's and not yet posted about; the post takes its date.

feedFiles.description: `s3Key`s of files **already uploaded** via `POST /api/v1/media/presign` (tag `social-media`) and PUT to S3 — **not** the binaries. Up to 4 keys, at most one of them a video. This is the type legacy's own `CreateFeedDto` declared (`feedFiles?: string[]`), even though the shipped client sent multipart instead.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation, verbatim from fitness-api.

reportMemberId.description: Reported member **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

reportContent.description: Free-text report body. Legacy capped it at 300 characters.

reason.description: API-043 report category. **Not part of the legacy contract** — the shipped app has no category picker, so it defaults to `spam` (the mildest bucket: ops triages from `reportContent`, and a harsher default would inject an accusation the member never made). Accepted here so the app can start sending a real category without a backend change. A blank value counts as absent.

feedId.description: Post **UUID** (the app still declares an int — the legacy int ids are gone).

reactionType.description: Legacy `ReactionTypeEnum` (`like`/`love`/`care`/`haha`/`wow`/`sad`), defaulting to `love` as in legacy. v2 has no emotion axis — one `like` plus stamp codes (BR-SOC-011) — so every legacy emotion maps to `like`. A v2 stamp code passes through unchanged.

memberId.description: Author **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

image.description: Avatar URL. The Comment Page calls this `image`; the feed card calls the same value `avatar`.

id.description: Comment **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

profile.description: Author. **Null** when they have no social profile — legacy's Transform returned null rather than an object of nulls.

data.description: Comments **oldest first** — the Comment Page appends new ones at the bottom, so the order is load-bearing.

hasNextPage.description: Legacy computed this as `data.length === limit`, so a full last page reports `true`. Kept.

total.description: Total comments on the post, excluding blocked authors.

feedId.description: Post **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

content.description: Comment body. Legacy required it non-empty.

targetMemberId.description: The other member's **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

avatar.description: Avatar URL. An **empty string**, never null, when the member has no avatar — legacy emitted `''` and the app declares the field non-nullable.

username.description: SNS display name. Legacy named the response field `username` even though its `@ApiProperty` said `targetMemberName`; the app reads `username`.

status.description: Whether **the caller** follows this member — not whether the list's owner does. Browsing somebody else's followers, each row still says what your own follow button should do. `noAction` is the caller's own row.

hasNextPage.description: Legacy computed this as `data.length === limit`, so a full last page reports `true`. Kept. Always `false` for `type=suggest`, which legacy never paged.

total.description: Total matching members. For `type=suggest` this is the page size, as in legacy.

id.description: Training session **UUID** (the app still declares an int).

name.description: Routine the session was started from. Empty string for a quick-start session, as legacy returned.

description.description: Same value as `name`. Legacy assigned `description: routine?.name` — the routine's **name**, not its description — and the picker renders both, so the quirk is reproduced rather than quietly corrected.

time.description: Duration in seconds (legacy named this `time`). Null while a session has not ended and has no manual override.

volume.description: Sum of weight × reps over the session's confirmed sets — legacy's formula, so it agrees with the volume axis behind `achieved`.

achieved.description: How many of the four personal bests — max weight, reps, volume, estimated 1RM — this workout holds (legacy `achieved`). It counts METRICS, not exercises. A member's first workout scores 4: legacy compared against a history that already included the session itself.

title.description: Session name. Legacy accepted any non-empty string (`@IsString() @IsNotEmpty()`) into an unbounded varchar and the app's field sets no `maxLength`; 255 is the server-side ceiling.

duration.description: Workout duration in **seconds** (legacy `trainings.duration`). Stored as the session's manual duration override, so the read paths report it instead of `endedAt - startedAt`. Calories are recomputed when the member has a registered body weight, and left untouched when they do not.

uncollectedAmount.description: Legacy `uncollectedAmount` — the canonical `amount`, renamed. The sum of the **outstanding remainder** across bills (total minus already collected), not their face values. `0` when nothing is owed.

saleIds.description: Legacy `saleIds` — the canonical `billingIds`, renamed and **passed through as UUID strings** (ADR-038 D8; the app moves this field and `financialInfoId` from `int` to `String`). These are what `POST /sbps-link/request` must send back to select which bills to pay, so they are forwarded verbatim rather than dropped. `[]` when nothing is owed.

familyUnpaid.description: Not a legacy field (additive). `true` while the member, or anyone in the member's family, has an unpaid bill. A family member (child) always gets `uncollectedAmount: 0` and `saleIds: []`; show the 「主会員のお支払いが確認できていないため…」 message when this is `true` (APP-F-03 FR-S006).

streakLog.description: The open card's visit days — distinct JST dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`), **newest first**, at most 10. On the day a card closes it is that card's ten days instead (the app recognises “10 days, newest is today” as the completion). `[]` right after a card has closed.

total.description: How many cards have **closed** (every ten distinct visit days close one) — legacy’s count of 「スタンプ」 points. Not the stamps on the open card; the app shows `total × 10 + streakLog.length`.

completedAt.description: When the newest card closed — the first gate entry of its tenth visit day. `null` until a card has closed (or if that day cannot be read).

qrCode.description: Legacy `qrCode` — the canonical `qrPayload`, renamed. Opaque: render it, do not parse it. **Short-lived and single-use**: each call invalidates the previously issued token, so re-request it rather than caching. The canonical response also carries `expiresAt`/`ttlSeconds`; legacy had neither and the app reads neither, so they are dropped here.

id.description: Cabinet id — pass it to `lockers/lockers-slot?lockerId=` to list its slots.

lockerArea.description: Area letter A–Z, from the location master. Legacy held the same letter in a `lockerArea` enum column.

lockerImage.description: First cabinet photo, as a delivery URL. Null when the cabinet has none.

longitude.description: Floor-map X placement. **Not geographic and not pixels** — API-100 §6.3 stores a fraction `0.0–1.0` of the floor-plan image measured from its top-left, so that re-uploading the plan or rendering it at another zoom keeps placements valid. Sent as a string because legacy typed this column `varchar`. Multiply by the rendered plan width; treating it as a pixel offset puts every cabinet in the top-left corner.

latitude.description: Floor-map Y placement — same `0.0–1.0` fraction rule as `longitude`, measured downward from the top edge.

direction.description: **Always null** — v2 has no direction column on a cabinet; legacy defaulted it to `left`. Null rather than a guessed `left`, because the app renders the opening side from it and a wrong side is worse than none. Constrained to legacy's four values if it is ever populated: the app's `LockerDirection` has no unknown member, so any other string is a decode error.

gymMapImage.description: The store's floor-plan image, as a delivery URL. Null when the store has not uploaded one.

lockers.description: The store's active cabinets, filtered to `optionId` when that query param is given. `[]` is a valid answer.

fee.description: Monthly fee, **tax-inclusive** — legacy returned the raw `fee` column, which was 「料金(税込)」. The v2 master is 税込 too (API-085 v0.12), passed through.

description.description: **Always null** — legacy declared this field on the DTO but its service never populated it. Kept so the shape matches; do not read it.

contract.description: Their plan line. Null when they hold no active contract.

options.description: Their active monthly options. `[]` when they have none.

id.description: The OPTION id (legacy int). The app sends it on as `optionId` of the protein/supplement QR lookup.

name.description: "option name (store name)" — the store of the oldest ticket; the option name alone when that store row is gone.

typeActive.description: `qr` for protein / supplement (a QR shown to the vendor machine), `scan` for every other kind.

categoryName.description: The ticket kind, from `options.subcategory`. Always one of these seven.

memberContractId.description: The ticket to use next — the OLDEST unused one (legacy int `member_contracts.id`; here an `option_contracts` id). Sent back to `options-once-time/activate`.
`memberContractId` of an entry from `GET options-once-time` — the caller's own unused ticket.

message.description: fitness-api's message, verbatim — the same for `name=Supplement`.

uniqueId.description: The QR payload the vendor machine reads: `9999` + the digits of the member number, zero-padded to 10 (`JF-0000083` → `99990000000083`). Digits only — the vendor server cannot take letters.

id.description: Ticket id. **UUID** — the app declares `int?` and must switch to String (ruling 2026-09-11).

memberContractId.description: The pass (= the entry `id`). **UUID**, same note.

storeId.description: The store the ticket is valid at (the pass store). String, as the app declares.

usageAt.description: Always null here — this is the next UNUSED ticket.

expiredAt.description: Last usable day (JST), legacy field name.

expirationDate.description: Same day as `expiredAt` — the field the app reads first (`expirationDate ?? expired`).

id.description: The pass (the 1Day contract) — the path id of `activate`. **UUID**, app declares `int`.

name.description: `plan name(store name)` — no space, as legacy.

expired.description: The pass expiry: the latest ticket expiry, else contract start + 6 months. Never empty (the app parses it).

status.description: `using` while a ticket of this pass was activated today (JST).

expiredTicket.description: Unused and past their last day.

nextExpiringTicket.description: The unused ticket that expires first; null when none.

sourceContractId.description: **Always null** — legacy keyed the transfer to a member-contract row; v2's application records the stores and the member, not a contract id.

destinationStoreId.description: The store being moved to (canonical `toStoreId`). The app fetches this store to name it on screen.

scheduledTransferDate.description: Effective date, date-only. Null until scheduled.

transferStatus.description: **Always `transferProcessing`** when a row is returned. The canonical status vocabulary (`pending`/`active`/…) is mapped down to legacy's single in-flight value on purpose: the app's `TransferStoreStatus` knows only this one and falls back to `unknown`, and its screen renders the pending-transfer block **only** on an exact match — so passing the v2 string through would silently blank the block.

transferReason.description: Reason text. Null when unset — the canonical route allows a transfer with no reason.

sourceContractId.description: Accepted and **ignored**: 移籍元 is the caller's main contract (API-142 §3.2), not a client-sent id.

destinationContractId.description: Accepted and ignored — a transfer keeps the plan; plan changes are a separate flow.

sourceStoreId.description: Accepted and **ignored**, for the same reason as `sourceContractId`.

scheduledTransferDate.description: The date the member picked. A bare date or a local timestamp is taken as that calendar day; a timestamp carrying `Z` / an offset is converted to the JST day.

campaignFee.description: Legacy `campaignFee`; v2 campaigns have no single fee → null.

discountStartMonth.description: 1-based month the discount starts in (first_month 1, next_month 2, specific_month N).

discountStartMonthType.description: Always `thMonth` — v2 counts the start month relative to the contract.

cancelFee.description: Fixed 違約金, 税込 (for `cancellationFee`); 0 otherwise.

taxRate.description: Tax rate included in `cancelFee`.

id.description: `billing_items.id` of the discount line. **UUID** — the app declares `int` and must switch to String (ruling 2026-09-11).

saleId.description: `billings.id` it was billed on. **UUID**, same note as `id`.

scopeType.description: `joiningFee` for the enrollment-fee waiver, `memberContract` for a plan discount.

scopeId.description: Always null (no legacy member-contract id to give).

billingAmount.description: The discount as billed: negative, 税込.

saleDetails.description: The discounts charged back (`discountAmount`); empty for `cancellationFee`.

saleDetailIds.description: Sent by the shipped app; **ignored** (the lines are recomputed).

storeId.description: Sent by the shipped app; **ignored** (the contract's store is used).

penaltyDatas.description: Which campaigns to charge. `[]` is answered 200 and charges nothing.

id.description: Option master id. For a locker: the picked slot's `optionId` (`GET lockers/lockers-slot`).

paymentType.description: `payNow` = from today, charged now (a monthly option prorated for the rest of the month); anything else = from the 1st of next month. A one-time option must be `payNow`.

quantity.description: One-time options only (tickets), 1–50. Monthly options are always 1.

lockerSlotId.description: Locker options only: the picked slot. **Required on `/payment`** (the slot is taken in the same transaction); optional on the estimate (priced without it). It must be free, at the contract's store and priced by `id`; the contract may hold one slot.

storeId.description: The contract's store when sent — except a ticket-only purchase (every add a per-use option, `payNow`; no plan change, no cancel, no locker), which may name another store of the brand group that sells the tickets (the app's 他の店舗を指定する, App Bug-No2): the tickets, and their sale, are that store's.

optionDeleteIds.description: Option MASTER ids of options the member holds now, to cancel.

contractId.description: The current plan (master id) — with `contractChangeId` for a plan change.

contractChangeId.description: The plan to change to (master id).

fee.description: 税抜, summed over units of the same name and price.

billPaymentNow.description: What is charged NOW for the `payNow` options; null when none.

storeId.description: As on the estimate: the contract's store, or another store for a ticket-only purchase.

contractId.description: Current plan (master id), with `upgradeContractId`.

upgradeContractId.description: Plan to change to, from the 1st of next month.

memberContractIds.description: Option contracts to cancel (`memberContractId` of `GET /api/v1/options`). One already ending this month (`isOptionCancel`) has its cancel taken back.

ok_return_url.description: `sbps_link`: where the WebView goes after a successful charge.

ng_return_url.description: `sbps_link`: accepted, unused (a failed charge answers an error).

ptype.description: Yamauchi payment type. **Always `point`** here: the shipped app reads only this entry (`GetExternalPointResult.pointBalance`) and v2's ledger has no payment-type axis.

available.description: Spendable balance — the latest ledger row's running total, the same derivation as the canonical `GET /api/v1/points/balance`.

total.description: Lifetime **earned** points, i.e. positive movements only. Spends and expiries do not reduce it: the app derives the member rank (総累計ポイント) from this number, and a rank that dropped when you spent points would be wrong.

balance.description: Spendable balances. **Always exactly one entry** (`ptype: point`), `available: 0` when the ledger is empty. Not brand-gated: ENJOY (JOYFIT) points are in launch scope since TBD-007 closed 2026-08-06.

cumuluses.description: Lifetime totals. **Always exactly one entry** (`ptype: point`), `total: 0` when the ledger is empty.

result.description: The payload, wrapped exactly as the external API wrapped it — the app reads `result`, not the root.

brand.description: Legacy brand selector for the external point server. **Ignored** — the brand is the member's own.

memberId.description: Legacy int member id. **Ignored** — the member is the JWT subject.

sts.description: Legacy account status sent to the external server. **Ignored**.

isOld.description: Legacy "talk to the old point server" switch. **Ignored**.

status.description: Always `ok`: the v2 point ledger needs no member registration, so there is nothing that can fail.

month.description: **Two-digit year** `YY-MM`, as fitness-api sent it. Not a typo and not safe to "fix": the app parses this as `DateTime(2000 + YY, MM)` and re-formats it as `yyyy-MM` for `detail-monthlies`, so a four-digit year here becomes the year 4026 there and the detail list comes back empty. Buckets are cut in **JST**.

totalPoints.description: Points **earned** in the month — positive movements only, matching legacy's `SUM(CASE WHEN endpoint = 'give_point' …)`. A month with more spending than earning still reports what was earned.

status.description: Derived, never stored: the current JST month is still accruing → `PENDING`; every earlier month → `CONFIRMED`. Legacy never emitted `CANCELED` here either.

id.description: **Always null.** The ledger id is a UUID and the app declares `int?`, so sending it would be a Dart `TypeError`; the app's mapper drops the field, so null costs nothing.

point.description: Point **magnitude** (never negative). Direction lives in `type` — v2 stores one signed number, legacy stored an amount plus a direction.

type.description: Derived from the sign of the ledger movement: negative → `use_point`, otherwise `give_point`.

name.description: Row label, standing in for legacy's partner-supplied `svalue`: the movement's own description when it has one, else the JP name of its event type (an unknown event type echoes its code rather than blanking the row). Activity awards store legacy's own `svalue` as their description — `来館` / `トレーニング記録` / `体重体脂肪記録` / `レッスン参加` — so the row reads exactly as it did in legacy.

syncedAt.description: **`YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` in JST, not ISO-8601** — legacy's format, which the app parses as a naive local `DateTime`. It is the ledger timestamp: v2 has no external sync step, so there is no separate synced-at time.

svalue.description: Legacy `svalue` — the row's description, or the JP label for its event type when it has none.

scopeId.description: The source row the points came from (training session, referral, …), or null when the award has no source. **Must round-trip**: the training-result screen shows the popup only when this equals the session it just finished.

scopeType.description: Legacy's name for what the points were for, mapped from the v2 `eventType`. Constrained to values the app's `PointScopeType` knows: that enum decodes **without** an `unknownEnumValue`, so an unrecognised string is an `ArgumentError`, not a null. `stamp` never appears — stamps are not ledger rows.

endpoint.description: Derived from the sign of the ledger movement.

memberId.description: Sent by the shipped app; **ignored** (the member is the JWT subject).

usePoint.description: Points to spend. At most the balance (E-RWD-003) and at most the chosen line's `fee` from `GET plan-options/me` (E-RWD-002) — the same two caps the app applies.

scopeId.description: `memberContractId` of one entry of `GET /api/v1/fitness-member/plan-options/me` — the plan line or one monthly option line of the caller's current contract. Any other id is 404 E-OPT-004.

id.description: Ledger row id of the spend.

point.description: Signed, as legacy stored it: a use is negative.

scopeId.description: The contract line the points will be deducted from (the request `scopeId`).

postalCode.description: 郵便番号 — 7 digits, no hyphen.

prefectureCode.description: 都道府県コード — JIS X 0401, 2 digits. The app maps it with `int.tryParse` to its prefecture picker.

cityCode.description: 市区町村コード — the last 3 digits of the JIS X 0402 municipality code (legacy split the 5-digit code 2 + 3).

prefectureKana.description: 都道府県カナ — half-width katakana, as published by Japan Post.

cityKana.description: 市区町村カナ — half-width katakana.

suburbKana.description: 町域カナ — half-width katakana; empty when `suburb` is empty.

suburb.description: 町域. **Empty string, never null**, for a code that covers the rest of a city (KEN_ALL's 「以下に掲載がない場合」, which legacy passed through and the app then wrote into 住所1). A long 町域 that KEN_ALL splits over several lines is returned joined into one row.

id.description: Choice **UUID** (legacy int) — send it back in `answerIds`.

multipleAnswers.description: **Always false.** Legacy echoed the child row's own column, which only means something on a question.

id.description: Question **UUID** (legacy int) — send it back as `questionId`.

context.example: どのくらいの頻度で来店しますか？

multipleAnswers.description: `true` for a `multiple_choice` question, `false` for every other format.

choices.description: `[]` for a free-text or rating question — the app drops those, as it did with legacy's.

answerIds.description: The chosen choice `id`s. An empty list means "not answered" and is dropped, as legacy did.

storeId.description: Store **UUID** (legacy int). Hides the questions that store opts out of.

message.example: アンケートを送りました
message.description: fitness-api's `common.answerSurvey` string, verbatim.

storeCode.description: The sticker's `major=` — the store's club code (v2 `stores.club_code`, legacy `stores.code`).

qrId.description: The sticker's `minor=` — the device's QR number (v2 `connected_devices.qr_id`, set in the CRM device ledger; legacy `qrId`).

success.description: false on every refusal — which also comes as HTTP 400.

type.description: Which result dialog the app opens: `entry` = the 解錠 dialog (entry gate, and the refusals legacy raised before telling the device kinds apart), `option` = the option-device one.

message.example: アクティブなデバイスが正常に接続されました
message.description: Shown to the member as it is (Japanese).

connectedDeviceName.description: The device name (Body Planner scan: the option name). Null when the sticker named no device.

optionIds.description: Only on 「これらのオプションを購入する必要があります。」: the store's options of the service type that would have allowed it (legacy `number[]`).

storeId.description: Only alongside `optionIds` — the store whose ticket shop the app opens (legacy int).

success.description: false on every refusal — which also comes as HTTP 400.

type.description: Which result dialog the app opens: `entry` = the 解錠 dialog (entry gate, and the refusals legacy raised before telling the device kinds apart), `option` = the option-device one.

message.example: アクティブなデバイスが正常に接続されました
message.description: Shown to the member as it is (Japanese).

connectedDeviceName.description: The device name (Body Planner scan: the option name). Null when the sticker named no device.

optionIds.description: Only on 「これらのオプションを購入する必要があります。」: the store's options of the service type that would have allowed it (legacy `number[]`).

storeId.description: Only alongside `optionIds` — the store whose ticket shop the app opens (legacy int).

statusCode.description: fitness-api's HttpException status, echoed in the body.

code.description: The v2 catalogue code, when the refusal came from one (Body Planner scan only).

qr.description: The analyser's result QR, verbatim (Tanita `DF870` format — the app only sends QR text starting with `DF870`).

storeId.description: The store the Body Planner option must be registered at — the app sends its contract store (legacy int).
The store the inquiry is about (legacy int; ADR-038 D8 UUID).

email.description: Where the member wants the answer — may differ from the account email. Also receives the receipt mail.

content.example: 料金プランについて教えてください。

type.description: fitness-api `InquiryTypeEnum`. Decides the 受付番号 letter (A–G) and the API-143 category the row is filed under.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone (digits, `+`, `-`, spaces, parentheses; up to 20).

message.example: リクエストが正常に送信されました
message.description: Legacy’s fixed success message.

inquiryCode.description: 受付番号: the type’s letter (A 入会 / B 料金プラン / C 施設・設備 / D プログラム・レッスン / E パーソナルトレーニング / F 退会・休会 / G その他) + 8 characters. The app only opens its completion screen when this is present, and shows it there.

ok_return_url.description: Legacy field — **do not send**. Accepted and ignored: the WebView always lands on `{API}/api/v1/fitness-member/sbps-link/done/ok` when every selected bill is paid.

ng_return_url.description: Legacy field — **do not send**. Accepted and ignored: otherwise (declined, no card, partly paid) the WebView lands on `{API}/api/v1/fitness-member/sbps-link/done/ng`.

linkType.description: Payment method. Only `credit` exists in v2 (the card on file); anything else is 400.

saleIds.description: Bills to pay — the `saleIds` of `sales/uncollected-amount`. Ids that are no longer uncollected are left out.

financialInfoId.description: Accepted and unused: v2 charges the member’s active SBPS credit card.

brandGroup.description: Brand group the area belongs to. Immutable after create.

genderCondition.description: 性別の条件: none = なし / female_only = 女性のみ / male_only = 男性のみ.
性別の条件: none / female_only / male_only.

doors.description: The live doors of the area. system / headquarter: every store; manager / staff / observer: only the doors of their own stores (E-02 データスコープ). `usageCounts.doorCount` stays the total.

usageCounts.description: 使われている所 — counts. An area with any count above 0 cannot be deleted.

updatedByName.description: 最終変更 — staff display name (null when unresolved).

usage.description: 使われている所 — the plans, options and area doors that use the area.

planCount.description: Plans (not deleted) whose 利用できるエリア include the area.

optionCount.description: Options whose 利用できるエリア include the area.

doorCount.description: Live area doors (connected devices) set to the area, over every store — also for a store-scoped role, whose `usage.doors` lists only its own stores' doors.

usageCounts.description: 使われている所 — counts. An area with any count above 0 cannot be deleted.

updatedByName.description: 最終変更 — staff display name (null when unresolved).
